author: Unknown
title: Ipek: Looking only at the final link in child worker deaths is wrong - Part One
content:
In Turkey, where cheap labour is widely used, the number of child workers has begun to rise, particularly as the economic crisis has deepened. According to data from the Turkish Statistical Institute (TÜIK), the number of working children stood at 720,000 as of 2019.


The number of child workers began to increase further with the introduction of Vocational Education Centres (MESEM). The lack of inspections at workplaces affiliated with MESEM has also led to an increase in child worker deaths. According to data from the Workers’ Health and Work Safety Assembly (İSİG), 62 children lost their lives in work-related deaths in the first eight months of 2026.


Deniz Ipek, a Class A occupational safety expert working with the ISIG Observatory, spoke to ANF about child labour in Turkey and the reasons behind the rising number of worker deaths.


I believe the real figure should be counted in the millions


Ipek said the exact number of child workers in Turkey as of 2026 is unknown and that although some figures provide a reference point, the full scale cannot be determined. Ipek continued: “We do not know exactly how many child workers are working in Turkey today. TÜIK’s most recent special Child Labour Force Survey covering the entire 5–17 age group was conducted in 2019, and the number of children engaged in economic activity was reported as 720,000. Of the working children, 79.7 percent were aged 15–17, 15.9 percent were aged 12–14, and 4.4 percent were aged 5–11. It is also important that the survey’s reference period was October to December; the summer months, when child labour increases in agriculture, tourism and seasonal work, are not adequately reflected in this picture.


More recent TÜIK data cover the 15–17 age group. In 2025, the labour force participation rate in this age group rose to 25.5 percent and the employment rate to 22.1 percent. In other words, one in four children aged 15–17 is in the labour force. The problem is that child labour is not captured in a single set of statistics. MESEM students, vocational high school interns, children working in seasonal agriculture, and those working informally in small-scale industry and services all fall under different statuses. Refugee child labour is one of the least visible parts of this picture. A significant proportion of refugee children working in agriculture, textiles, small workshops and the service sector are employed informally, meaning the true scale is not reflected in official statistics. Any figure that excludes refugee children when discussing the overall scale of child labour in Turkey is therefore incomplete.


We cannot use the 2019 figure of 720,000 as today’s number of child workers. I believe the real figure should be counted in the millions. Estimates of more than three million are not official TÜİK data either; they are estimates that attempt to account for child labour that remains invisible and fragmented across different statuses. There is a serious lack of data. Independent studies on children who have died allow us to establish a figure, but we do not know the total number of children who are working, injured, left disabled or suffering from work-related health problems. Child labour itself is visible, but its true scale remains invisible.”


The economic basis for so many children working is clear


Ipek said child labour is prohibited, but a large informal economy exists in which child workers remain invisible and added: “Under Article 71 of Labour Law No. 4857, the employment of children under the age of 15 is prohibited. Children who have reached the age of 14 and completed compulsory primary education may work in light jobs that do not interfere with their physical, mental, social and moral development or their education. The Regulation on the Procedures and Principles for the Employment of Children and Young Workers also limits the types of work they may perform and their working conditions according to age.


Against these legal restrictions stands a much larger informal economy. From industrial estates to agriculture, from small workshops to the service sector, child labour can easily be rendered invisible. There are also statuses such as ‘student’, ‘apprentice’ and ‘intern’. From an occupational health and safety perspective, what matters to me is the work the child actually performs. If a child is operating a press, welding, working with electricity, carrying heavy loads or working at height, the status assigned to them does …

author: Unknown
title: Bir hayat için kaç kişiyiz?
content:
Türkiye’de engelli kişilerin şüpheli ölümlerine, işkence ve eziyet iddialarına ilişkin takip ettiğimiz dosyalarda bazen on, bazen on beş kişiyiz.


Etrafımıza baktığımızda birbirini iyi tanıyan engelli hakları savunucularını ve kan ağlayan aileleri görüyoruz. Madrid’de yetmiş yıldır yaşadığı evden çıkarılan Maricarmen’in hikayesini okurken aklıma bizim bu halimiz geldi…


Maricarmen Abascal, 87 yaşında, engelli bir kadın. Madrid’in Retiro semtinde, gençliğinden beri yaşadığı evden 23 Eylül 2026’da sedyeyle çıkarıldı. Kapıda ve binanın içinde bekleyenler tahliyeyi durdurmaya çalıştı; polis onları püskürttü.


Maricarmen ambulansla hastaneye götürülürken, evinin önünde onun yalnız olmadığını söyleyen insanlar vardı. O gün tahliyeyi engelleyemediler. Ama hikaye, ambulansın sokağın köşesinden dönmesiyle bitmedi.


Aynı gün Madrid’de binlerce kişi sokağa çıktı. Euronews’un haberine göre, başkentteki gösteriye on binden fazla kişi katıldı. Protestolar başka kentlere yayıldı. İnsanlar “Hepimiz Maricarmen’iz” diyordu. Kiracılar örgütlerinin sonraki çağrısı da tek bir kişinin adını çoğaltıyordu: “Bütün Maricarmenler için.” Yaşlı ve engelli kadının evinden çıkarılması, birbirini tanımayan insanların ortak meselesi haline gelmişti.

 


Maricarmen’in yanında duran herkes onun komşusu değildi. İspanya’da sokağa dökülen binlerin aynı yaşta olmaları, aynı engelliliği yaşamaları, aynı şirketle karşı karşıya bulunmaları gerekmedi. Halk, bir kişinin başına gelenle kendi hayatları arasında bağ kurabildi. O bağın kurulabildiği yerde, bir tahliye dosyası yalnızca kiracıyla ev sahibi arasındaki uyuşmazlık olarak kalmadı; mülkiyetin, barınmanın ve kamu gücünün nasıl ilişkilendiği de tartışmaya açıldı.


Üstelik bu hikayede sermaye, adı konulamayan soyut bir güç değil. Evin sahibi Urbagestión, Urbagesa ticari adıyla gayrimenkul yatırımları alanında faaliyet gösteriyor. Şirket kendisini bir yatırım fonu değil, “

küçük bir işletme

” olarak tanımlıyor. İnsanları evinden eden küçük bir işletme…


Madrid’deki Kiracılar Sendikasının aktardığına göre, Maricarmen’e sunulan seçenekler arasında, evinden otuz kilometre uzakta, aylık 1.200 avro isteyen bir bakım kurumu da vardı. Belediye “yardım” sunduğunu, sendika ise bu seçeneğin onun gelirini ve yaşadığı çevreyle bağlarını gözetmediğini söylüyordu.


Bir insanın başını sokabileceği başka bir yer bulmakla, hayatını sürdürebilmesini sağlamak arasındaki fark burada beliriyor. Alıştığı çevre, ilişkileri, gündelik hayatını nasıl yaşayacağına dair tercihleri basit bir taşınma işleminin ayrıntıları değil. 


Madrid’deki dayanışmanın bir başka boyutu da sosyal hizmet çalışanlarının bu itirazıydı.

Samur Social

 işçi komitesi, tahliyelere katılmayı reddeden bir metni çalışanlara iletti. Sosyal hizmet çalışanları, mesleki değerlendirmelerinin dikkate alınmadığını; bazen tahliye edilen kişiye sunabilecekleri hiçbir barınma seçeneği olmadan görevlendirildiklerini anlattı. 


Aynı sosyal hizmet çalışanları, özel bir şirket bünyesinde istihdam edildikleri için bu tutumun kendileri bakımından taşıdığı risklerden de söz ediyordu. İşçi komitesinin anlatımına göre hizmeti yürüten Grupo 5, bir yatırım fonu tarafından satın alınmıştı. Böylece konutun yatırım konusu olması ve bakım emeği yarıştırıldı. Yani, bir yanda evinden çıkarılan kişinin desteğe ihtiyacı, diğer yanda o desteği vermekle görevli çalışanın iş güvencesi vardı. Tam da bu durum, bizim için çok tanıdık…


Türkiye’de takip ettiğimiz dosyalarda hissettiğimiz yalnızlığı bu bağlamda düşünüyorum. Şüpheli bir ölümün aydınlatılmasını, işkence ve eziyet iddialarının araştırılmasını isterken yalnızca delillerle uğraşmıyoruz. O hayatın neden herkesinki kadar önemli olduğunu yeniden anlatmak zorunda kalmanın ağırlığını da taşıyoruz. Aynı yüzler, birbirini tanıyan aynı insanlar, yakınlarının başına ne geldiğini öğrenmek için adliyelere gidip gelen aileler…


Engelli bir kişinin işkence görmesi, şüpheli koşullar altında hayatını kaybetmesi, yalnızca engellilik alanında çalışanların ilgileneceği bir konu olabilir mi?


Bir bakım kurumundaki şüpheli ölüm, sadece o kurumda yakını bulunanların sorunu olarak kalabilir mi? Dosyanın teknik yönleri uzmanlık gerektirebilir; fakat bir insanın şiddetten korunmasını, söyleyeceği sözünün dinlenmesini ve ölümünün aydınlatılmasını istemek uzmanlığa bağlı değil. Orada bulunmak için benzer bir hayatı yaşamak gerekmiyor…


Engellilik ve yoksulluğun kesiştiği yer


Hayattan koparılan engellilere bakım sunanların ekonomik …

content:
“ΟΥΛΟΙ ΕΜΕΙΣ ΕΦΕΝΤΗ” – Η Κοινότητα Κατειλημμένων Προσφυγικών της Λ. Αλεξάνδρας καλεί σε πορεία επανασύνδεσης από το Πολυτεχνείο προς τα Προσφυγικά το Σάββατο 26 Σεπτεμβρίου.

ΓΙΑ ΤΟΝ ΑΓΩΝΑ ΠΟΥ ΔΟΘΗΚΕ ΚΑΙ ΚΕΡΔΗΘΗΚΕ ΣΥΛΛΟΓΙΚΑ – ΓΙΑ ΤΟΥΣ ΑΓΩΝΕΣ ΠΟΥ ΘΑ ΔΟΘΟΥΝ ΚΑΙ ΘΑ ΚΕΡΔΗΘΟΥΝ ΣΥΛΛΟΓΙΚΑ


[…] Κι έτσι ο καθένας προχωράει βάζοντας το μερίδιο αίματος που του αντιστοιχεί μέχρι να εξεγερθούν κι άλλοι, μέχρι την εποχή που όλοι όρθιοι θα βάλουμε έναν νέο ήλιο σ’ ένα νέο ουρανό[…]


Subcomandante Marcos


Υπάρχουν στιγμές που ένας συλλογικός αγώνας αφήνει τέτοιο υλικό και ηθικό αποτύπωμα ώστε είναι αδύνατον να προσπεραστεί. Είναι εκείνες οι στιγμές που η κοινωνία παίρνει ξανά τη δύναμή της στα χέρια της, υψώνονται τα βλέμματα και έχει ήδη παρθεί η απόφαση της νίκης. Κι έτσι ανοίγονται ρωγμές. Ρωγμές – παράθυρα σε έναν διαφορετικό κόσμο, από τις οποίες ξεπηδάει η ζωή.


Αυτές τις στιγμές μοιραστήκαμε τους τελευταίους μήνες, ως Κοινότητα Κατειλημμένων Προσφυγικών, με όλους τους συντρόφους και γείτονές μας, με τους συντρόφους μας απεργούς πείνας μέχρι θανάτου Αριστοτέλη Χαντζή και Suzon Doppagne και από κοινού με όλους τους ανθρώπους της αλληλεγγύης που βαδίσαμε κι αγωνιστήκαμε πλάι πλάι. Αυτόν τον πολύ όμορφο αγώνα μοιραστήκαμε, που η παρακαταθήκη του στο παρόν και το μέλλον απλώνεται μπροστά μας τώρα φωτίζοντας μια τεράστια δυνατότητα.


Η νίκη αυτή είναι μια υπόθεση συλλογική. Αποτελεί μια ακόμη απόδειξη πως όταν περάσουμε από το εγώ στο εμείς μπορούμε να ανασυγκροτήσουμε την πολυδιασπασμένη μας ισχύ ως κοινωνίες και κινήματα από τα κάτω. Μπορούμε να ξαναχτίσουμε το συλλογικό φαντασιακό του κόσμου της αλληλεγγύης, της καθημερινής αντίστασης απέναντι στην εξαθλίωση, τον φόβο, την υποταγή, την εξατομίκευση.


Αυτούς τους μήνες, άνθρωποι και αγώνες συναντήθηκαν. Μέσα από τις αντιθέσεις και τη διαφορετικότητα, ένα ευρύ κοινωνικό μέτωπο δημιουργήθηκε και στο διάβα του συμπαρέσυρε πολλές από τις βεβαιότητες του κόσμου της εξουσίας: Το ότι η καταστολή και η ήττα είναι δεδομένες. Το ότι οι αγώνες δίνονται μονοθεματικά και μέσα σε στενά όρια και μερικές φορές για την τιμή των όπλων. Το ότι ο κατακερματισμός είναι αναγκαίος. Το ότι η εξατομικευμένη νεοφιλελεύθερη αντίληψη του εαυτού και του κόσμου είναι παντοδύναμη και τα θεμέλια της ανθρώπινης συνεργασίας, της αλληλεγγύης και της αυτοθέσμισης των κοινωνιών έχουν αποσαρθρωθεί.


Δε χρειάστηκε να ειπωθούν πολλά όλον αυτόν τον καιρό – και ταυτόχρονα έχουν ειπωθεί σχεδόν όλα μέσα στον αγώνα. Και η ουσία όλων αυτών είναι πως είδαμε να υφαίνεται ξανά το συλλογικό φαντασιακό μέσα από την αναγνώριση της ανάγκης να ξαναβρούμε τους δεσμούς αλληλεγγύης και κοινότητας μεταξύ μας, ως τον πυρήνα των συλλογικών αντιστάσεων.


Γιατί στις κοινότητες συναντιούνται οι άνθρωποι, εκεί συλλογικοποιούνται οι ανάγκες και οργανώνονται οι απαντήσεις. Κι από την ανάγκη στην οργάνωση κι από την οργάνωση στον αγώνα και τη διεκδίκηση, ανοίγουν διάπλατα μπροστά μας μονοπάτια για να τα βαδίσουμε …

title: Kongress unserer Internationale ICL-CIT
content:
Ein außerordentlicher Kongress unserer Gewerkschaftsinternationen ICL-CIT ("Internationale Konföderation der Arbeit") findest an diesem Wochenende (25.-27. September) in Massenzatico statt. Die FAU nimmt vier Delegierten teil. Es wird vor allem um Statutenänderungen und Arbeitsabläufe gehen, denn es ist notwendiger denn je, unter den gegebenen Bedingungen schnell und koordiniert länderübergreifend agieren zu können.

Vertreten sein werden neben der FAU die CNT (Spanien), CNT (Frankreich), die IWW-Regionen Wisera (Europa) and Nara (Nordamerika), die IP (Polen), USI (Italien) und FORA (Argentinien).

Schon vor dem Kongress wurden in einem Referendum die neuen Mitglieder Federation of General Workers Myanmar (FGWM) und Federação das Organizações de Base aus Brasilien (FOB) aufgenommen, die online zugeschaltet sind.

Quellen und mehr Info (Englisch/spanisch):

title: MEETING ANTIFASCISTE CONTRE L'EXTRADICTION DE GINO
content:
Le Comité Solidarité Budapest vous invite, le jour de l'audience décisive de Gino devant la cour de cassation, à une grande rencontre politique pour parler de la répression et s'organiser contre elle.


RDV

 le 30 septembre 2026 à 18h30 à la Bourse du Travail de Paris (3 rue du Chateau-d'Eau, 75010)


Plus de détails sur le programme et des nouveaux invité.es seront communiqués dans les jours à venir. En attendant, continuaons nos actions en solidarité avec Gino, Zaid et les antifascistes de Budapest.


Défendre l'antifascisme signifie : pas d'extradition pour Gino.


Déclaration commune d'auteur·rices, d'artistes, de scientifiques et de personnalités politiques de France, d'Italie, d'Allemagne, des États-Unis et d'autres pays.


Partout dans le monde, nous assistons à la montée de l'extrême droite. Des partis autoritaires remportent les élections et accèdent au pouvoir. En

février 2023

, comme depuis plusieurs années, des néonazis de toute l'Europe s'étaient réunis à

Budapest

 pour commémorer la

SS

. Les participants défilèrent en uniformes, arborant ouvertement des symboles nazis. Comme chaque année, des antifascistes de plusieurs pays manifestaient contre cet évènement.


À la suite d'accrochages et d'agressions en marge de cette commémoration,

une vague de mesures répressives transfrontalières à l'encontre des antifascistes a été déclenchée

. Ils sont menacés de

peine de prison

 très lourdes, sans aucune commune mesure avec les faits reprochés. Gino est notamment accusé d'avoir infligé à des néonazis des blessures ayant entraîné moins de huit jours d'incapacité de travail, mais il risque vingt-quatre ans de prison. Ce décalage entre l'infraction présumée et la peine encourue doit nous alarmer.


Gino a trouvé refuge en France il y a près de deux ans

. En

2025

, la

Cour d'appel de Paris a décidé de ne pas remettre Gino à la Hongrie, estimant qu'il n'existait pas de garanties suffisantes pour un procès équitable

 et évoquant la possibilité d'éventuelles violations de la Convention européenne des droits de l'Homme. La cour faisait également part de ses réserves concernant les conditions de détention dans les prisons hongroises. Mais aussitôt après ce refus, par une coïncidence extraordinaire,

l'Allemagne a émis son propre mandat d'arrêt européen, indiquant ainsi clairement sa collaboration avec la Hongrie

.

La Cour d'appel de Paris a brusquement décidé, contrairement à sa précédente décision de 2025, que Gino devait être remis à l'Allemagne

. Ce changement de cap a de quoi surprendre. Les avocats de Gino se sont alors pourvus en Cassation

 

; la

décision

 sera rendue le

30 septembre

.


Or, si c'est désormais la justice allemande qui le réclame,

l'enquête a été effectuée par la police de Viktor Orban

. La Cour d'appel de Paris a beau affirmer que “La procédure d'enquête hongroise n'a ni été transmise par les autorités hongroises ni effectuée par les autorités allemandes

 

», on peine à comprendre, à travers cette prose artificieuse, qui pourrait alors avoir mené l'enquête

 

!

La Cour d'appel évoque des “décisions d'enquête européenne.” Cette terminologie ne doit cependant pas nous tromper

, une décision d'enquête européenne n'est rien d'autre qu'une décision prise par la justice d'un pays (en l'occurrence l'Allemagne) qui demande à la police d'un autre pays (en l'occurrence la Hongrie) d'effectuer des actes d'enquête. La vie des gens ne peut pas être mise à la merci des mots.


Le mandat d'arrêt européen ne saurait être une procédure automatique, ignorant les réalités politiques. Tandis que partout l'extrême droite prospère, si l'on veut protéger les libertés publiques et les droits fondamentaux, il faut que le juge n'abdique pas son contrôle. Le fait de vouloir remettre Gino à la justice allemande, malgré que l'enquête soit hongroise, c'est tolérer une justice de façade, c'est accepter de remettre un prévenu à la justice allemande afin qu'il soit jugé sur la base d'une enquête effectuée par un état autoritaire.


Dans la même affaire,

en juin 2024, une camarade de Gino a été remise par les autorités allemandes à la Hongrie

, sans aucun scrupule et sans attendre la décision de la Cour constitutionnelle fédérale, qui jugera d'ailleurs cette

extradition illégale

. Trop tard,

Maja

 purge désormais une peine de

 huit ans de prison en Hongrie

, dans des conditions d'incarcération effroyables.


L'antifasciste

Zaid

 A. comme Gino,

est également ré clamé par la Hongrie …

title: Karasu: Rıza Altun’s struggle will always guide us
content:
Rıza Altun, one of the leading cadres of the Kurdistan Freedom Movement, and those who lost their lives in the Freedom Movement’s struggle were commemorated at an event held in Paris.


In a video message to the commemoration, KCK (Kurdistan Communities Union) Executive Council member Mustafa Karasu spoke about Rıza Altun’s activities from the early years of his involvement in the struggle until his death. Karasu said that Altun assumed responsibilities in various areas of the Freedom Movement, from organizing work in Ankara’s Tuzluçayır neighborhood to Antep, from resistance in prison to his activities in Kurdistan and diplomatic work, highlighting his qualities as an organizer and activist.


Karasu also saluted commemorations for the martyrs that have been held in many cities across Kurdistan over the past month after the announcement of their deaths. He said that the public’s participation in and support for these commemorations had given them great morale.


The message sent by KCK Executive Council member Mustafa Karasu to the commemoration in the French capital is as follows:


“I greet all our people who have gathered to commemorate Comrade Rıza. This is the seventh anniversary of Comrade Rıza’s death. Comrades Baz and Garzan, together with Comrade Rıza, lost their lives in an airstrike on September 25, 2019.


As we remember these comrades, commemorations for the martyrs have been taking place across Kurdistan for the past month. Once again, I remember all those martyrs with respect and gratitude. I also commend our people who have participated in these commemorations with great enthusiasm.


Comrade Rıza holds an important place in the history of our party. He was one of the first cadres of our struggle. Our movement was a group that emerged among university students in Ankara and initially organized within the university youth.


The Apoists were organized among university students in Ankara. They also organized in Tuzluçayır, a neighborhood in Ankara known as ‘Little Moscow.’ Comrade Rıza was the leading figure in organizing the Apoist group in Tuzluçayır.


Comrade Rıza organized dozens of young people and brought them into the struggle. It was him who secured Tuzluçayır’s support for our movement. Just as he brought many young people from Tuzluçayır into our struggle, he also involved his entire family in it from the very beginning. His family became part of the struggle as well. Indeed, one of his brothers and two of his nephews lost their lives in this struggle. In this respect, his family stands among the foremost examples in the history of our struggle and our movement of families who participated collectively.


This in itself demonstrated what kind of militant Comrade Rıza was and what kind of Apoist he was. Because he believed deeply in this struggle and devoted himself to it completely, his entire family also became involved and took part in the struggle, and young members of the family lost their lives.


Comrade Rıza and I went to Kurdistan toward the end of 1976, more precisely, at the end of the summer. We went to Kurdistan at almost the same time. A month earlier, I had gone to Antep with Doğan Kılıçkaya, a valued militant from Tuzluçayır who later lost his life and whose nom de guerre was Yasin. A month later, Comrade Rıza also came to Antep.


At that time, Antep was one of the first places where our struggle developed and became most influential. Comrade Rıza played a very important role in this. While our struggle in Antep developed into a major struggle against fascists, a party culture also emerged there under the leadership of Comrade Haki. Comrade Rıza also played a role in shaping this party culture.


Comrade Rıza was truly known as a militant within the struggle. He was an important and influential militant of the Apoist group. He was very composed and highly effective in the struggle against fascists. While he was in Ankara, in Tuzluçayır, he also waged a significant struggle against fascists. During his struggle there, Comrade Rıza’s code name was ‘Şirket’ (‘Company’). He was given this name because of his organizational abilities.


In Tuzluçayır, a truly effective struggle was waged against fascists under Şirket’s leadership. Comrade Rıza was not only an influential militant in our freedom movement’s struggle against fascists, but also served on the first military council of our movement. Together with Comrade Mehmet Karasungur, he was a member of the military council.

title: APPEL A MANIFESTATION ANTIFA LE 10 OCTOBRE - AIX EN PROVENCE
content:
A l'appel de Aix Antifa et d'autres signataires comme Tsedek, UJFP, UPM, LFI, AfroQueer Révolutionnaires, Aix Vanguard,Extinction Rebellion et le Collectif Antifasciste Sud Luberon, toustes solidaires pour dire NON à L'extreme droite


10 OCTOBRE — 11H FAISONS FRONT CONTRE L'EXTRÊME DROITE


L'extrême droite avance mais nous ne la laisserons pas passer. À l'approche des élections présidentielles, le rassemblement national progresse et se trouve aujourd'hui en tête de nombreuses intentions de vote. Cette progression doit nous alerter et nous pousser à construire dès maintenant une riposte populaire, sociale, antiraciste et antifasciste. Car derrière les sondages, il y a la réalité du racisme et des discours de haine qui se banalisent L'extrême droite se nourrit de la division et de la désignation de boucs émissaires : les immigré·es, les personnes racisées, les musulman·es, les habitant·es des quartiers populaires sont constamment désigné·es comme responsables. L'islamophobie s'installe dans le débat public et nourrit un climat de stigmatisation et d'exclusion. Les personnes LGBTQIA+, et particulièrement les personnes trans, sont elles aussi au cœur d'une offensive réactionnaire. Leurs droits, leur dignité et leur place dans la société sont attaqués. Nous sommes dans une période où le néonazisme se banalise et progresse : de plus en plus, des personnes se sentent suffisamment à l'aise pour afficher ouvertement des symboles et des saluts nazis dans l'espace public. Cette banalisation doit nous faire réagir : nous ne pouvons pas laisser la haine et les idéologies fascistes s'installer comme une normalité.


L'EXTRÊME DROITE N'EST PAS INVINCIBLE


Elle cherche à nous convaincre que sa victoire serait inévitable. Ce n'est pas le cas. Nous refusons que le racisme, l'islamophobie, la transphobie et la haine deviennent la norme. Et nous refusons que la colère contre la précarité, les bas salaires, les services publics détruits et les inégalités soit tournée contre celles et ceux qui en sont aussi victimes.


NOUS VOULONS UNE AUTRE FORCE


Un antifascisme populaire et antiraciste qui rassemble largement et s'organise dans la durée. Car l'extrême droite n'est pas invincible. Il est possible de repousser l'extrême droite par notre mobilisation. L'année dernière, c'est cette mobilisation syndicale et populaire qui a permis d'empêcher que le gala du réactionnaire Stérin se déroule au 6MIC. C'est aussi la mobilisation qui a permis de faire partir le pseudo « journal » raciste Frontières du campus aixois. Chaque fois que nous sommes nombreux·ses, organisés et solidaires, nous pouvons faire reculer l'extrême droite. Le 10 octobre, faisons de la rue un espace de résistance et de rassemblement.

title: El fascismo del fin de los tiempos: hacer negocio hasta que llegue el apocalipsis
content:
El fascismo del fin de los tiempos: hacer negocio hasta que llegue el apocalipsis


Por Naomi Klein Y Astra Taylor 


24 Septiembre, 2026


El mundo asiste a la emergencia de un nuevo fascismo. La gran diferencia con la pesadilla que vivimos en el siglo XX es que los monstruos de aquellos tiempos engañaban a las masas con la promesa de un futuro purificado, rico y estable mientras los de ahora aceleran sin frenos hacia la catástrofe al grito de sálvese quien tenga dinero. La alianza de etnonacionalistas, tecnoligarcas y fanáticos religiosos ha dado la espalda a un porvenir común


Este verano, a medida que el calor implacable y la sequía hacían bajar sus niveles de agua, el Danubio empezó a mostrar sus secretos. Como si fueran monstruos que surgían del fango del tiempo, empezaron a aparecer restos hundidos de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.


En Serbia, el río, al secarse, dejó al descubierto al menos 20 barcos nazis, algunos de ellos aún cargados de munición sin detonar. En Hungría, dejó al aire una motocicleta militar nazi cubierta de barro caliente, cerca de las medallas y las placas de identificación oxidadas de dos soldados alemanes. En Eslovaquia, un transeúnte vio que asomaba en el río casi desaparecido una enorme bomba de 680 kilos plantada por la Royal Air Force. Las autoridades tuvieron que transportar con cuidado el arma, que llevaba más de 80 años sumergida, y detonarla bajo tierra, a gran profundidad.


Muchos observadores tienen la sensación de que estas apariciones fantasmales y amenazadoras del pasado de Europa son, más que una curiosidad histórica, una metáfora demasiado literal: la forma que tiene la naturaleza de confirmar la frase de William Faulkner de que “el pasado nunca muere. Ni siquiera es pasado”.


La impresión de que la historia se repite se apoya en muchos datos. A lo largo de todo el Danubio, en la última década ha habido un auge de la nostalgia por una época en la que la “civilización europea” dominaba de forma absoluta, y cada nueva oleada de extrema derecha coquetea con más descaro que la anterior con políticas y consignas raciales que se suponía que habían quedado enterradas al desaparecer el Tercer Reich.


La magnitud de este renacimiento quedó patente a principios de 2025 en la Conferencia de Seguridad de Múnich. Allí, el vicepresidente de Estados Unidos, J. D. Vance, recién investido, reprendió a los líderes europeos por mantener un cortafuegos político que aislaba a partidos de extrema derecha antes intocables.


Además, se desvivió por reunirse con el partido alemán Alternativa por Alemania (AfD), que ha difundido propuestas para la “remigración” de grandes cantidades de gente y cuyo antiguo colíder llegó a decir que la época nazi no era más que una “caca de pájaro” en la historia del país. Este septiembre, el partido logró un avance electoral histórico en Sajonia-Anhalt, al obtener un 43,8 por ciento de los votos.


Más al este, a orillas del Danubio, el Partido de la Libertad de Austria (FPÖ), fundado en 1956 por un antiguo funcionario nazi, goza de la mayor popularidad de su historia y Walter Rosenkranz, miembro destacado del partido, ocupa el segundo cargo más importante del país. El año pasado, el jefe de gabinete de Rosenkranz tuvo que dimitir cuando se supo que una investigación oficial sobre los “Separatistas Sajones”, de extrema derecha, había descubierto un alijo de munición y parafernalia nazi en una propiedad vinculada a él, aunque él negó vivir allí.


Da la casualidad de que el grupo que está en el centro de la polémica tiene las iniciales “SS”, como da la casualidad de que Elon Musk, acérrimo partidario de la AfD y de otros grupos de la extrema derecha europea, expresó su gratitud a los votantes de Trump en enero de 2025 con un gesto que muchos interpretaron como un saludo nazi. (Musk restó importancia a la crítica y publicó en su plataforma X: “Francamente, necesitan mejores artimañas. La crítica de que ‘todo el mundo es Hitler’ está muuuuy manida”).


Igual que los buques de guerra hundidos que están saliendo a la luz a medida que baja el nivel del Danubio, el fascismo parece estar resurgiendo en Europa, Estados Unidos y otros países. Sin embargo, después de haber acabado de escribir un libro sobre los rasgos distintivos del fascismo contemporáneo, no acaban de gustarnos las comparaciones históricas lineales. Por el contrario, si queremos comprender a la extrema derecha actual, más nos valdría no quedarnos en las reliquias oxidadas y prestar más atención a la …

title: AfD-Meldeportale gegen Lehrerinnen und Lehrer: Teil einer weltweiten Kampagne der Rechten gegen emanzipativen Unterricht
content:
Dossier


Der

faschistische brasilianische Präsidentschaftskandidat

 hat es im Programm: Schule ohne Parteien (was bedeutet, schön, wie früher, kolonialistisch lehren, das Land sei am 22. April 1500 von den Portugiesen „entdeckt“ worden); die Teesäufer des Herrn Trump haben es als Ziel: Ideologiefreie Schulen (sprich wir haben den „Wilden Westen“ zivilisiert und die paar toten Indianer haben es eh verdient) und noch mehrere andere. Indische Safran-Faschisten wollen den muslimischen Teil der eigenen Geschichte nicht gerne hören, bei Orban sollen die Kinder auf Panzern rumklettern statt Sozialkunde  und so weiter – da konnte ein rechtsradikaler Ideologen-Verein wie die AFD nicht fehlen: Neutrale Schule nennen sie ihr Denunziations-Programm, erfindungsreich waren sie halt noch nie.

Die Neutralität

 soll dann vermutlich anfangen bei historischen völkischen Idiotien wie etwa der Frankenkönig (und Sachsenschlächter) sei der erste „deutsche“ Kaiser gewesen und enden mit dem Ende des Lehrplanes in bezug auf Nazi-Diktatur und (natürlich, schon aus Eigeninteresse) Kritik an Rassismus aller Art. Erfindungsreicher allemal als AFD-Hetze ist etwa der Protestmodus der fzs gegen diesen Vorstoß. Siehe dazu das allgemeine Echo auf die AFD-Denunziantenkampagne, gewerkschaftliche Stellungnahme und weitere Informationen:


Schule unter Rechten: Das Klassenzimmer im Dienste des Kulturkampfes


„

Wie geht es in Sachsen-Anhalt bildungspolitisch weiter? Es lohnt ein Blick nach Spanien, in die Regionen, wo die rechtsextreme Vox mitregiert


Bildung ist in Spanien Ländersache, also der autonomen Regionen. 17 hat Spanien. In 4 davon regiert die rechtsextreme Vox als Juniorpartner in Koalition mit der rechten Partido Popular (PP). Und in Valencia unterstützen die Neofranquisten die Minderheitsregierung der PP. Das hat seinen Preis. Vox nutzt diese Stellung für ihren Kampf um kulturelle Hegemonie. Was wäre da besser geeignet als die Bildungspolitik? Allen voran geht es gegen Migranten und vor allem gegen islamische Migranten. Wo Vox mitregiert, wird es künftig nur nicht spezielle Menüs für „Schüler mit einem ärztlichen Attest über die Unverträglichkeit spezieller Lebensmittel“ bei der Schulspeisung geben, so ein Erlass aus Valencia, der so ähnlich auch in den anderen Regionen beschlossen wurde. Das heißt ganz konkret, ein Mittagstisch halal ist für muslimische Schüler und Schülerinnen nicht mehr auf dem Speiseplan. Wenn die Familien damit ein Problem haben, hilft nur noch der Griff zur Tupperdose. Doch damit nicht genug. Dort, wo seit Jahren vor allem für marokkanischstämmige Schüler und Schülerinnen Arabischunterricht sowie Klassen über die Kultur des Herkunftslands erteilt wird, hat Vox durchgesetzt, dass diese Klassen gestrichen werden. (…)


Kontrolle über die Inhalte, auch hier setzt Vox an. Bevor sie mitregierte, forderte sie einen sogenannten „Eltern-PIN“. So nannte die Partei ihr Ansinnen, den Familien das Recht einzuräumen, ihre Kinder aus dem Unterricht zu nehmen, wenn dort Themen wie Gleichstellung oder Toleranz gegenüber sexuellen Minderheiten oder die Aufarbeitung des Faschismus auf dem Programm standen. Jetzt gehen die Neofranquisten einen Schritt weiter. Sie wollen in Valencia den Unterricht in der Regionalsprache einschränken und haben die „ideologische Neutralität“ in einer geplanten Bildungsreform festgeschrieben. Im Unterricht und in außerschulischen Veranstaltungen soll die Schulleitung überwachen, was dort zur Sprache kommt, um die „Indoktrinierung der Kinder“ zu verhindern. Die Schulbehörde soll das Recht haben, Inspektoren in den Unterricht zu schicken und Kinder und Lehrer zu befragen. Es können dann „Sofortmaßnahmen“ ergriffen und Disziplinarverfahren eröffnet werden. „Dieses Gesetz pervertiert eindeutig den Geist dessen, was eine Schulaufsicht sein soll“, protestiert die Gewerkschaft STEPV, die im valencianischen Bildungswesen die Mehrheit stellt, in einer schriftlichen Erklärung. Das würde Lehrfreiheit verletzen und zu einer „Hexenjagd“ führen. Die Schulaufsicht, die eigentlich die Schulleitung unterstützen soll, werde zur „unterdrückenden und zensierenden Instanz“. (…)


Die Themenliste der Kampagne zur „Eltern-PIN“ lässt Schlimmes vermuten. „Es ist durchaus möglich, dass selbst Unterricht über die Gründe des Klimawandels als Indoktrinierung angesehen wird“, befürchtet STEPV.“

title: Bundesverfassungsgericht setzt Beugehaft aus: Antifaschistin Lina ist frei
content:
Bundesverfassungsgericht setzt Beugehaft aus: Antifaschistin Lina ist frei


Nach mehr als zweieinhalb Monaten endete die Erzwingungshaft gegen Lina per Gerichtsurteil: Am 23. September 2026 hob das Bundesverfassungsgericht die Beugehaft gegen die Antifaschistin mittels einer einstweiligen Anordnung vorläufig auf. Damit beendete das höchste Gericht die willkürliche sechsmonatige Freiheitsentziehung, mit der das Oberlandesgericht (

OLG

) Dresden die Aktivistin für ihre Aussageverweigerung bestraft hatte. In seiner Entscheidung verwies das Bundesverfassungsgericht auf den hohen Wert des Rechts, sich nicht selbst belasten zu müssen, weshalb Lina jetzt bis zur eigentlichen Entscheidung über die eingereichte Verfassungsbeschwerde frei ist.

Vorausgegangen war eine Vorladung als Zeugin im aktuellen Antifa-Großprozess vor dem

OLG

 Dresden am 30. Juni 2026. Lina hatte konsequent die Aussage verweigert und dabei auch auf die Möglichkeit verwiesen, sich selbst zu belasten. Noch vor Ort ließ das Oberlandesgericht (

OLG

) Dresden die Antifaschistin für sechs Monate in Beugehaft nehmen und schöpfte damit das maximal zulässige Höchstmaß der Freiheitsentziehung aus. Mit diesem „Ordnungsmittel“ sollen Zeug*innen genötigt werden, im Prozess die vom Gericht gewünschten Aussagen zu machen.

Bereits im Oktober 2025 hatte das Amtsgericht Dresden sechsmonatige Beugehaft gegen Lina verhängt, die jedoch nicht unmittelbar vollstreckt wurde. Gegen diese doppelte Nutzung des schweren Zwangsmittels war Linas Verteidigung juristisch vorgegangen, doch am 18. Juni 2026 hatte der Bundesgerichtshof (

BGH

) die erneute Verhängung bestätigt und damit den Weg für den inflationären Einsatz von Beugehaft geebnet. Erst die jetzige Beschwerde vor dem Bundesverfassungsgericht hatte Erfolg: Mit dem heutigen Beschluss erkannte der höchste deutsche Gerichtshof die grundlegende Bedeutung der Selbstbelastungsfreiheit an, also des Rechts, sich nicht selbst belasten zu müssen. Dieses Prinzip habe elementare Bedeutung für die Menschenwürde und die Rechtsstaatlichkeit. Deshalb wurde die Beugehaft bis zur endgültigen Entscheidung über die Verfassungsbeschwerde ausgesetzt.

Lina war nach mehrjähriger Untersuchungshaft am 31. Mai 2023 vom Oberlandesgericht Dresden wegen körperlicher Auseinandersetzungen mit Nazis und des staatlichen Konstrukts der „kriminellen Vereinigung“ zu fünf Jahren und drei Monaten Haft verurteilt worden. Dieser Prozess war der Auftakt zu weiteren Prozessen, unter denen das derzeitige Dresdner Antifa-Großverfahren im Mittelpunkt steht.

Mit der heutigen Entscheidung setzt das Bundesverfassungsgericht ein klares Signal gegen die inflationäre Nutzung der Beugehaft in den aktuellen Antifa-Prozessen. Gegen Antifaschist*innen kommt dieses sonst kaum angewendete Zwangsmittel in den letzten Monaten vermehrt zum Einsatz: Schon am 25. März war im Dresdner Antifa-Großkomplex ein Antifaschist, der gemeinsam mit Lina verurteilt worden war, als Zeuge vorgeladen. Weil auch er die Aussage verweigert hatte, wurde er ebenfalls direkt vor Ort in sechsmonatige Beugehaft genommen. Hingegen hatte Richter Joachim Kubista gegen aussageunwillige Nazi-Zeugen stets nur geringe Ordnungsgelder verhängt.

„Das heutige Urteil des Bundesverfassungsgerichts stellt unmissverständlich klar, dass Grundrechte und rechtsstaatliche Prinzipien wie das Recht, sich nicht selbst belasten zu müssen, auch für Antifaschist*innen gelten. Das Mittel der Freiheitsberaubung, um Zeug*innen zu Aussagen zu zwingen, muss jedoch prinzipiell aufgehoben werden“, erklärte Hartmut Brückner vom Bundesvorstand der Roten Hilfe e. V. „Wir freuen uns mit Lina, mit ihrer Familie und ihren Freund*innen und Genoss*innen, dass sie nach über zweieinhalbmonatiger Freiheitsberaubung nun wieder frei ist. Zugleich fordern wir die sofortige Freilassung des Antifaschisten, der bereits seit Ende März ebenfalls rechtswidrig in Beugehaft ist.“ Brückner schloss: „Die Ermittlungsverfahren, Schikanen und Inhaftierungen von Antifaschist*innen müssen enden. Schluss mit der Kriminalisierung – wir sind alle Antifa!“

 


bert


25.9.2026 - 08:48


Pressemitteilung


Das Bundesverfassungsgericht hat die Beugehaft gegen Lina vorläufig aufgehoben. Nach mehr als zweieinhalb Monaten kommt die Antifaschistin frei, bis über ihre Verfassungsbeschwerde entschieden ist. Zentral ist dabei das Recht, sich nicht selbst belasten zu müssen.

author: By Camilla Donzelli, Contributor
title: A Failed Reception System in Crete Turns People on the Move Into Political Targets
content:
Athanatoi, Greece — Residents of a small village in Northern Crete, near Herakleion, are fighting the Greek government’s plan to convert a disused factory into a reception center for people on the move, escalating a monthslong standoff that pits xenophobic backlash against an increasingly securitized European border regime. 


“We’re not staying silent. We’re not backing down. No to the camp.” The slogan, painted in red and black across a large banner, hangs from the gate of a factory facing the Candia-Mires state highway, near the village of Athanatoi in northern Crete. A few yards away, a second banner reads: “No camp — the people have a voice.”


A banner reading “We’re not staying silent. We’re not backing down. No to the camp,” hanging from the gate of a factory opposite the abandoned Skouloudis industrial complex. Photo contributed by Romanos Lioutas.


Across the road stands the disused Skouloudis industrial complex, recently identified by Greece’s Ministry of Migration and Asylum as a site to be converted into a reception center for migrants crossing the stretch of sea between Libya and Greece and landing on the island’s southern coast. Since Minister Thanos Plevris

announced

 the plan in mid-June 2026, Skouloudis has been at the center of a

bitter standoff

 between authorities and local communities.


The former Skouloudis industrial facility, seen from the Heraklion–Mires state highway. Photo contributed by Romanos Lioutas.


The choice of this industrial site, however, is only the latest development in a long and contested decision-making process that began in the summer of 2025, when

arrivals in Crete

 far outpaced those recorded along the Aegean route — the sea passage from Turkey to the Greek islands of Lesbos, Samos and Chios that has long been the country’s primary migration corridor — making the island Greece’s main point of entry.


Against a backdrop of chronic absence of adequate first-reception facilities on the island, the handling of landings has fallen to entirely

unsustainable emergency measures

.


The main temporary holding site in Heraklion remains the former psygeio — a Coast Guard cold-storage building in the port area. Meant to hold just 70 to 80 people, the site held more than 450 in the first months of 2026, forcing men, women and children to sleep on the floor.


The lack of adequate sanitation and ventilation created dire health conditions, while pressure to find an alternative mounted further as the Port Authority pursued legal action to clear the site. Faced with this infrastructural collapse, authorities found themselves forced to publicly propose a solution.


One of the rooms inside the temporary first-reception facility known as Psygeio, in the port of Heraklion, where people are held after their arrival. Photo contributed by Romanos Lioutas.


Locked Up and Criminalized: People on the Move Face a Broken System on Crete’s Shores


Between Delay and Denial 


In the summer of 2025, the government

announced

 the conversion of several military sites, but that announcement was followed by months of silence and effective inaction. Only in February 2026 did the Greek Parliament approve the opening of

two centers

, without specifying their location or how they would be built.


The first details came only months later: in Chania, authorities settled on retrofitting

Agya

, a former exhibition center already in use as a temporary reception facility; in Heraklion, the disused Skouloudis industrial plant was identified instead.


“These delays and constant changes of plan shouldn’t be read as political strategy, but as failure,” Michalis Markodimitrakis, a member of the Heraklion-based collective Thalassa of Solidarity and a researcher at the Hellenic Mediterranean University, told Unicorn Riot.


“Local communities and representatives of Crete’s tourism and cultural sector are pushing back hard, because they see the presence of migrants as damaging to the island’s image and a threat to their economic interests.”


Michalis Markodimitrakis, member of Thalassa of Solidarity collective


A side view of the former Skouloudis industrial facility, where adaptation works to accommodate people on the move have not yet begun. Photo contributed by Romanos Lioutas.


Back in July 2025, the day after the first announcement floated the opening of the centers, a network of tourism industry associations sent an

open letter

 to Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis and Migration and …

title: La répression continue : 8 nouvelles interpellations dans l'affaire Deranque
content:
La répression judiciaire sur les antifascistes lyonnais continue. Après quelques mois de silence, le travail de la Sous-direction anti-terroriste (

SDAT

), associée au dossier depuis le mois de mars a fini par payer et a mené à l'arrestation de 8 nouvelles personnes, dont 5 ont été mises en examen pour "association de malfaiteurs".


Entre le 17 et le 18 février, le parquet de Lyon et le procureur Thierry Dran avaient déjà fait arrêter 11 personnes sur la qualification lunaire d' «

 

homicide volontaire

 

», suivant complètement le narratif médiatique de l'extrême-droite. Quelques jours plus tard, on apprenait la confirmation par des témoins dans divers articles de presse que la bagarre de rue était en réalité un guet-apens raté mis en place par les fafs en coordination avec le collectif Némésis. Le 4 mars, 2 nouvelles personnes étaient interpellées par la Direction de la Criminalité Territoriale (

DCT

) dans le Rhône et dans l'Aube. Sur ces 13 premières interpellations, 9 personnes demeuraient mises en examen et incarcérée ce mois de septembre.


On apprend aujourd'hui dans le Progrès, qui cite carrément que ses sources viennent du torchon fasciste Boulevard Voltaire, que 8 nouvelles personnes ont été interpellées le jeudi 24 septembre. 5 personnes au total ont été mises en examen pour "associationde malfaiteur, 4 également pour "violences aggravées par trois circonstances (avec usage ou menace d'une arme, en réunion et en dissimulant volontairement tout ou partie du visage afin de ne pas être identifiées)". Trois ont été placées en détention provisoire et deux en contrôle judicaire.


L'affaire constitue une réelle aubaine pour la répression de s'acharner sur les milieux antifascistes dans un contexte de fascisation évident. Ces arrestations au compte-goutte, outre que de légitimer la fiction libérale de justice démocratique qui veillerait à éliminer les éléments "violents" du paysage républicain, ont clairement pour but de terroriser la mobilisation antifasciste et plus largement le mouvement social qui s'opposent à la vague réactionnaire nationale et internationale.


Continuons à garder la ligne et à faire front contre la répression qui touche ces camarades en leur apportant toute la solidarité possible, à l'intérieur des murs et à l'extérieur.


À jamais antifascistes.

author: David Swanson
title: Parliamentary Dialogue on Peace in Cameroon on the Occasion of International Peace Day 2026
content:
Africa, International Day of Peace, Nonviolent Activism

By Guy Feugap, World BEYOND War’s Africa Organizer, September 27, 2026

On the occasion of the International Day of Peace, celebrated on September 21, 2026, a parliamentary dialogue focused on peace, social cohesion, and the protection of populations was held in Cameroon at the invitation of the United Nations in Cameroon. The meeting, held at the National Assembly headquarters, brought together representatives from Parliament and the Government, civil society organizations, and various stakeholders and partners committed to promoting peace and combating gender-based violence, femicide, and infanticide. Cameroon, already mired in armed conflicts, is now characterized by growing insecurity for people in their daily lives. Unfortunately, institutions have proven unable to prevent and respond to the various forms of violence threatening the population.

The first session of the parliamentary dialogue, dedicated to Parliament’s role in promoting peace, focused on how the National Assembly, the Senate, and members of Parliament can use their constitutional functions and public leadership to contribute to a peaceful environment. Discussions focused in particular on inclusive dialogue, nonviolent political participation, prevention and early warning, accountability in political communication and information, as well as the protection and inclusion of women, youth, people with disabilities, and other vulnerable groups. Peaceful dispute resolution and dialogue were also identified as important elements of peacebuilding.

The second session was devoted to strengthening prevention and response to gender-based violence, femicide, and infanticide. Introduced by the Vice President of the National Assembly and the United Nations Advisor on Peace and Development, among others, the dialogue addressed these forms of violence as issues involving human rights, protection, justice, public health, governance, and peace. The discussions shed light on a troubling situation. The rise in certain forms of crime and violence is an additional cause for concern. Femicide and infanticide—including in places where women and children should be protected, such as homes and schools—illustrate the scale of the challenges facing Cameroonian society. Civil society reaffirmed its role in educating and raising awareness among the public, as well as in advocating for a legal framework to better prevent and punish these crimes. In this regard, World BEYOND War and WILPF Cameroon launched a letter-writing campaign addressed to the Prime Minister, Head of Government, to draw the authorities’ attention to the urgent need for strengthened action against femicides.

On the government’s side, it was noted that the process of drafting the bill on gender-based violence is at an advanced stage and that the text is nearly finalized. Parliamentary representatives, for their part, indicated that they are ready to review and vote on the bill as soon as it is officially submitted to them. This prospect was one of the key takeaways from the dialogue: the need to translate the concerns expressed by civil society and other stakeholders into concrete institutional and legislative measures. Beyond the adoption of a law, the discussions also highlighted the importance of a coordinated response encompassing prevention, reporting, referral of victims and survivors, protection, investigation, prosecution, justice, psychosocial support, and institutional coordination.

The parliamentary dialogue held on International Day of Peace 2026 thus brought together two dimensions that are often addressed separately: peacebuilding and the struggle against gender-based violence. For civil society organizations working on these issues, preventing femicides, infanticides, and other forms of violence is not merely a matter of justice or the protection of human rights. It also contributes to building a peaceful society, in which every person can live free from violence and where institutions fully assume their responsibility to protect. The organizations that participated in this session will continue to ensure that the commitments and discussions arising from this meeting are translated into concrete actions.

title: Saygı: Receiving support in one’s mother tongue is vital in combating violence against women
content:
In Turkey, femicides and cases of violence against women are increasing day by day, contrary to the rhetoric of those in power.


In Kurdistan, women are subjected to attacks not only by family members and people close to them, but also by state security forces, such as police officers and soldiers, as part of special warfare policies. These attacks, which result in the killing of women, have continued for many years as part of policies targeting the struggle of Kurdish women.


203 women killed in the first eight months of 2026


The fact that perpetrators of violence against women receive light sentences or no punishment at all, both in Turkey and Kurdistan, is increasingly paving the way for further violence. According to 2026 data from the We Will Stop Femicide Platform, 203 women were killed in the first eight months of 2026, while the deaths of 215 women were recorded as “suspicious.”


In Kurdistan, cases of violence against and the killing of women targeted by special warfare practices are also increasing day by day. According to data from the Amed Branch of the Human Rights Association (IHD), 38 women were killed in the first six months of 2026.


Attacks against women are carried out particularly by men described as those closest to them. In Kurdistan, however, women are also subjected to attacks by state security forces, including police officers and soldiers.


Pointing out that gender inequality lies at the root of violence against women, Selcan Saygı, an activist with the Free Women's Movement (Tevgera Jinên Azad, TJA), assessed the policies of extermination targeting women in comments to our agency.


Stating that traditional norms legitimizing male dominance and economic dependence must be considered among the factors behind attacks against women, Selcan Saygı continued: “Violence against women is not an isolated incident; fundamentally, it is rooted in gender inequality and imbalances of power. Its main causes include traditional stereotypes that subordinate women and legitimize male dominance, a perception of impunity arising from laws that remain only on paper, economic dependence resulting from women's exclusion from employment, and the failure to sufficiently internalize human rights awareness across all segments of society.”


Drawing attention to the situation in Kurdistan, Selcan Saygı noted that policies targeting women in the region should be understood as reflecting the state's attitude toward the women's struggle. She said: “Particularly in Kurdistan and in cities known for their political dynamics, this situation is exacerbated not only by general causes but also by factors specific to the region. In areas that have long been dominated by conflict and security-oriented policies, the erosion of social peace increases the overall tendency toward violence, and this is reflected more severely within the home.”


Saygı added: “Furthermore, restrictions on the activities of civil society organizations working for women's rights, or their closure, as well as the disabling of local support mechanisms such as women's counseling centers and shelters through trustee appointments, deprive women of places where they can seek help. Feudal structures in the region, pressure in the name of ‘honor,’ and high unemployment rates are other significant factors that intensify tensions within the home.”


Victims of violence must be able to seek help in their mother tongue


Addressing what needs to be done to counter policies of extermination targeting women, Saygı said: “There are concrete steps that need to be taken to address this problem, both at the national level and, in particular, in Kurdistan. First, local governments must be restructured with a women-centered perspective, and shelters and support centers must be expanded. The scope of activities of independent women's organizations and local initiatives must be broadened, and the necessary conditions must be created to enable them to work in coordination with state institutions.”


Saygı also emphasized that, particularly in Kurdistan, victims of violence must be able to seek help in their mother tongue, underlining that “especially in this region, it is of vital importance to establish mechanisms through which victims of violence can report incidents in their mother tongue and receive legal and psychological support. author: Equality Now
title: Mona Sinha, CEO of Equality Now, inducted into National Women’s Hall of Fame
content:
25th September 2026


Mona Sinha, CEO of Equality Now, inducted into National Women’s Hall of Fame


7 min read


Press Releases


North America


Global advocate for gender equality recognised for more than 40 years of strengthening women’s rights movements worldwide


ROCHESTER, NY- September 24, 2026 –


S. Mona Sinha

, Chief Executive Officer of international nonprofit organization

Equality Now

, was inducted this evening into the

National Women’s Hall of Fame

 at the George Eastman Museum in Rochester, New York.


Sinha becomes only the second South Asian inductee in the Hall’s history, recognized for transforming Equality Now into a global force for legal reform on behalf of women and girls. She joins a

2026 class of 11 women

 (5 Contemporary and 6 Historical) whose leadership and achievements have shaped American life, including Jackie Joyner-Kersee, Janet L. Yellen, Audre Lorde, Harriet Jacobs and Virginia Hall. The induction ranks among the highest honors given to American women, recognizing more than 40 years of Sinha’s leadership across gender equality, philanthropy, advocacy and social enterprise.  


At Equality Now, Sinha leads worldwide efforts to use the law to end discrimination and violence against women and girls, work that in 2025 alone helped secure 17 legal changes across nine countries, benefiting 69 million women and girls. That builds on more than three decades of impact: since its founding in 1992, Equality Now has helped reform 140 discriminatory laws worldwide. 


The urgency of this work remains profound. The

World Health Organization

estimates 840 million women have experienced partner or sexual violence in their lifetime, yet just 0.2 percent of global development aid in 2022 addressed violence against women, with funding falling further in 2025.


Sinha has also brought women’s rights stories to global audiences as an Executive Producer of the Academy Award-nominated documentary

To Kill a Tiger

, Netflix’s

Disclosure

 and the Tony Award-nominated play

What the Constitution Means to Me.


Founded in Seneca Falls, New York in 1969, the National Women’s Hall of Fame is the country’s first and oldest nonprofit organization and museum dedicated to honoring the achievements of distinguished American women. More than 300 women have been inducted since the first ceremony in 1973, including Susan B. Anthony, Harriet Tubman, Eleanor Roosevelt, Maya Angelou and Gloria Steinem. The Hall received over 400 nominations for its 2026 class, with candidates evaluated on the reach and significance of their impact, the importance of their accomplishments and the duration of their work. Sinha’s induction places her permanently alongside these icons in the record of American women’s achievement: a distinction rarely extended to global human rights leaders, and rarer still for a South Asian woman.


During the ceremony, Sinha reflected on a lesson that has guided her work across business, philanthropy and the global fight for women’s equality: 


“Power shared is power supercharged,” said S. Mona Sinha, CEO of Equality Now. “Open a door, invest in an idea, hand her the microphone and watch power grow through her. That is how power compounds.”


Sinha opened her induction speech with a childhood memory of her mother in Kolkata, who each morning set aside a fistful of rice for someone in greater need. This quiet ritual became a lasting lesson in generosity, responsibility and the cumulative power of everyday action.


“I don’t receive this extraordinary honor as mine alone,” Sinha continued. “I receive it as a fistful of rice, placed in my hands with a responsibility to pass it on.”


Beyond her role at Equality Now, Sinha serves on the boards of the Smithsonian American Women’s History Museum and Columbia University’s Tamer Institute for Social Enterprise. Her earlier honors include the Ellis Island Medal of Honor and a place on Forbes’ 50 Over 50: Impact list.


ABOUT EQUALITY NOW


Founded in 1992, Equality Now is an international human rights organization working to achieve legal and systemic change that addresses violence and discrimination against women and girls around the world. Working alongside local, national and regional partners, Equality Now combines legal expertise, advocacy and coalition-building to advance legal equality, end sexual violence and exploitation, and eliminate harmful practices. Since its founding, the organization has played a pivotal role in reforming 140 …

author: Jian Sanz
title: CLSU Student Regent red-tagged in latest attack on student leaders
content:
Image of packaged sent to Balllesteros (photo from CLSU USSC)

Central Luzon State University Student Regent (CLSU SR) Rashela Ballesteros received a package containing red-tagging messages around 12:30 pm on September 17 at the University Supreme Student Council (USSC) office.

The package, sent by a certain Jared Mariano from Guimba, Nueva Ecija, contained a red-tagging message formatted as a love letter, an altered photo showing Ballesteros’s face pasted onto a soldier’s body, and a list of requirements to become an officer in the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP). The letter in the package read, “Hope I’ll see your smile in campus.(sic)”

In a statement, Anakbayan CLSU condemned yet another harassment and red-tagging of Ballesteros, reiterating that incidents like these result in serious violations of students’ rights to security and freedom of expression.

“This is a threat not only to SR Ballesteros, but also to the democratic rights of the entire CLSU community. It is crucial to protect the freedom of students to voice their demands and participate in social issues, both inside and outside the university,” the youth organization added.

The organization also compared the tactic to the documented methods used by the AFP and National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC) against several student leaders in CLSU. They noted that this incident is a form of surveillance and harassment against Ballesteros, especially since this is reportedly not the first suspicious attempt to contact her.

Related story: Youth groups sound alarm over red-tagging, forced interrogation of student leader

Ballesteros also serves as the national convener of Network Opposed to Pax Silica (NO to Pax Silica), and convener of the Movement Against Destructive Solar Farms (MADSOLAR) and Save the Rice Granary (STRG).

The CLSU University Supreme Student Council (USSC) called the harassment an attack on the broader student masses of CLSU as well. They also noted that the package came months after Ballesteros stood against the continuous cases of surveillance, harassment, red-tagging, and intimidation suffered during the first week of classes in the university.

Since 2024, Ballesteros, fellow student activists and leaders Eyu Bartolome, Cairo Sandoval, and Loi Matias, have faced repeated red-tagging and harassment by military forces and the NTF-ELCAC. Notably, on June 12, 2026, two unidentified men approached CLSU employees to inquire about Ballesteros’s whereabouts.

CLSU USSC also emphasized that despite the university’s formation of a committee addressing red-tagging and attacks on CLSUans, attacks on student activists persist in the university. (RVO)

title: Comienza el juicio por el femicidio de Andrea Jara López
content:
A casi tres años del femicidio de Andrea, su pareja y único acusado, Arnaldo Meza llega detenido al juicio. El proceso se llevará adelante en los Tribunales de San Martín entre el 22 y el 25 de septiembre mediante la modalidad de juicio por jurados. Se espera que el viernes 25 se conozca la sentencia para el asesino.

Por Zorzal Diario.


Durante la tarde del jueves 6 de octubre de 2023 Andrea y su padre estaban rebozando milanesas para la cena de ese día. El olor a frito empezaba a inundar el comedor. Esa noche sería la semifinal de la Copa Libertadores donde se enfrentaban Boca Juniors y Palmeiras. Cerca de las diez de la noche, Arnaldo Meza llegó a la casa familiar donde él también vivía, con el objetivo de llevar a Andrea a ver el partido a la casa de un amigo, Albino Ramos López. 

 Andrea saludó a su papá y salió sin celular ni plata. 


Una vez en la casa de Albino, ubicada en la calle Solís entre Las Hortensias y Las Margaritas del mismo barrio, transcurrió todo el partido hasta la victoria del equipo brasilero. Cerca de la 01:16 de la madrugada, mientras Albino salía a buscar una pizza y antes de llegar a la vereda, se escuchó un disparo que venía desde su casa. 

Las últimas palabras de Andrea, mientras caía al suelo desvaneciéndose, fueron un murmullo: 

“¿Qué me pasa?”

.


Lo que siguió fue la simulación y el encubrimiento. La cargaron en un Citroën C3 gris y la llevaron al Hospital Bocalandro. Dejaron a Andrea agonizando en la guardia y se fueron, primero Meza, su pareja y después Albino quién esperó a que llegara la policía. 

La familia del agresor intentó engañar a la madre de Andrea diciéndole que su hija estaba internada por una apendicitis.


Cuando los padres de Andrea llegaron al hospital, los médicos les advirtieron que una joven había ingresado con una herida de bala en la cabeza y el rostro deformado por la hinchazón. Desorientados por la mentira de la familia de Meza, recorrieron otros hospitales con la esperanza de que Andrea estuviera bien.


Sin ningún resultado, decidieron ir hasta la casa de la familia de Meza dónde encontraron el auto gris bañado en sangre. Allí, la hermana del agresor confesó entre lágrimas: 

“Mi hermano tiene que pagar por lo que le hizo”

.

 De regreso al Bocalandro, la confirmación llegó del modo más doloroso: 

la reconocieron por el tatuaje en la piel que llevaba grabado el nombre de su hija, Z.

 Andrea falleció algunas horas después.


La habitación intacta


En la casa donde vivía Andrea todo sigue en su lugar. Las fotos en las paredes, la televisión, la ropa y el olor de su perfume. Sobre una mesa quedaron, prolijamente impresos, varias copias de su currículum vitae: 

Andrea Celeste Jara López tenía veinticuatro años

, la sonrisa luminosa y el deseo intacto de trabajar. “Quería ser modelo”, cuenta Patricia su mamá, pero sobre todas las cosas quería salir adelante junto a su hija, que entonces tenía 5 años. Había dejado todo listo para salir a repartir esos CVs en cuanto su madre regresara de un viaje. No llegó a hacerlo.


En la habitación familiar hay también una trama de duelos que se cruzan. 

Unos meses antes del crimen, la abuela de Andrea había fallecido. 

Según los preceptos de la cultura paraguaya de la que proviene la familia, es necesario deshacerse de ciertos objetos —como la cama del difunto— para que la muerte no vuelva a golpear a los seres queridos. Andrea, en cambio, pidió conservar esa cama. 

Cuando la niña, que hoy tiene ocho, extraña a su mamá, se hamaca con fuerza en el patio para acercarse al cielo, donde su mamá fue a cuidar a la abuelita.


El infierno antes del disparo


Arnaldo Meza no mató a Andrea de la nada.

 Durante meses desplegó sobre ella una red de violencia, aislamiento y sometimiento económico que en el barrio Costa Esperanza muchos conocían, pero que la familia de la joven fue reconstruyendo trágicamente en piezas después del crimen.


Meza era conocido en la zona por ser prestamista, comprar y vender armas y apretar a vecinos. 

En el terreno de la intimidad, le quitó el celular a Andrea, la obligó a dejar de trabajar y pasó a controlar el poco dinero que ella ingresaba. Incluso cuando él mismo no tenía dónde ir, la familia de Andrea le abrió la puerta de su hogar, le dio techo y comida sin sospechar la violencia sistemática que ejercía puertas adentro. Andrea callaba para no preocupar a sus padres; sus amigas, en cambio, le advertían que se separara de un hombre que ya tenía  denuncias previas por violencia de …

author: Bram Sable-Smith
title: Missouri’s Abortion Rights Face a Second Vote in Two Years
content:
Abortion returns to ballots in Missouri and other states as voters and lawmakers reshape post-Roe policies.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

After Missouri voters added abortion protections to the state constitution in 2024, Kelly McCoomb decided to keep her yard sign supporting the measure in the basement of her suburban St. Louis home.

Abortion access is important to McCoomb. She wants her daughter to grow up in a state where the option is available if needed, and the sign was a keepsake from the day Missourians voted to reverse the state’s near-total ban. McCoomb also couldn’t shake the feeling that she’d need to display the sign in her yard again soon.

“I have little faith in our Missouri government,” McCoomb said, sitting on her front porch.

Sure enough, just two years later, the state’s Republican-dominated legislature is asking Missouri voters to overturn the abortion protections they recently supported. The conflicting measures even have the same title: Amendment 3. But while a “yes” vote in 2024 supported adding protections to the state constitution, a “no” vote in 2026 would keep them. McCoomb covered the “YES” on her yard sign with a “NO” made from black duct tape before placing the sign back in her yard.

Voters will weigh in on abortion in Missouri, and three other states, in the November general election. Missouri is also one of two states voting on it for the second time since 2024. Nevada will vote again, too.

The spate of referendums comes after the U.S. Supreme Court overturned federal abortion protections with its 2022 decision in Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization, leaving each state to make its own abortion policy. The result has been a patchwork of state rules with varying degrees of bans or limitations, and even a series of “shield laws” in states where abortion remains legal that aim to protect providers from prosecution in states where it’s not.

“I just think there’s a constitutional crisis that’s coming,” said Kristi Hamrick, vice president of media and policy for the anti-abortion organization Students for Life Action.

“Can you have 50 state standards on whether or not a human being is a human being? Can you have 50 state standards on whether human beings have legal protection?” Hamrick said.

That patchwork of abortion protections is the reason Nevadans for Reproductive Freedom introduced the 2024 ballot measure to enshrine the state’s law allowing abortions up to 24 weeks after conception into the state constitution, said Denise Lopez, president of the coalition.

The measure received strong support two years ago, with 64% of voters in favor. Nevada law requires two majority votes to enshrine constitutional amendments, so voters will need to support the expanded protection again in November for it to be enacted.

The Nevada ballot measure wouldn’t change the state’s existing law allowing abortions up to 24 weeks after conception. But the proposal would make it more difficult to overturn abortion access, requiring voter approval of any new ban in two elections.

Lopez said Nevadans for Reproductive Freedom has been campaigning to ensure voters are still mobilized.

“Folks care about it,” she said. “They’re seeing what’s happening at the national level, and they want to make sure that whatever’s happening in our neighboring states, like Idaho and Utah, doesn’t happen here in Nevada.”

Idaho, where a ballot measure establishing abortion rights recently qualified to go before voters in November, has one of the strictest abortion bans in the country. Voters will decide whether state statute should allow abortion through fetal viability, the point when a fetus can survive after birth, which is generally considered to be around 24 weeks.

In Utah, abortion is allowed up to 18 weeks while legal challenges to the state’s ban continue.

In Virginia, where abortion is already allowed through two trimesters of pregnancy, until 28 weeks, voters will decide whether to amend their state constitution to codify those rights.

Missouri is the only state voting this year on removing abortion protections already on the books. The measure would repeal the 2024 amendment that guaranteed abortion access through fetal viability in the state and replace it with a ban on abortions with exceptions for medical emergencies, fetal anomalies, and pregnancies resulting from rape or incest. title: Aktivîsta LGBTÎ+yan Duru ku beriya Lûtkeya NATOyê hatibû girtin, serbest bû
content:
Xwendekara zanîngehê û aktivîsta LGBTÎ+yan Duru ku beriya Lûtkeya NATOyê di operasyonên li Enqereyê de di 23ê Hezîranê de hatibû desteserkirin û paşê jî hatibû girtin. Danişîna doza Duruyê duh (24ê Îlonê) pêk hat. Dadgehê biryara tehliyeya Duruyê da.  


Li gorî agahiyên ku UniKuirê ragihandine, Duru bi destê kelemçekirî anîn salona danişînê. Hevalên wê û parêzvanên mafan ên ku dixwestin danişînê bişopînin di korîdorê de hatin rawestandin.


Doza yekem a aktîvîsta LGBTİ+yan Duruyê di 24ê Îlonê de ye


18 Tebax 2026


Di dema danişînê de di salonê de polîsên biçek û bi ekîpman û wezîfedarên sivîl amade bûn. 


Daxuyaniyên çapemeniyê, cilûberg û weşan hatin pirsîn


Piştî parastina bersûcê/a din a/ê ku bi Duruyê re tê darizandin, dest bi îfadeya Duruyê hate kirin.


Dadwer ji Duruyê pirsî ku gelo têkiliya wê bi ti rêxistinê re heye an na, daxuyaniyên çapemeniyê yên ku tevlî bûye, pankart û nivîsên di dosyayê de, cilûbergên ku li xwe kirine û alên ku hilgirtine pirsîn.


Duruyê got ku ew tevlî daxuyaniyên çapemeniyê bûye lê bi rêya medyaya civakî û nûçeyan ji wan agahdar bûye û bi arastekirina ti rêxistinê tevnegeriya ye.


Operasyonên Lûtkeya NATOyê: Yildiz Tar, Emel Memiş û xwebexşên TEMAyê serbest bûn


22 Tîrmeh 2026


Duruyê li dijî nirxandina ku hin cilûberg "formaya" rêxistinê ne jî derket û got ku wî ti cilûbergên bi rêxistinê re têkildar li xwe nekirine.


Her weha Duruyê got: "Ez weşanên mixalif dixwînim. Yek ji wan jî kovara Yeni Demokrat Gençlik e. Min li qadê ew heval an jî ew ala dîtin û ez çûm ba wan."


"Têkiliyeke min a rêxistinî tune ye, em tenê heval in"


Dadwer ji Duruyê mala ku lê dimîne, kovar û rojnameyên di dema serdegirtina polîsan de li malê hatine dîtin û axaftinên ku bi hin kesan re kirine pirsîn.


Duruyê got ku ew di mala xwendekaran de dimîne, polîs beriya ku derfeta vekirina derî bidin wan ketine malê û weşanên li malê weşanên mixalif ên qanûnî ne ku ew wan dişopîne.


Duruyê diyar kir ku ew bi kesên di dosyayê de ne heval e û got: "Têkiliyeke min a rêxistinî tune ye, em tenê heval in."


Encamnameya Lûtkeya NATOyê hat weşandin


9 Tîrmeh 2026


Parêzeran daxwaza tehliyeyê kir


Parêzerên Duruyê diyar kirin ku lêpirsîn di çarçoveya desteserkirinên beriya Lûtkeya NATOyê de hatiye destpêkirin û daxwaza tehliyeya wê kirin.


Yek ji parêzeran diyar kir ku beriya Lûtkeya NATOyê nêzîkî 100 kesî bi awayekî "tedbîr" hatine girtin û got ku Duru di çarçoveya van lêpirsînan de kesê dawî ye ku girtî maye.


Parêzer da zanîn ku bişopandina fîzîkî û qeydên di dosyayê de di çarçoveya têkoşîna li dijî terorê de ti sûcekî nîşan nadin û bal kişand ser ku bersûc xwendekarên zanîngehê ne.


Dadgehê biryara tehliyeya Duruyê da. Darizandina Duruyê dê bê girtin berdewam bike.


Danişîn taloqî 7ê Kanûna Paşîna 2027an kirin.


(NÖ/AY)

Ολυμπιάδος 50 Άνω Πόλη

.
