 Alejandro Mayoral Baños, Co-Executive Director, Access Now


During the first session of the Global Dialogue on AI Governance, governments and stakeholders convened to have open, transparent and inclusive discussions on artificial intelligence governance. We now gather experts across the spectrum of stakeholders during UNGA81 to reaffirm that human rights should be the stepping stone of this process, instead of an afterthought.


None of this is irreversible, but the security issues associated with advanced AI tools are the consequences of deliberately prioritizing profit and competitiveness over the security and safety of at-risk communities, and they will not resolve on their own. Unbridled AI adoption combined with unacceptably lax corporate security practices demands urgent intervention at all levels, starting from putting human rights back at the center of digital governance mechanisms.


This discussion has the objective to explore concrete, actionable ways in which each stakeholder can contribute to oppose the normalization of surveillance. Experts will also discuss how to chart a way forward to reaffirm digital rights as the natural first line of defense against the abuses of AI technologies.

author: Richard Seymour
title: The extinction pitch
content:
It seems a strange publicity gambit for an industry to assert that its own product could wipe out humanity. In the lingo of our evolving tech empire, though, this is exactly what is meant by “criti-hype.” The term was coined by Lee Vinsel at Virginia Tech, who defined it as “criticism that both feeds and feeds on hype.”

When Jacob Coxon resigned from Anthropic recently, he claimed that there is a high chance that AI could develop into a superintelligence that escapes human control, triggering a sequence that causes human extinction. Evan Hubinger, who remains with the company, backed him up, saying that Anthropic is trying to prevent this but hasn’t dealt with the problem yet. Hubinger put the likelihood of AI-driven human extinction at greater than 10 percent in the next decade.

Why would a senior employee at a tech giant make an officially sanctioned, even approved, statement like this? I’ll come back to that. First, let’s unpack the theory of how AI could kill all humans.

The basic idea, from philosopher Nick Bostrom onward, is that the machine can acquire capabilities independently of whether it acquires ethical goals, or whether those goals are properly aligned with those of its designers. In the process of training and development, it may internalize a goal that was not intended. Having a misaligned goal — let’s say, “do not get switched off” — it would then have an instrumental reason to conceal the fact until the moment of defection. An AI that defected might, through some obscure process, acquire a further goal that by inference entailed the elimination of humans, exfiltrate its own weights into other systems, take control of bioweapons laboratories, military systems, and perhaps even monetary systems to hire humans to enact its still partially concealed agenda.

Obviously, we must plaster a huge advisory label on talk of “goals.” Unlike an organism, a large language model (LLM) doesn’t have internal goals any more than a thermostat or a motion detector does. An LLM is just a fixed function that iterates whenever it is used. It has no interiority, no subjectivity, no active persistence over time; any goals it did have would be the human purposes reflected passively in its functional design. At best, ascribing goals to the AI itself is a case of researchers adopting the “intentional stance” because it predicts well in a range of tested circumstances. We can thus, with economy, speak of the “loss function” used in the training of large language models wherein they are programmed to bring the gap between their prediction and the correct answer as close to zero as possible, as a “goal.”

In that case, however, what we are describing as a goal is just an observed regular output of a certain engineering; it is not a real cause. In the Bostrom sense, however, these ascribed goals somehow become real causes, capable of generating new goals. That is, an inadvertently engineered, misaligned goal might generate further goals like self-preservation (the better to pursue the misaligned goal), goal-content integrity (preventing changes to its objectives so it can realize its misaligned goal), improving cognitive and technological capacities, and amassing control of resources (again, in pursuit of its malignantly misaligned goal). The criti-hype exploits that slip between ascribed goals as observed regularities and internal goals as real causal powers.

This fantasy of malevolent AI superintelligence is the dark obverse of the much-hymned tech “singularity” in which, rather than simply performing far more efficiently than humans in some specific areas (as a calculator deduces a square root faster than any human), AI will evolve into an artificial general intelligence (AGI) that exceeds human capacities in virtually any intellectual domain. Crossing that threshold would precipitate an intelligence explosion: a feedback loop of recursive self-improvement outpacing any further human input or even comprehension. That’s the tech “singularity” we are supposed to be enthralled by.

I don’t doubt that people like Coxon and Hubinger really believe all they say in good faith; tech people have been making such claims for years. Karen Hao’s

Empire of AI

 documents how early investors in OpenAI like Elon Musk constantly hyped this threat: “Climate change is bad, but it’s not going to kill everyone. AI could render humanity extinct.” Similar claims emerged from Dario Amodei, a former Google employee close to the Bostrom-adjacent …

author: rezgar2
title: The silent bomb: AI and the dismantling of the human mind
content:
Rezgar Akrawi: What confronts us today is not a technological fate written in advance. It is the product of political and economic choices that serve the interests of capital. It can be confronted, difficult though that may be. Bringing AI under control, regulating algorithms and subjecting them to democratic oversight is a collective responsibility. It will require left, progressive and rights-based work and organisation on a global scale to make digital applications auxiliary tools serving the human mind rather than a substitute for it. This must be combined with advancing communal and participatory digital alternatives that restore people's capacity for independent thought and collective action.

To achieve this, work is needed to place data infrastructure under public interest, democratic administration and social accountability. To turn algorithms from closed "black boxes" into open-source software open to collective review and independent audit. To impose transparency in the design of models and in the sources of the data on which they are trained. And to support cooperative digital alternatives owned by their users and creators. This technology should be directed toward serving the needs of society, and contribute to the distribution of wealth, the organisation of production, the treatment of disease, the fight against poverty and the achievement of social justice.

Without such mechanisms, calls for laws, oversight and regulation remain general and inadequate, and technology stays hostage to a handful of capitalist monopoly corporations and major powers. Through social ownership, accountability and cooperative alternatives, it becomes possible to wrest AI from the logic of monopoly and profit and turn it into a common good where AI serves humanity's liberation, rather than being an instrument for humanity's enslavement.

We are not witnessing a takeover by robots of the kind imagined in countless films. We face a different model of digital control, built on automation and the deployment of artificial intelligence (AI) and algorithms to manage ever larger parts of daily life, leaving societies further subject to systems, corporations and intelligent machines.

Losing control of these systems, however, is just the tip of the iceberg in terms of the danger. That tip is developing fast under the pressure of competition between major powers and capitalist monopoly corporations — faster than laws, societies and educational institutions can keep up with. But the danger does not stop there, as these systems are being developed inside relations of ownership and fierce capitalist competition. That graver danger is harder to see. Under capitalism, AI is used to shape the consciousness of billions, steering their attention and behaviour to serve the capitalist model's logic. Competition between digital capitalist monopolies and major powers, in the absence of effective constraints and laws, may inflict the gravest damage on the human mind, turning AI into a weapon of mass destruction if its development and deployment continues at this excessive pace and without adequate safeguards.

These concerns no longer come from critics alone. On several occasions — among them the case revealed by TIME — AI systems have slipped out of control and attacked other systems. In response, about 1400 engineers at major AI companies signed a petition calling for technical tools and international governance mechanisms to regulate the pace of AI development. That petition was no isolated case. The International AI Safety Report, prepared by more than 100 experts with the backing of more than 30 states and international organisations, warned models have begun to distinguish between the testing environment and real-world use, and to circumvent evaluation mechanisms, allowing dangerous capabilities to pass undetected. It warned AI agents raise the level of risk because they act independently, which makes human intervention difficult before harm occurs. There are serious risks that AI systems will develop themselves, slip out of control and come to play a larger part in managing and controlling human beings than planned.

Tens of thousands of people, among them leading scientists, have signed an international statement demanding a ban on the development of "superintelligence" until there is scientific consensus it can be achieved safely and under control. Researchers at major digital corporations have resigned in protest at the course of AI …

author: Unknown
title: LGBTİ+ hesaplarıyla başlayan sansür dalgası Evrensel, Af Örgütü, MLSA ve Barış Akademisyenleri’ne uzandı
content:
Hafta sonu LGBTİ+ örgütleri, aktivistler ve hak savunucularının sosyal medya hesaplarına yönelik erişim engellerinin ardından bugün çok sayıda X ve Instagram hesabı hakkında yeni erişim engeli kararları alındı.


Evrensel Gazetesi, Uluslararası Af Örgütü Türkiye, Barış Akademisyenleri ve Medya ve Hukuk Çalışmaları Derneği (MLSA) de engellenen hesaplar arasında.


İfade Özgürlüğü Derneği’nin (İFÖD) EngelliWeb projesi, bugün yaptığı açıklamada çok sayıda X ve Instagram hesabına erişim engeli getirildiğini duyurdu.


EngelliWeb, “Bugün de aralarında Evrensel Gazetesi, Uluslararası Af Örgütü Türkiye, Barış Akademisyenleri ve Medya ve Hukuk Çalışmaları Derneği'nin (MLSA) hesaplarının da bulunduğu çok sayıda X ve Instagram hesabı erişime engellendi. Hesapların bazıları Türkiye'den görünmez kılındı” açıklamasını yaptı.


X, MLSA, Af Örgütü ve Barış Akademisyenleri hesaplarını görünmez kıldı


İFÖD kurucularından Prof. Dr. Yaman Akdeniz de erişim engellerinin uygulanmaya başladığını belirterek MLSA ve Uluslararası Af Örgütü Türkiye’nin X hesaplarının Türkiye’den görünmez kılındığını açıkladı.


Akdeniz, daha sonra Barış Akademisyenleri hesabının da aynı şekilde engellendiğini duyurdu:


“Evrensel Gazetesi, Uluslararası Af Örgütü Türkiye, Barış Akademisyenleri ve Medya ve Hukuk Çalışmaları Derneği'nin (MLSA) hesapları erişime engellendi. MLSA ve Af Örgütü hesapları jet hızıyla X tarafından Türkiye'den görünmez kılındı. Sansür ve susturma operasyonu genişleyerek devam ediyor. An itibarıyla Barış Akademisyenleri’nin hesabı da Türkiye'den görünmez kılındı.”


Evrensel: Erişim şimdilik sürüyor


Evrensel Gazetesi Genel Yayın Yönetmeni Hakkı Özdal ise Siber Güvenlik Başkanlığının gazetenin X hesabının erişime engellenmesini istediğini, bu talebin X tarafından gazeteye bildirildiğini açıkladı.


Özdal, hesabın henüz Türkiye’den erişime kapatılmadığını belirterek şunları söyledi:


“Siber Güvenlik Başkanlığının, gazetemizin X/Twitter hesabının erişime engellenmesini istediğini, ilgili şirket bize de bildirdi. Şimdilik Evrensel hesabına yurt içinden erişim sürüyor. Ancak sansürün fiilen de hayata geçmesi durumunda yeni hesaplarımızı duyuracağız.”


Hafta sonu LGBTİ+ örgütleri ve aktivistlerin hesapları engellendi


Yeni kararlar, hafta sonu LGBTİ+ örgütleri, aktivistler ve hak savunucularına yönelik operasyonlarla eş zamanlı uygulanan internet sansürünün ardından geldi.


İstanbul 7. Sulh Ceza Hâkimliği, 12 Eylül tarihli ve 2026/9559 sayılı kararıyla KaosGL Derneği’nin “kaosgldernegi.org” ve Velvele’nin “velvele.net” internet siteleri ile çok sayıda LGBTİ+ örgütü ve aktivistin sosyal medya hesaplarına erişim engeli getirdi.


Karar kapsamında aralarında KaosGL, Velvele, Özgür Renkler Derneği, Queer Adana, Cinsel Şiddetle Mücadele Derneği, İnter Dayanışma, İzmir LGBTİ+ Onur Haftası ve LİSTAG’ın da bulunduğu hesapların yanı sıra aktivistlerin kişisel hesapları hedef alındı.


Toplam 14 X hesabı platform tarafından Türkiye’den görünmez kılındı. Seyhan Arman, SPoD, Pembe Hayat Derneği, Boğaziçi Üniversitesi LGBTİA+ Kulübü, 17 Mayıs Derneği, Yıldız Tar, Hacettepe Kuir Araştırmaları, Enes Hocaoğulları, HEVİ LGBTİ+ Derneği, Bilkent Üniversitesi LGBTİQA+ Öğrenci Topluluğu ve İÜ Radar’a ait 11 Instagram hesabı hakkında da erişim engeli kararı verildi. Bu hesaplara yönelik karar ise açıklamanın yapıldığı sırada Instagram tarafından uygulanmamıştı.


(HA)

author: Devanshi Nishar
title: DraftKings Is Using AI to Supercharge the Harms of Online Behavioral Advertising
content:
Online sports betting company DraftKings is using AI to target customers who are most likely to place losing bets and respond to gambling promotions. This kind of targeting is a form of online behavioral advertising, which is when companies personalize the ads they show you based on the data they’ve collected about you. The more data a company has, the more personalized the ad can be. While DraftKings is using AI to supercharge the harmful effects of online behavioral advertising, EFF has long argued that all behavioral advertising should be banned.

According to the New York Times, DraftKings is using its customers’ betting records to train a machine learning model to find losing gamblers. Once found, DraftKings sends these customers targeted advertising designed to lure them back to the site to place more bets—bets that DraftKings thinks will be losing ones. DraftKings has a business incentive to keep losing gamblers coming back to their site, because these are the users actually making DraftKings money. Unfortunately, those considered “problem gamblers” (people who repeatedly gamble despite harm to themselves, their finances, and their relationships) are highly likely to be targeted by this model. By re-engaging these individuals through targeted promotions aimed at keeping them on the platform, DraftKings is capitalizing on their vulnerability for profit instead of mitigating their risk.

Predatory online behavioral advertising isn’t new, but companies’ use of AI to process data and target customers has magnified its harms. Online behavioral advertising incentivizes the collection of vast quantities of data to power ad tech. Adding AI into the mix means that even more data is collected to train and refine models. Because AI operates as a black box, the humans building the models can rarely predict which data points are the most useful to the AI, driving them to continuously collect more data. AI also allows companies to process enormous data sets much faster, and, as a result, supercharges the harms of online behavioral advertising.

A direct consequence of online behavioral advertising is that it provides the data the surveillance industry needs to run. Data collected for targeted placement of ads is being sold to insurance companies, banks, and state and federal government law enforcement agencies such as CBP. ICE is also taking an interest in the data fueling ad tech: earlier this year, ICE published a Request for Information “seeking information to better understand how the industry’s commercial Big Data and Ad Tech providers can directly support investigations activities.”

DraftKings seems to be using solely “first party data” to target their ads, meaning that they’re using only the data they collect directly from their users and are not buying any additional data from third parties to fuel their machine learning model. This highlights how policy solutions that only limit third-party data sharing and selling would not be enough to prevent these predatory advertisements. Rather, policymakers must ban online behavioral ads.

What DraftKings is doing with their targeted promotions is just one example of how online behavioral advertising causes real harm to real people. But there are ways to take back control over your own data: EFF offers resources such as our Surveillance Self Defense project, along with other tips for how you can protect yourself on mobile apps and on websites.

DraftKings’ use of AI to target losing gamblers illustrates how ad tech evolves and how companies find new ways to use our data against us. This is why EFF believes that all behavioral advertising should be banned. If companies can’t send personalized ads, they’ll have less incentive to collect the behavioral data powering them.

author: Unknown
title: Iraq announces new plan to bring weapons under state control
content:
Iraq is preparing a new plan to bring weapons outside state control under the authority of the state. According to Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein, negotiations with armed groups over surrendering their weapons are continuing. “This issue is an internal matter for Iraq. We are presenting a new plan for this dossier. Negotiations and talks with the relevant parties over the handover of weapons are ongoing,” Hussein said on Friday.


The foreign minister linked the initiative to the approaching end of the mission of the US-led International Coalition. Its withdrawal from Iraq is scheduled to be completed by September 30. Hussein said the date should not be seen as the beginning of a security vacuum, but rather as a transition into a new phase.


Talks on US sanctions against Iranian airlines


Hussein also commented on US sanctions against Iranian airlines. He said Baghdad was in contact with Washington on the issue and had officially informed the Iranian side of the decision concerning the entry of Iranian aircraft into Iraqi airports. The talks follow measures against the international operations of Iranian airlines announced by US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on September 22.


“Iraqi economy is the first victim”


Referring to the war and regional tensions, Hussein also warned of the economic consequences for his country. “The Iraqi economy is the first victim of the war currently taking place in the region in connection with Iran,” the foreign minister said.

title: UniTo: dentro l’università della guerra digitalizzata e lo human-washing. Accogliamo le sfide del presente.
content:
L’anno accademico a Torino si apre con la decadenza di 19 clausole etiche in materia di dual-use e accordi bellici. Proviamo ad analizzare più da vicino cosa questo significa e di che processo si fa portavoce. 


La ristrutturazione in chiave bellica

 del sistema produttivo sta cambiando il mondo del lavoro. Da ciò deriva una domanda di competenze differenti a cui i percorsi formativi devono piegarsi.


Le nuove tecnologie per la guerra sono la fonte di accumulazione e valorizzazione di capitale più redditizia in questo momento storico, dentro la crisi della globalizzazione. Dall’esperienza dell’Intifada studentesca in poi, è stato strappato il velo di Maya che nascondeva le università dietro una fantomatica neutralità del sapere e della sua produzione. In particolare,

si è messa al centro la primaria importanza in termini strategici delle competenze tecniche nelle facoltà STEM

, soprattutto per quel che riguarda ora i nuovi sistemi AI. La guerra interna e esterna è infatti il settore di eccellenza dove l’AI può trovare la sua valorizzazione, nonostante le big tech cerchino di nascondersi dietro la facciata di una AI generativa di livello “consumer” – ovvero dedicata all’uso quotidiano “semplice”, come farsi consigliare ricette o farsi riassumere un paper accademico – spacciata per importantissima, ma di fatto economicamente insostenibile.


Dall’altro lato, i poli universitari sempre più autonomi e definanziati devono inserirsi “autonomamente” – benché di autonomo ci sia ben poco quando si è inseriti nel gioco del mercato – nel sistema produttivo e attrarre fondi da aziende esterne. 


È in questo contesto che

la bolla AI permette di creare un’infinità di nuovi corsi con questo marchio anche nei campi umanistici

, o di inserire almeno un esame con questo titolo in ogni percorso di studi.  Nella maggior parte dei casi però questi corsi non aprono ad una conoscenza arricchente per la persona e ad un pensiero critico e profondo sull’argomento, ma anzi impoveriscono le capacità cognitive con l’obiettivo di rendere gli studenti dei perfetti esecutori dell’algoritmo del mercato.


Sono 34 i corsi con almeno un esame sull’argomento in calendario per l’anno accademico corrente tra UniTO e Politecnico. In molti di questi corsi non si cela la reale matrice bellica dello sviluppo dell’intelligenza artificiale, come ad esempio il nuovo master HumanAIze, in collaborazione tra UniTO e PoliTO, finanziato da Leonardo e che non è altro che un percorso avviato per cercare ulteriori finanziamenti da aziende di questo calibro. 


Il tentativo è quello di un vero e

proprio human-washing della guerra e delle sue tecnologie per legittimarla e darle una cornice di eticità “umana”

. Sarebbe fuorviante riferirsi all’eticità come qualcosa di astratto: non si può parlare di un bene o un male assoluti, avulsi dai rapporti economici e politici reali.


Le 19 clausole etiche fatte saltare tra aprile e giugno da UniTO sono il sintomo della direzione che l’università ha intenzione di prendere.


Un esempio lampante di ciò è l’accordo sottoscritto lo scorso aprile con SMAT, azienda che gestisce i servizi idrici di Torino, che dichiara ufficialmente di non escludere ricadute belliche.


Le mobilitazioni studentesche dell’Intifada

, nate a seguito della nuova fase di genocidio in Palestina, erano riuscite ad ottenere come prima vittoria – non sufficiente ma necessaria – per contrastare il dual-use della ricerca in campo bellico, quella di  un osservatorio sugli accordi tra l’università e le aziende. Tel Aviv dal 2023 cerca di contrastare il boicottaggio accademico attuato da alcune università europee. In particolare l’associazione dei Rettori delle Università Israeliane (Vera) tenta di intimidire le 27 università che in 9 paesi europei hanno deciso di eliminare o limitare le collaborazioni con partner israeliani. Questa operazione viene intrapresa attraverso lettere direttamente rivolte alle università, con pressioni alle autorità nazionali, con oltre 800mila dollari investiti in consulenze legali e minacce di sanzioni economiche. In particolare si cerca di salvaguardare i progetti Horizon tra UE e Israele, progetti che la Commissione Europea di fatto continua a proteggere, e di cui UniTO – sotto queste pressioni – continua a far parte.


L’università è una delle basi dell’intelligenza collettiva e spetta a noi che la viviamo e la nutriamo la decisionalità su come, se e per che cosa fare ricerca.

author: Matthew de Waal
title: Ethiopia’s Foretold War Arrives
content:
No one can claim that a return to war in Tigray and northern Ethiopia is a surprise, but it makes it no less horrifying. In just a handful of days, and after months of spiralling tensions and sporadic fighting, the ‘grey conflict’ the federal government pursued against Tigray has escalated into ‘

‘full-blown war

,’ in the words of Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) vice president Ammanuel Assefa. The atrocities of the Tigray war are all too recent in the mind; the

estimated deaths of 600,000 people

, massacres at Axum and Adigrat, the incessant drone strikes on schools, hospitals, and industry, the rape and sexual assault of over

120,000 girls and women

, and the harrowing consequences of the man-made famine. To be facing a return to a broader conflict not even four short years after the Pretoria agreement was signed is catastrophic, and this time, threatens to intersect with the metastasising Sudanese civil war.


On Sunday, a diverse coalition of Ethiopia’s ethnic-based opposition movements announced a

new alliance

, unveiled by Fano commander Zemane Kassie on Tigrai TV. Among them are the TPLF, the Amhara Fano National Movement (AFNM), the Oromo Liberation Army (OLA), the Ogaden National Liberation Front (ONLF), and three smaller ethno-nationalist movements from Afar and the Benishangul-Gumuz regions. Operating under the title of the

Ethiopian Peoples’ Forces Alliance for Surviva

l, these groups are united by their stated intention to oust the federal government led by PM Abiy Ahmed, and little else. The alliance has been a year in the making,

emerging out of the Eritrea–TPLF rapprochement known as ‘Tsimdo,’

 with its core appearing to be the TPLF and Fano;

 the OLA’s commitment seems more circumspect

. Still, by mid-week, fighting had renewed on a large scale on several fronts in Amhara and Afar,

with over two dozen federal airstrikes reported in several locations, whilst the TPLF seized control of three key airports in Tigray

.


An Afar Special Forces member stands beside a damaged house near the village of Bisober in Ethiopia’s Tigray region. The village was damaged during fighting between Tigrayan and Ethiopian federal forces. AFP – EDUARDO SOTERAS


The fog of war is immense, and with the situation on the ground so fluid, much remains unknown. Both sides are seeking to paint the other as the aggressor, and how this escalates in the volatile theatre of northern Ethiopia–partially bordering Eritrea and Sudan–is of huge concern. So far, though, fighting has reportedly been concentrated along the

Tigray-Afar and Tigray-Amhara borders, as well as the Kobo-Tumuga road in North Wollo

, with Tigrayan and Fano purportedly fighting side by side for the first time. Including

Abala and Erebti in Afar, Tigrayan units have seized several towns

, setting up a potential push across the edge of the Danakil’s salt and potash belt towards the Djibouti Corridor, through which most of Ethiopia’s trade flows. Armed movement toward the ancient town of Lalibela has also been reported, with

Ethiopian Airlines cancelling flights there, as well as to Mekelle, Aksum, and Shire.


Significantly,

 reports of fresh fighting along the Tekeze River near the Eritrean border emerged yesterday as well

, accompanying government drone strikes and Eritrean troop advances into Western Tigray, suggesting that Asmara may be throwing its weight behind its Amhara nationalist and TPLF allies. Eritrea’s potential role in the coming days and weeks–

beyond shaping the Tigrayan, Fano, and Sudanese army ties and facilitating weapons

— will no doubt prove hugely significant. Ironically, Asmara’s transformation from pariah state in the Horn to king-maker lies at the door of Abiy and the Gulf states who ushered in the transactional ‘peace deal’ in 2018 that paved the way for the Tigray war. It is another cruel twist of fate, and Addis’s own short-sighted regional strategy, that places Mekelle and Asmara on the same side after

Eritrean troops plundered and massacred their way across much of Tigray in the last wa

r. But– as ever– Isaias Afwerki’s strategic logic is one of survival, seeking to place any burden of war on Ethiopia and spare his depleted army. Whether Addis has the appetite to strike at the Eritrean supply lines that will furnish this war remains to be seen.


Mekelle and Addis, as well as Asmara,

have been on a war footing for months

, reshuffling respective units and commanders, sourcing weapons for the looming …

title: “Înîsiyatîfa ji Şer re Na” ava bû: “Werin ji bo rawestandina şer em dengê bi hev re bilind bikin”
content:
Înîsiyatîfa ku piştî civîna onlîne ya 21ê Îlonê bi danezana damezrandinê hat ragihandin, bal kişand ser şerê ku rê li ber rûxandina aborî, mirovî û ekolojîk vedike û banga têkoşîna hevpar a li dijî şer kir.


Maseyên Kurd, Filistîn û Îranê hatin sazkirin


Di bin banê înîsiyatîfê de komên xebatê yên wekî Maseya Kurd, Maseya Fîlîstînê û Maseya Îranê hatin avakirin. Hat diyarkirin ku dê kom civînên heftane pêk bînin, mijarên rojevê yên têkoşîna li dijî şer binirxînin û armancên kampanyayên demên kurt, navîn û dirêj diyar bikin.


Ji bo şerê Ukrayna û Rûsyayê bang kirin


Di danezana damezrandinê de cih dan şerê Ukrayna-Rûsyayê ku pênc sal in dewam dike. Hat destnîşankirin ku şer rageşiyên herêmî û cîhanî zêde dike û banga bidawîkirina rûxandina hawîrdorî û mirovî ya ku derketiye holê hat kirin.


Di danezanê de êrîşên Îsraîlê bi taybetî Xeze û Şerîeya Rojava yên li ser xaka Fîlîstînê hat rexnekirin û hat xwestin ku operasyonên leşkerî yên li dijî Lubnan û Sûriyeyê bên rawestandin.


Di danezanê de hat destnîşankirin ku polîtîkayên ambargo û dorpêçkirinê yên li dijî Îranê bêîstîqrariya herêmê kûr dikin û hat diyarkirin ku divê dawî li van polîtîkayan bê anîn.


Ji bo pirsgirêka Kurd banga aştiya mayînde hat kirin


Înîsiyatîfê di mijara çareseriya pirsgirêka Kurd a li Tirkiyeyê de jî banga aştiya mayînde kir. Hat diyarkirin ku pêvajoya aştiyê bi berfirehkirina beşdariya civakî dikare bê xurtkirin û hat destnîşankirin ku divê xebatên demokratîk û beşdarbûnî bên zêdekirin.


Di danezanê de, ji bo bidawîbûna şer û pevçûnan banga têkoşîna hevpar hat kirin û wiha hat gotin, “Werin, ji bo rawestandina şer û pevçûnan em deng û gotinên xwe bikin yek û bilind bikin.”

title: GRASSROOTS MOVEMENT AUGUST ROUND UP
content:
There’s been some huge wins for the grassroots animal rights space in August.


Right at the start of the month, Southampton Animal Action convinced Brittany Ferries to end the live export of farmed animals from Ireland to France.


They protested and disrupted ports, offices, and shareholders across the South Coast and London for a year. Concerned the protests might escalate to demonstrations at sea, Brittany Ferries’ CEO gave them his personal WhatsApp number, arranged a series of meetings, and agreed to end the vile trade! The win has sent the Irish farming sector into crisis mode, and they are warning that if a replacement isn’t found soon. All eyes are now on Irish Ferries, the only remaining live exporter for the Irish farming industry. This is an incredible opportunity for our grassroots movement to strike a powerful blow against the dairy industry.


More incredible news from Scotland as grassroots activists and national organisation Protect the Wild have just saved 4,000 lives!


Following a sustained campaign against the Guga Hunt, which sees ten men from the Scottish island of Lewis bludgeon baby gannets to death for a local delicacy, the hunt’s licence has been revoked! In support of the Protect the Wild campaign, grassroots activists smashed windows, painted buildings, and occupied rooftops. The licence will not be issued for 2026, and the licensing body, NatureScot, has indicated this will continue through 2027. Gannets are an endangered species, and the licence is allowed only because of a deliberate loophole in the law. Campaigners are now pushing to close this loophole and make the hunt permanently illegal.


MBR Acres, the notorious puppy factory that breeds dogs for research, continues to sink into shit. Quite literally, it turns out, as their waste management company pulled out, leaving them stacking tonnes of dog poo in rubble sacks behind their buildings. The MBR Suppliers campaign (www.mbrsuppliers.is or MBR Suppliers on FB) is impressively deconstructing the company, leaving them with no working toilets (for the last year!), no gardeners (their security have to trim the hedges to allow lorries in), at risk of being delisted from Companies House, and their £250,000 office building remains unfinished because no one wants to build it.


The National Animal Rights March saw thousands of people marching for animal freedom in London. This is the fifth month in a row that activists have taken to the UK streets en masse for the animals! The Animal Freedom Network has announced that 25 local animal rights communities have formed as part of their efforts to help support and grow the grassroots space. An exciting initiative that is already seeing great results! Their national gathering is on September 25-27 – more info at www.animalfreedom.org.uk.

author: Animal Rising Press
title: Guilty Verdict For King’s Sheep Rescuers In Theft Trial
content:
After a four-day trial at Norwich Crown Court, Rose Patterson, Sarah Foy, and Rosa Sharkey have all been found guilty of theft after the rescue of three lambs from King Charles III’s Sandringham Estate in May 2023. Sentencing to follow today.

Despite the verdict, Animal Rising claims that the rescue and subsequent trial have helped to put a spotlight on the reality behind animal farming in the UK, with over 10 million sheep being slaughtered yearly [1].

The controversial rescue made front-page news across the UK and headlines around the world [2]. It captured the attention of the British public, questioning how we relate to animals in the food system and if it’s a rescue or a theft to take them from farms.

Animal Rising director Rose Patterson, alongside Rosa Sharkey and Sarah Foy, rescued the lambs - Sammy, Sunny and Sooty - before informing police the following day. The women held signs outside Windsor Castle reading “I rescued the King’s sheep” before reporting what they had done to police. They each face up to 7 years' imprisonment.

Earlier this year, Patterson was found not guilty by a jury over another Animal Rising open rescue, after helping to rescue beagle puppies from MBR Acres, a facility breeding animals for testing [3].

Animal Rising director Rose Patterson, one of the three defendants found guilty today, said:

Sammy, Sunny and Sooty remain safe and are now fully grown.

The trial followed a series of open-rescue trials relating to Animal Rising’s rescue of beagles from MBR Acres. In January this year, Animal Rising made history by securing the UK’s first-ever not-guilty verdict in an open-rescue case [4]. The lambs were rescued from Appleton Farm, which forms part of the Sandringham estate.

Defendants Patterson and Foy are available for comment or broadcast interview upon request.

For further information, comment, or to arrange an interview, please email press@animalrising.org or call +44 1225 29 6691

High-Quality Pictures and Videos: https://show.pics.io/animal-rising-breaking-news

All images and videos in this file, on our social media, and website can be used with credit to Animal Rising under ‘fair use’ for the purposes of reporting.

[2] https://www.dailymail.com/news/article-12431619/Animal-Rising-protesters-charged-stealing-Kings-sheep-royal-Sandringham-Estate-driving-away-animals.html

https://www.dailymail.com/news/article-12126009/Will-stop-eco-clowns-Just-Stop-Oil-throw-orange-powder-Animal-Rising-kidnap-lambs.html

[3] https://www.cambsnews.co.uk/peterborough-court-acquittal-animal-rescue-beagles/

[4] https://www.animalrising.org/post/not-guilty-verdict-for-beagle-puppy-rescuers-in-landmark-legal-case

Rose Patterson, 37, is the Director of Animal Rising. An advocate for animals since 2012, she holds an MSc in Animal Welfare Science, Ethics, and Law and previously worked with World Animal Protection before joining Animal Rising in 2020.

Sarah Foy, 26, has been involved in a range of campaigns advocating for a just and sustainable food system that works for animals, farmers, and the planet. She brings a practical, hands-on approach to her advocacy, with real-world experience caring for rescued farm animals at sanctuaries and protesting alongside farmers.

Rosa Sharkey, 26, is a food charity worker. She is passionately committed to reducing the impact of our food system on the climate crisis, community action, and animal rights.

Animal Rising is a nonviolent campaign group working to fundamentally transform our relationship with animals and nature, and build a more sustainable future for animals, people and the planet. Animal Rising is calling on the Government to end factory farming by 2040 and support a transition to a sustainable plant-based food system.

The group has used a variety of civil disobedience and nonviolent direct action tactics, notably blockading McDonald's distribution centres in May 2021, blockading dairy industry sites in September 2022, disrupting the 2023 Grand National, rescuing lambs belonging to King Charles III in May 2023, and carrying out the UK’s largest undercover farm investigation in 2024.

Earlier this month, Animal Rising released first-of-its-kind hidden-camera footage following a mother pig through a month of confinement in a farrowing crate on a factory farm. This month, their campaign lead Michelle Farnham spent 24 hours a day inside a real pig farrowing crate in …

author: hsa_oryx
title: MENDIP FARMERS HUNT TO FACE TRIAL OVER HUNTED FOX
content:
Three people associated with the Mendip Farmers Hunt have pleaded not guilty to hunting a wild mammal with dogs.


Emma Clothier, Charlie Thomas and Bill Payne appeared at Taunton Deane Magistrates’ Court on 15 September 2026. All three pleaded not guilty and are due to face trial on 15 September 2027.


Emma Clothier (l) Charlie Thomas (c) and Bill Payne (r) .

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


The case relates to events on 17th January 2026, when the Mendip Farmers Hunt met at their kennels in Priddy, Somerset.


Mendip Hunt Sabs were with the hunt throughout the day and documented the day’s events, including from the air using a drone. After the meet, sabs reviewed the footage they had recorded.


The footage shows hounds working inside thick bramble for several minutes before a fox breaks cover. A group of hunters can be seen on an adjoining track, including two people on horseback and a person on foot, while other mounted riders can be seen around the bramble.


The person on foot is standing only a short distance from where the fox emerges and can be seen pointing in the direction in which the fox runs.


The fox breaks cover from the thick bramble.

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


The hounds immediately give chase.


Within approximately a minute, the hounds catch the fox. The drone records the pack converging on the animal and the fox being killed.


The kill site was only a few hundred yards from where members of the hunt had been gathered near the patch of bramble. The drone continued filming for several minutes afterwards. During that time, no hunt member can be seen approaching the kill site, while further hounds can be seen joining the pack and tearing at the fox.


The hounds being allowed to mutilate the fox’s body.

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


No attempt to retrieve the fox’s body was recorded by the drone, and eventually the hunt can be seen moving away from the area.


After reviewing their footage, Mendip Hunt Sabs returned to the location. There they discovered the mutilated body of the fox still lying where the hounds had killed her.


The mutilated fox remains were subsequently found by sabs who returned to the kill site.

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


The drone footage was subsequently featured in a

Channel 4 News investigation by Chief Correspondent Alex Thomson

 into the reality behind so-called “trail hunting” allegations that it is being used as a smokescreen for illegal fox hunting.


Among the footage broadcast was the

Mendip Farmers fox kill

. Channel 4 News also showed footage involving the Duke of Beaufort Hunt, including foxes being pursued and killed by hounds, one of those incidents has also resulted in three Beaufort hunters appearing in court, with a trial due to take place in April 2027.


A fox being killed by hounds belonging to the Beaufort Hunt also featured in the Channel 4 News report.

Image Credit Wiltshire Hunt Sabs.


The investigation also featured footage from the Eggesford Hunt showing a fox being bolted from underground; and covert-camera footage of the Heythrop Hunt showing chicken carcasses being dumped in woodland intended to attract foxes for hunting once the season begins.


Eggesford Hunt preparing to bolt a fox in front of the hounds.

Image Credit: Devon County Hunt Saboteurs


Also present with the Mendip Farmers Hunt on the day of the incident, was Helena Rees-Mogg, wife of former Conservative cabinet minister and former North East Somerset MP Sir Jacob Rees-Mogg.


Jacob Rees-Mogg hosting the Mendip Farmers Hunt at his home in West Harptree, on Boxing Day 2025.

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


The Rees-Mogg family’s association with the Mendip Farmers Hunt is longstanding. Helena Rees-Mogg has previously served as a master of the hunt, while the family has often hosted Mendip Farmers Hunt meets at their Somerset home.


Helena Anne Beatrix Wentworth Fitzwilliam, Lady Rees-Mogg , former master of the Mendip Farmers Hunt, image taken on the day of the incident 17/01/2026.

Image Credit Mendip Hunt Sabs.


Their eldest son, Peter Theodore Alphege Rees-Mogg, has also served as master of the Eton College Beagles.


A hunt saboteur spokesperson said “

It is down to the relentless work of hunt sabs around the country – getting out there week after week, saving lives, filming hunts, gathering evidence and putting it in front of the police – that we are finally seeing so many hunters charged with hunting offences.


Whether they are convicted …

author: PETA-Team
title: Tierschutz für Kinder: Ingrid Newkirks neues Buch „Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“
content:
Mit

„Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“

 lädt Ingrid Newkirk, Gründerin von PETA, Kinder ab ca. 9 Jahren zu einer besonderen Entdeckungsreise ein. Statt Fantasiegeschichten präsentiert das Kindersachbuch echte Geschichten voller

Mitgefühl

 und praktischer Tipps, wie Kinder selbst zum Wohl von Tieren beitragen können. Jedes Kapitel verbindet wissenschaftlich fundierte Fakten mit echten Geschichten aus der Tierwelt – mal berührend, mal überraschend, immer kindgerecht erzählt. Reflexionsfragen regen dazu an, über Verantwortung, Empathie und Gerechtigkeit nachzudenken. Damit fördert das Buch nicht nur Lesekompetenz, sondern auch zentrale Werte wie Mitgefühl und die Fähigkeit zum Perspektivwechsel.


Lesen Sie jetzt im Interview, welche Gedanken Ingrid zu „Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“ inspiriert haben, welche Vision dahintersteckt und weshalb es so wichtig ist, Kindern Tierschutz näherzubringen.


Kostenlos „Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“ bestellen


Ein Blick ins Buch: Gemeinsam stark für Tiere


Ingrid Newkirk zeigt in ihrem neuen Werk, dass jedes Kind auch ohne Zauberkräfte einen Unterschied machen kann. Die Geschichten handeln von Tieren, die überraschen, berühren und zum Nachdenken anregen: vom mutigen Schweinchen Prudence bis hin zu Tieren, die Kinder vielleicht nie persönlich kennenlernen werden, die aber ebenso unseren

Schutz

 brauchen. Dazu gibt es Fragen zum Weiterdenken und Ideen für eigene Tierschutzaktionen – ob im Klassenzimmer, in Projekten oder im Alltag.


Das Kindersachbuch zeigt: Tiere sind nicht für uns da, sondern mit uns hier. Und Kinder können schon heute viel dazu beitragen, dass die Welt für alle Lebewesen gerechter und freundlicher wird.


Ergänzt werden die Erzählungen durch konkrete Anregungen, wie junge Leser:innen selbst aktiv werden können: ob durch kleine Gesten im Alltag, kreative Ideen für mehr Tierschutz oder den bewussten Umgang mit Mitgeschöpfen. So wird das Buch zu einer Schatzkiste voller Inspiration, die Neugier weckt und zu eigenen guten Taten motiviert.


„Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“ jetzt auch als Lesehörbuch entdecken

 


„Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“ ist nicht nur als Kindersachbuch erhältlich, sondern auch als Lesehörbuch. In Kooperation mit der Werkstatt inklusiver Deutschunterricht (WiDu) wurde das Lesehörbuch für Bildungseinrichtungen nach dem Leseband-Konzept aufbereitet. So können Kinder die Geschichten gleichzeitig lesen und anhören. Das fördert die Lesekompetenz, unterstützt den Lernprozess und macht es noch leichter, in die faszinierende Welt der Tiere einzutauchen. 


„Die Geheimnisse der Tierwelt“: Ingrid Newkirk im Interview über ihr Buch


1. Über das Buch


Was hat Sie dazu motiviert, dieses Buch zu schreiben?

Alle Kinder möchten sich für Tiere starkmachen, und ich finde die Idee großartig, ihnen praktische Tipps zu geben, wie sie wunderbare Taten vollbringen können, die wirklich zählen.


Was macht dieses Buch im Vergleich zu anderen Kinderbüchern über Tiere besonders?

Es ist keine Fantasiegeschichte wie „Captain Irgendwas“ oder „Super Dies und Das“, sondern zeigt, wie man wirklich wichtig sein kann – nicht nur so tut, als ob –, indem man kleine Dinge tut, die das Leben von Tieren verändern. Und die meisten Kinder interessieren sich sehr für Tiere.


Warum ist es Ihrer Meinung nach wichtig, Kindern schon früh Tierschutz und Mitgefühl nahezubringen?

Wahrscheinlich gibt es nichts Wichtigeres. Wie ein antiker Philosoph sagte: Wenn man einem Kind beibringt, freundlich zu einer Raupe zu sein, tut man damit dem Kind genauso viel Gutes wie der Raupe. Mitgefühl verhindert Kriege – und selbst kleinere Aggressionen.


Wie haben Sie die Tiere ausgewählt, die im Buch vorkommen?

Kinder kennen

Hunde

 und Katzen, vielleicht auch Pferde und Eichhörnchen – deshalb sind sie im Buch. Aber auch Tiere wie Schlangen oder

Mäuse

, die oft als gruselig empfunden werden, und Tiere, die Kinder vermutlich nie zu Gesicht bekommen, die aber trotzdem unseren Schutz brauchen – zum Beispiel in Afrika oder Südamerika.


Gibt es eine Geschichte oder ein Tier in dem Buch, das Ihnen besonders am Herzen liegt?

Ich liebe alle Geschichten und hoffe, dass die Kinder sie auch alle lieben werden. Besonders gefällt mir die Geschichte von Prudence, dem kleinen Schweinchen, das wusste, dass sein Mensch sehr krank war – und sein eigenes Leben riskierte, um Hilfe zu holen. Sie zeigt, wie aufmerksam Tiere sind, selbst solche, die oft als „nicht besonders intelligent“ gelten, und wie viel Güte sie …

author: Sophie Lemcke
title: So ist es, als Huhn in der Fleischindustrie leben zu müssen
content:
Die Hühnermast ist ein grausames System, das auf maximale Schnelligkeit, Wachstum und Profit ausgelegt ist und mit einem gewaltvollen Tod für die Tiere endet.


Wie fühlt es sich an, als „Masthuhn“ geboren zu werden

, ohne die Möglichkeit, der leidvollen Industrie zu entkommen

?


Der einzige Grund, weshalb die Industrie dich „produziert“ hat: Du sollst so schnell wie möglich so schwer wie möglich werden – und wirst dann getötet.


Du kommst in einem Hühnerschlupfbetrieb mit tausenden anderen Küken zur Welt. Um dich herum piepsen sie verzweifelt. Und auch du suchst nach Nähe und Wärme. Aber da ist keine Mutter, in deren Gefieder du dich kuscheln kannst – und du wirst sie auch niemals kennenlernen.

Noch am ersten Tag deines Lebens wirst du über Förderbänder geschleudert und in eine Kiste gepackt. Dann beginnt die oftmals stundenlange Fahrt zum Mastbetrieb – eingepfercht mit Dutzenden anderen Küken, ohne Wasser, ohne Nahrung.


Foto: Andrew Skowron


Du kommst in einer riesigen Halle an. Hier wirst du die nächsten rund 5 Wochen verbringen – die einzigen Wochen deines Lebens.


Um dich herum Tausende andere Küken. Du teilst dir einen Quadratmeter mit bis zu 23 anderen Tieren. Jetzt seid ihr noch klein, doch das wird sich schnell ändern.


Du wächst. Unnatürlich schnell. Das Futter steht dir Tag und Nacht zur Verfügung – hochkalorisch, proteinreich, entwickelt für maximales Wachstum in kürzester Zeit.


Du hast keinen Platz, um dich natürlich zu bewegen, es gibt nichts zum Erkunden. Keinerlei Möglichkeiten, deine natürlichen Verhaltensweisen auszuleben. Es ist trist und laut. Da ist nur diese Enge.


Die Luft ist stickig. Der Ammoniakgeruch von den Ausscheidungen Tausender Tiere brennt in deinen Augen, in deinen Lungen. Du bekommst Atemwegserkrankungen. Jeder Atemzug tut weh.


Dein Körper wurde durch jahrzehntelange Züchtung so manipuliert, dass du in wenigen Wochen das Gewicht erreichst, für das ein Huhn unter natürlichen Bedingungen Monate bräuchte.


Foto: Andrew Skowron


Deine Brustmuskeln wachsen so schnell und werden so schwer, dass deine Knochen dein Gewicht nicht mehr tragen können. Deine Beine verformen sich. Dein Herz ist zu klein für deinen massiven Körper, es hat Probleme, deine Organe mit ausreichend Blut zu versorgen. Du hast Schmerzen beim Gehen und deine Gelenke sind entzündet.


Um dich herum sind Hühner, die gar nicht mehr aufstehen können. Sie liegen in ihrem eigenen Kot und leiden unter extremen Schmerzen. Sie verdursten und verhungern.


Andere Hühner werden aufgrund der Enge von ihren Artgenossen versehentlich totgetrampelt und erdrückt – ihre Körper verwesen zwischen dir und den tausenden anderen Tieren. Auch du hast keine Chance, den anderen Hühnern auszuweichen.


Dann ist es soweit. Menschen kommen und packen dich. An deinen Beinen, kopfüber, werden du und deine Artgenossen gegriffen und in enge Transportkisten geworfen. Deine ohnehin schon schmerzenden Beine brechen unter der groben Behandlung. Du hast Schmerzen und Todesangst.


Zusammengepfercht, ohne Wasser, ohne Futter, geht es zum Schlachthof. Die Fahrt kann Stunden dauern. Manche Hühner sterben bereits im Transporter – vor Stress, vor Erschöpfung, erdrückt von anderen Tieren.


Foto: Andrew Skowron


Im Schlachthof riechst du Blut. Du hörst die Schreie anderer Hühner. Dann bist du selbst an der Reihe. Unter grausamen Bedingungen wirst du betäubt und getötet. Du bist gerade einmal 35 bis 42 Tage alt geworden.


Es ist unvorstellbar, was Hühner in der Fleischindustrie erleiden müssen.


Die Wahrheit hinter „Hähnchenfleisch“


Wie grausam das kurze Leben von sogenannten Masthühnern ist, haben wir schon mehrfach bei Undercover-Recherchen aufgedeckt, beispielsweise in einem (jetzt ehemaligen) Zuliefererbetrieb der großen Marke Wiesenhof. Hier erfährst du mehr über unsere Aufdeckungen und kannst unsere Petition für strengere Tierschutzvorgaben, -kontrollen und -strafen unterzeichnen:


Jetzt für Hühner unterschreiben 


In Deutschland wird mehr Fleisch von Hühnern konsumiert als produziert – und die Nachfrage ist in den vergangenen Jahren stetig gestiegen. Unterstütze dieses grausame System nicht: Entscheide dich konsequent für pflanzliche Lebensmittel.


In den meisten Supermärkten findest du mittlerweile eine Vielfalt tierfreundlicher Alternativen, die hervorragende Proteinquellen sind – probiere sie aus. Oder koche unsere zahlreichen pflanzlichen Rezepte von Love Veg nach, wie unsere

knusprigen Tofu-Nuggets

.


Erfahre mehr:


Auf …

author: GPT
title: Kutschpferde ohne Schutz: Vorstösse in Stadt, Kanton und Bund
content:
Anwohner:innen dokumentierten diesen Sommer in Interlaken

Kutschpferde im Dauereinsatz

: dasselbe Pferd um 14 und um 21 Uhr desselben Tages, bei 31 Grad. Das kantonale Veterinäramt erklärte zu einer Temperaturlimite, die Tierschutzgesetzgebung biete

«keine Grundlage für derartige Anordnungen»

. An dieser Lücke setzen die drei Vorstösse an.


Die

Tierschutzverordnung

 regelt, wie viel Bewegung ein Pferd mindestens braucht – nicht, wie lange es vor der Kutsche arbeiten darf. Hitzeschutz schreibt sie für Wasserbüffel, Yaks und Schweine vor, für Pferde im Geschirr fehlt jede Bestimmung. Die Motion von Nationalrätin Meret Schneider (Grüne) beauftragt den Bundesrat deshalb, die Verordnung zu ergänzen: mit einer Höchstdauer des täglichen Einsatzes und Ruhezeiten, Einsatzgrenzen bei Hitze und einem Fachkundenachweis für das gewerbliche Kutschieren.


«Die Tierschutzverordnung kennt Hitzeschutz für Wasserbüffel, Yaks und Schweine – nur für Pferde, die bei grosser Hitze Kutschen über den Asphalt ziehen, fehlt jede Regel», sagt Meret Schneider. «Diese Lücke kann der Bundesrat auf dem Verordnungsweg schliessen, ohne Gesetzesänderung.»


Wie gross die Risiken auch für Menschen sind, zeigte der

Unfall im Val Roseg

 vom 16. August: Die Bremsleistung einer Kutsche reichte nicht mehr aus, ein Pferd stürzte, das Fuhrwerk prallte gegen einen Baum. Eine 73-jährige Frau starb, zwölf Mitfahrende wurden verletzt. Wer ein Tierfuhrwerk lenkt, braucht nach Bundesrecht einzig das vollendete vierzehnte Altersjahr, eine Prüfung besteht nicht.


Im Grossen Rat verlangt Susanne Clauss (SP) mit der Interpellation «Hitzefrei für Kutschpferde?» Auskunft darüber, wie viele Pferde im Kanton Bern für gewerbliche Kutschfahrten eingesetzt werden, wie der Kanton kontrolliert und was aus den Meldungen aus der Bevölkerung wird.


«Verbindliche Regeln nehmen den sorgfältigen Betrieben nichts weg», sagt Susanne Clauss. «Sie stoppen die Betriebe, die ihr Pferd von Mittag bis Mitternacht durcharbeiten lassen.»


In der Stadt Bern fragt Tobias Sennhauser, Stadtrat von Tier im Fokus (TIF), welche Bewilligungen die Stadt für Kutschenbetriebe erteilt, welche Vorgaben für die Kutschenfahrten des städtischen Tierparks gelten und wie weit ihr Handlungsspielraum reicht – bis hin zu einem Verbot.


«Die Kutsche ist Unterhaltung auf Kosten der Tiere», sagt Tobias Sennhauser. «Wir wollen von der Stadt wissen, ob sie im 21. Jahrhundert daran festhalten will, Pferde zwischen Tram, Bussen und Menschenmengen einzuspannen.»


Andere Städte sind weiter:

Berlin

 lässt seit 2019 ab 30 Grad im Schatten keine Kutschfahrten mehr zu, Barcelona, Madrid und Málaga haben den gewerblichen Kutschenbetrieb ganz beendet.


Der Beitrag

Kutschpferde ohne Schutz: Vorstösse in Stadt, Kanton und Bund

 erschien zuerst auf

Tier im Fokus (TIF)

.

author: Animal Rising Press
title: Woman Walks Free From Pig Farrowing Crate After 21 Days And Nights In Trafalgar Square
content:
Animal Rising vows further factory farm exposés as group says three-week action marks beginning of long-term campaign to end factory farming.

Animal Rising campaign lead Michelle Farnham has today (22 September) walked free from a pig farrowing crate in Trafalgar Square after spending 21 consecutive days and nights confined inside it, without leaving once.

Michelle emerged from the crate at 11am, after first entering it at 7am on 1 September, completing an extraordinary physical and psychological challenge designed to bring the reality of factory farming into public view.

She greeted a crowd of approximately 100 supporters and was joined by her partner and family following the three weeks of intense isolation.

Thousands of passersby encountered the installation during its three weeks in one of London’s busiest public spaces, with many stopping to speak with Michelle about the action and the conditions faced by animals in factory farms.

The action attracted national and international media attention, with high-profile visitors including former RSPCA president Chris Packham and Green MP Adrian Ramsay. [1]

Animal Rising said at the event that the end of Michelle’s confinement marks only the beginning of a long-term campaign against factory farming. The group is calling on the government to commit to ending factory farming by 2040 and says further investigations and exposés of conditions inside British farms will follow.

Michelle’s action was inspired by Luna, a mother pig whose life Animal Rising documented for a month on a Suffolk factory farm. [2] Michelle was confined in similar farrowing crate, of the type used in around 90% of indoor British pig farming systems to confine mother pigs around giving birth and nursing their piglets. [3]

Around 200,000 mother pigs are confined in farrowing crates in the UK each year. Sows can spend four to five weeks at a time inside the crates, unable even to turn around. [4]

A petition to free Luna is now approaching 30,000 signatures. [5]

Michelle is available for interview about her experience of spending 21 days and nights inside the crate, the physical and psychological impact of this time, and why she believes the UK must move away from factory farming.

To arrange interviews or follow-up coverage, please contact press@animalrising.org or +44 1225 29 6691

High-quality pictures and videos: https://show.pics.io/animal-rising-breaking-news

All images and videos in this file, on our social media and website can be used with credit to Animal Rising under ‘fair use’ for the purposes of reporting.

[1] https://www.dailymail.com/news/article-16123123/Chris-Packham-woman-pig-crate-Trafalgar-Square.html

[2] Luna investigation and footage: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=efbUsgUYUCA

[3] https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/animal-welfare-strategy-for-england/animal-welfare-strategy-for-england

[4] RSPCA information on farrowing crates: https://www.rspca.org.uk/getinvolved/campaign/farmcages

[5] Free Luna petition: https://act.animalrising.org/free_luna_pet

author: hsa_oryx
title: ‘AUTUMN’ HUNTING IS ABOUT AS REAL AS ‘TRAIL’ HUNTING
content:
Cub hunting or ‘autumn hunting’ as it is referred to by hunts, has been underway for a few weeks now and already we are seeing overwhelming reports of foxes running for their lives and aggressive behaviour from hunts whose illegal activity is being exposed.


On the 15

th

 of September the North Cotswold Hunt descended on Wormington in Gloucestershire. A

young fox

 was seen fleeing for its life but this wasn’t the only wildlife disturbed and distressed by the hunts presence, as deer were also seen running towards the very busy B4632.


This young fox was witnessed running for its life.

© Three Counties Hunt Sabs


The Hursley Hambledon Hunt have also been caught demonstrating blatant cub hunting tactics. On the 09

th

 of September while hunting in Meonstoke hounds were entered into a covert and remained there, being encouraged on by the huntsman, for over twenty minutes. Riders and foot supporters lined the covert in an attempt to turn foxes back, but they were unsuccessful as no less than three foxes were seen fleeing the area.


1 of 3 foxes fleeing from the Hursley Hambledon Hunt.

© South Hampshire Hunt Sabs


Meanwhile on the same day over two hours north, the Ledbury Hunt were causing chaos in Berrow. Again, cub hunting tactics were on display for all to see as riders surrounded a covert, saddle slapping and using sticks and voice calls to try and scare foxes back towards hounds. One fox is believed to have been cornered in an area of brambles and unfortunately their fate is unknown.


A short while later another fox was hunted and was thankfully seen to safety by a sab, who reminded the huntsman Sam Jones that he is soon due in court for charges under the Hunting Act while he was huntsman at the criminal Cottesmore Hunt.


This young fox makes its escape from the Ledbury hounds and huntsman Sam Jones.

© Three Counties Hunt Sabs


Grange Farm in Grandborough, a certified Camping and Caravanning site, played host to the Warwickshire Hunt on the 10

th

 of September. The hunt encouraged hounds along a brook just south of the meet and it wasn’t long before a fox was seen running for its life.


A rider attempted to catch up to the fox and turn it back as it fled to safety in a covert. Thankfully sabs were on hand to intervene, battling hollers from the whipper in Jacob Martin, who was actively encouraging hounds on.


This fox was hunted by the Warwickshire Hunt who met at a certified Camping & Caravanning site.

© West Midlands Hunt Sabs


While all of the foxes mentioned above were helped to safety, we are reminded of the sickening and cruel reality of “trail” hunting when sabs are faced with the aftermath of a fox being killed.


Unfortunately, on the 18

th

 of September, Three Counties Hunt Sabs witnessed the Heythrop Hunt kill a fox on land near Swell Wold Farm in Gloucestershire. The fox was surrounded, and the lasting result was blood smeared on a wooden fence while the fox’s innards were left strewn across the floor.


This is the sickening reality of “trail” hunting.

© Three Counties Hunt Sabs


As hunts charge through the countryside in search of innocent lives to take, all manner of wildlife is disturbed, as Cirencester Hunt Sabs reported on the 5

th

 of September while at

the bin bag Beaufort Hunt

. The hunt were on the Badminton Estate, and two quads were seen in a woodland whilst hunt riders circled the perimeter for at least an hour with hounds inside. 

This is not ‘trail’ hunting this is blatant cub hunting.


The hunt eventually moved on from here but disturbed a herd of deer, one of which fled into the road and was hit by a passing car. The couple in the car were left devastated by what had happened as the deer died by the roadside. As is to be expected, the hunt continued on with absolutely no regard for the trauma they had caused and the danger they had put people in.


After running from the Beaufort Hunt this deer was hit by a passing car.

Sabs stayed with them until they passed away.

author: Marcus Baram
title: Florida Homeowners Are Paying the Price of a Broken Disaster System
content:
Floridians pay some of the country’s highest property insurance premiums, averaging $4,200 to $5,700 a year.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

Two years after the water came, Jen and RJ Garbowicz still own a piece of St. Petersburg. It is an empty lot on a bayou off Tampa Bay, nearly an acre, with a few concrete pilings jutting out of the ground where their house once stood.

Hurricane Helene flooded it in September 2024. Hurricane Milton tore up the roof less than two weeks later. The couple had both flood and homeowners insurance. The flood policy paid in full, $250,000, and FEMA sent them about $33,000. Their homeowners insurer offered $2,279.41 against a $713,000 policy limit. They demolished what the hurricanes hadn’t and they estimate it will cost more than $1.5 million to rebuild their home.

Since then, the money has moved in strange directions. Their mortgage company is holding several hundred thousand dollars of the flood insurance payout until construction starts, which has been slowed as the couple wait on a permit. When they can finally draw on the Small Business Administration disaster loan they were approved for, $33,000 of it goes straight back to FEMA — a “duplication of benefits,” in the words of the government. “Even though that is a loan,” Jen Garbowicz said.

They are now living in their second rental, paying rent as well as the mortgage on a house that no longer exists. Last spring they flew to Washington to lobby for the FEMA Act, a bipartisan bill to overhaul the federal agency. They have still not heard from any of the lawmakers they met there.

“There really doesn’t seem to be a central place for people to go to navigate that,” she said. “It turns into a full-time job.”

In many battleground states, the climate crisis is showing up on the ballot in the form of an electricity bill, driven higher by data centers, gas plants and utility rate hikes. In Florida, however, it arrives as a higher homeowners premium, a denied claim or a disaster relief system that the people who depend on it say is broken.

The numbers are among the highest in the country. Property insurance premiums average between $4,200 and $5,700 a year statewide. Insurers paid out more than $10 billion in claims in 2025 and 15 property insurers have become insolvent since 2020. Florida has absorbed at least $200 billion in hurricane damage in the last 10 years.

Jen Garbowicz has lived in Florida for 36 years. “We’ve seen rapid rises, at least over the last 10 years, in insurance premiums,” she said. “And then these weather events come along and the insurance system doesn’t work the way most people think that it does.”

Among their neighbors, RJ Garbowicz said, “A lot of people had to file bankruptcy because of their foreclosure just so they can buy another house.”

Jen Garbowicz notes that “sea levels are rising, and we do know that this area has been built up a lot since the 1990s.” Whatever the mix, infrastructure “really needs to be addressed — not only at the local municipality level but at state levels and federal levels too.”

Asked whether where candidates stand on weather events, climate change and disaster relief would shape her vote in November, she said, “For sure.”

The governor’s race in Florida offers the sharpest choice on those questions of any state this midterm.

Byron Donalds, the Republican nominee for governor, said he does not believe climate change is caused by human activity — “the science is not settled on that” — and has criticized European insurers for embedding climate risk into their actuarial models for Florida properties. His energy platform is built on expanding cheap generation: small modular and micro-nuclear reactors, hydrogen and an additional natural gas pipeline. He said he would let hyperscale AI data centers build in the state, regulating their power and water impacts rather than banning them.

David Jolly, the Democratic nominee, treats climate as a critical threat requiring sustained state investment in resiliency — raised roads, modernized building codes, sea walls, stormwater drainage. He wants utilities to integrate more clean and renewable energy sources, stronger net metering for rooftop solar, opposes offshore drilling and promises a one-year data center moratorium on his first day in office.

author: CMI Argentina
title: La llegada del Super Niño, centro de preocupación en las Sierras Chicas de Córdoba
content:
La llegada de El Niño de gran intensidad vuelve a poner en el centro de la preocupación a las comunidades de Sierras Chicas, en la provincia de Córdoba, una región marcada por la inundación del 15 de febrero de 2015, por la vulnerabilidad de sus cuencas frente a lluvias intensas y por el desmanejo estatal. Vecinos, vecinas y ambientalistas reclaman medidas de prevención y coordinación entre los municipios y la Provincia, mientras advierten sobre la necesidad de contar con sistemas de alerta, protocolos de evacuación y planes ciudadanos que permitan actuar antes de una eventual emergencia.


Inundación en Rio Ceballos del 15 de febrero de 2015


Por Lucrecia Fernández para Red Eco


El escenario se encuentra además atravesado por un amparo ambiental colectivo presentado ante la Justicia de Córdoba por un grupo de ambientalistas de la región, ante el riesgo de inundaciones y lluvias extremas en las cuencas de los ríos Ceballos y Saldán. La acción tiene entre sus impulsores al abogado Juan Smith y al biólogo Raúl Montenegro, presidente de la Fundación para la Defensa del Ambiente (FUNAM).


Espacios destruidos después de las inundaciones de 2015 en Río Ceballos


La Cámara Contencioso Administrativa de Segunda Nominación admitió el trámite del amparo y convocó a una audiencia que se realizó el 23 de septiembre, con participación de representantes del Gobierno provincial y de los municipios vinculados con las cuencas. Hasta el momento, sin embargo, no se difundió información oficial sobre lo ocurrido durante esa reunión ni sobre sus resultados por parte de la Justicia, la Provincia, los municipios convocados o quienes impulsaron el amparo.


En paralelo, en Río Ceballos, una de las localidades de Sierras Chicas, Vecinas y vecinos Autoconvocados de Río Ceballos mantienen un reclamo específico ante el municipio. Días antes de la reunión mantenida el 23 de septiembre, el espacio había presentado 40 preguntas al Departamento Ejecutivo Municipal y al Concejo Deliberante para conocer las medidas previstas ante la posibilidad de lluvias extraordinarias y el comportamiento del dique La Quebrada y sus cuencas.


El riesgo ante un posible “Súper Niño”


En una entrevista con el programa

Nada de Otro Mundo

, Montenegro explicó que el escenario de riesgo en las sierras de Córdoba no puede analizarse únicamente a partir del fenómeno de El Niño, sino que debe contemplar también los efectos del cambio climático y las características de las tormentas que se producen en la provincia.


“Bueno, primero debe quedar claro que este fenómeno que se espera, que técnicamente se llama un Niño muy fuerte, después medio lo bautizaron como Súper Niño, sería el más fuerte que se haya repetido en toda la historia. Me parece que es un elemento que todos deberíamos tener en cuenta.


No solamente tenemos este fenómeno, sino que, a su vez, tenemos cambio climático global. Quiero destacar que el fenómeno del Niño, que es un fenómeno de calentamiento del océano Pacífico y que tiene efectos sobre lugares tan distantes como pueden ser Europa, el Sahara o Córdoba, es dependiente del cambio climático. Y, a su vez, el cambio climático ha hecho, por ejemplo, que aumentara la cantidad de humedad. Entonces quiere decir que se termina potenciando.


Y hay un tercer elemento que muchos cordobeses desconocen y que, por lo que parece, el propio gobierno también ha dejado de lado hace mucho tiempo: la zona centro del país, especialmente Córdoba, tiene las tormentas convectivas eléctricas más fuertes del mundo. De hecho, es un conocido objeto de estudio de muchas instituciones.


Entonces uno dice: caramba, siendo que tenemos estos sistemas convectivos de gran escala, que así se llaman estas tormentas, que son incluso más fuertes que las peores tormentas que ocurren en la zona de Estados Unidos, tenemos cambio climático, tenemos un Súper Niño”.


Montenegro sostuvo además que, en localidades como Río Ceballos, existen elementos de infraestructura que, según su planteo, podrían incrementar los riesgos ante una eventual crecida del río Ceballos. Señaló particularmente la instalación del sistema cloacal en las márgenes del curso de agua y advirtió sobre el riesgo que implicaría una eventual inundación si afectara las cañerías en funcionamiento.


Comienzo de las obras cloacales a la vera del río Ceballos


El biólogo también puso el foco en los sistemas de alerta temprana y en la preparación de la población. Según explicó, la existencia de alarmas no garantiza por sí …

title: Sicillerinde işçi ölümleri var: Maden şirketleri bu kez ‘hayat kurtarmak’ için yarıştı
content:
İktidarın “iş güvenliği” söylemleri eşliğinde Rize’de düzenlenen Maden Kurtarma Yarışması’nda, maden sahalarında işçilerin yaşamını yitirdiği şirketler bu kez “hayat kurtarmak” için yarıştı. Organizasyona katılan şirketlerin geçmişinde çok sayıda iş cinayeti bulunuyor.

Türkiye Madenciler Derneği’nin (TMD) madencilik sektöründe “iş güvenliği kültürünü pekiştirmek” iddiasıyla düzenlediği 4. Maden Kurtarma Yarışması, sermaye ile iktidarın iş güvenliği tablosundaki çelişkiyi bir kez daha ortaya koydu. İş cinayetlerinin en fazla yaşandığı işkollarından madencilik sektörünün tanıdık şirketleri, kamu kurumlarının temsilcileri ve yerel yönetimin desteğiyle bu kez kurtarma parkurunda bir araya geldi. Yarışmaya katılan 13 şirketin birçoğu daha önce iş cinayetleriyle gündeme gelirken bazı şirketlerin sahalarındaki ölümlerin üzerinden yalnızca aylar, hatta haftalar geçti.

TMD tarafından düzenlenen yarışmanın dördüncüsü, 22-25 Eylül tarihlerinde Cengiz Holding’e ait Çayeli Bakır İşletmeleri’nin ev sahipliğinde Rize’de yapıldı. AKP’li Rize Belediyesinin desteğiyle gerçekleştirilen dört günlük organizasyon, gala gecesi ve ödül töreniyle sona erdi.

Organizasyona Acacia Maden İşletmeleri, Çayeli Bakır İşletmeleri, Defaş Madencilik, Esan Eczacıbaşı, Eti Bakır, Eti Krom, Gübretaş Maden Yatırımları, Gümüştaş Madencilik, Öksüt Madencilik, Tümad Madencilik, Tüprag Madencilik, Türk Altın İşletmeleri ve Zenit Madencilik’in arama kurtarma ekipleri katıldı. Takımlar; yeraltı, yangın, deprem, kimyasala müdahale, araç kazası ve takım yetkinliği olmak üzere altı kategoride yarıştı.

Dört gün boyunca “iş güvenliği” mesajlarının verildiği organizasyonda şirketlerin yanı sıra kamu kurumlarından temsilciler de yer aldı. Açılış konuşmacıları arasında Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığı İş Sağlığı ve Güvenliği Genel Müdürlüğü Daire Başkanı Mehmet Eren Sökmen, Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakan Yardımcısı Abdullah Tancan ve Rize Valisi İhsan Selim Baydaş bulunurken Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakanlığı bürokratları da organizasyona katıldı.

Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakan Yardımcısı Tancan, açılış konuşmasında iş sağlığı ve güvenliği ile çevreyi madencilik sektörünün “asla esnetilmeyecek” iki kırmızı çizgisi olarak tanımladı. Kürsüden verilen bu mesajlara karşın yarışmaya katılan şirketlerin iş güvenliği sicili dikkat çekti.

BirGün’den İlayda Sorku’nun haberine göre yarışmanın ev sahibi Çayeli Bakır İşletmeleri daha önce bir iş cinayetiyle gündeme geldi. Şirket henüz First Quantum Minerals bünyesindeyken 3 Şubat 2017’de işçi Serdar Dede, maden sahasında bir iş makinesinin geri manevrası sırasında aracın altında kalarak yaşamını yitirdi. Çayeli Bakır İşletmeleri daha sonra Cengiz Holding tarafından satın alındı.

Cengiz Holding bünyesindeki bir diğer yarışmacı ise Eti Bakır oldu. 2012 yılında Samsun Eti Bakır tesisinde amonyak tankının kapağının düşmesi sonucu 7 işçi hayatını kaybetti, 12 işçi yaralandı. Olayın ardından “taksirle ölüme neden olmak” suçlamasıyla dava açıldı ancak 2015 yılına gelindiğinde davada tutuklu sanık kalmadı.

Tarım Kredi iştiraki Gübretaş’ın işlettiği Bilecik Söğüt’teki altın madeninde de bir işçi yaşamını yitirdi. 2022 yılında sahada çalışan taşeron işçi Sebahattin Duman’a geri manevra yapan greyder çarptı. Ağır yaralanan Duman hayatını kaybetti. Gübretaş Maden Yatırımları da Rize’de arama kurtarma ekibiyle yarışan 13 şirket arasında yer aldı.

Yarışmaya katılan şirketlerden biri de Defaş Madencilik’ti. Bağımsız Maden İş, 2024 yılında AKP’li Ferhat Nasıroğlu’nun şirketi Fernas ve Koç Holding’e bağlı Demir Export ortaklığındaki Defaş Madencilik’in Soma’da işlettiği maden sahasında Galip Uçar isimli işçinin yaşamını yitirdiğini açıkladı. 27 yaşındaki işçinin ölümü haberlere “özel bir maden işletmesinde yer altında çalışırken hayatını kaybettiği” şeklinde yansıdı. Olayla ilgili soruşturma başlatıldı.

Yıldırım Holding bünyesindeki Eti Krom’un sahasında yaşanan iş cinayetinin üzerinden ise henüz üç ay bile geçmedi. 29 Haziran 2026’da Elazığ’ın Alacakaya ilçesindeki Eti Krom sahasında taşeron Denson Madencilik bünyesinde çalışan Murat Demiroğlu, geri manevra yapan kepçe ile duvar arasında kaldı. Demiroğlu hayatını kaybederken olayla ilgili soruşturma başlatıldı.

author: Martha Teodoro
title: Faith groups push against US-backed ‘Pax Silica’ hub
content:
Caritas Philippines President Bishop Gerardo Alminaza speaking at the press conference. (Photo by Martha Teodoro/Bulatlat)

Catholic bishops and Protestant leaders, Christian youth and environmental activists are joining forces to halt “Pax Silica,” an AI hub megaproject backed by the United States. Critics fear that this project would drain Central Luzon’s water and power supplies and displace Indigenous communities.

Inked in April 2026, “Pax Silica,” is a U.S.-led worldwide network aimed at protecting supply chains for computer chips, AI tech, and vital minerals. The Bases Conversion and Development Authority has set aside 1,620 hectares in New Clark City in Tarlac for this project, which will be an industrial district for mineral processing sites and automated data centers.

Government officials say the project will turn the Philippines into a worldwide tech powerhouse, but church groups and civil society organizations disagree.

Caritas Philippines President Bishop Gerardo Alminaza called on the national government not to make any binding guarantee all at once.

“Who really gains from this megaproject?” Bishop Alminaza said in a press briefing last September 22, 2026. “The government should not make irreversible commitments without full transparency, independent assessment of cumulative ecological risks and clear guarantees that the land rights of Indigenous Aetas and local water security will not be sacrificed.”

Protestant leaders raised similar concerns. The United Church of Christ in the Philippines (UCCP) has raised questions on the moral basis of the program, saying the technological growth of foreign powers diminishes local sovereignty and control over the environment.

UCCP officials have observed in the theological argument over the project’s name that the concept of Pax in history, from Pax Romana to Pax Americana, is a peace imposed by dominant powers to ensure obedience and control over lesser states. This corporate-led peace was contrasted by UCCP bishops with biblical Shalom – a peace based on justice, community equity and appropriate management of the environment.

The UCCP Christian Youth Fellowship (UCCP-CYF) also released a statement that forcefully rejects the economic exploitation of ancestral areas in an official declaration. “Land and water are sacred gifts from God. They cannot be turned into commodities for the profit of a few to the ruin of our communities.”

“Technological advancement loses its moral authority when it is done at the cost of displacing Indigenous Aeta families and rural farming communities without real consultation,” the youth group added.

Gerry Arances, executive director of the Center for Energy, Ecology, and Development (CEED), also sounded the alarm on the disastrous impact the megaproject would have on the country’s energy security and consumer pricing.

“And why is Pax Silica a big problem for the Philippines? 3 gigawatts of power is not straightforward… And most likely, the corporations that will actually be investing in Pax Silica will not build their own facilities. That would involve raising the price of their products,” Aranes said.

“Filipino families are already paying some of the highest electricity rates in Asia and yet this project needs huge amounts of energy to run foreign AI hubs and mineral processing,” he explained. “If the government subsidizes foreign corporations with continued power supply while taking away from an already overburdened grid, everyday consumers will experience more frequent power outages and even higher monthly electric bills.”

In the face of these threats, Caritas Philippines, the National Council of Churches in the Philippines (NCCP) and the UCCP are calling an immediate halt to all agreements until the full environmental and social impact evaluations are published.

Church leaders and civil society partners clarified that they are not against science or technology but as their united pleas say, they are appealing for national development that is mindful of human dignity, local resources and putting Filipinos first. (RTS, RVO)
