content:
Автор

: Уэйн Прайс

Название

: Революционный анархизм - часть левого движения?

Дата

: 1991

Дополнительная информация

: Перевод М. Шувалова из газеты “Love and Rage” (USA) октябрь 1991 г. КАС-КОНТАКТ № 18 (25) февраль 1993 года


 Признают ли революционные анархисты себя частью левого движения? Ответов на этот вопрос, видимо, будет столько же, сколько существует на свете анархистов. Довольно типичный ответ принадлежит ветерану анархистского движения Сэму Долгоффу: «Вам всегда нужен левый фланг. И в рамках левого фланга вы ищете еще более левую сторону. Но и там вам нужно что-то еще более левое. И вот это-то левое и есть я».


Более ясное определение этому дал П. А. Кропоткин в своей статье «Анархизм» (1910 г.): «Что же касается их экономических воззрений, то анархисты наряду со всеми социалистами, левое крыло которых они составляют, противостоят… капиталистическому производству» (сокращенная цитата).


Анархизм – левый фланг левых, левое крыло социалистов? Многие хорошие анархисты, я уверен, будут выступать против такого определения. Левые, подчеркивают они, не хотят того, чего мы хотим. Левые, по их мысли, авторитарны, государственники, прокапиталисты, расисты и сексисты… В этом, конечно, есть доля правды, но тем не менее…


Вообще, организованное левое движение делится на два основных течения: реформистское и революционное. Левые реформисты варьируется от откровенных прокапиталистических либералов из числа социал-демократов (или «демократических социалистов») до умеренных коммунистов. Все они хотят использовать существующую бюрократически-милитаристскую машину государства для проведения социальных изменений, в общем принимая капиталистическую экономику, но стремясь ослабить ее наиболее негативные черты при помощи государственного регулирования и государственной собственности на некоторые виды производства. Реформисты считают, что нет альтернативы нынешней системе, которая угрожает всему человечеству своими войнами и угрозой экологической катастрофы. Вообще же, хотя реформисты заявляют, что они последовательно ведут людей к построению социалистического общества, но тем не менее не существует ни одной крупной социал-демократической партии, которая уже успела это сделать. Современные европейские социал-демократы (и даже очень многие коммунисты) очень мало чем отличаются от либеральных демократов традиционного образца…


С другой стороны, революционные левые нацеливают свою деятельность на уничтожение существующего государства. Но большинство из них (марксисты-ленинцы или националисты) хотели бы заменить его новым государством – государством однопартийной диктатуры… Они считают, что это будет вполне приемлемая «бархатная» диктатура – «диктатура пролетариата», или что-нибудь еще в этом роде.


В сущности, они стремятся отобрать все богатства и достояние у нынешних капиталистов, национализировав всю экономику. Они называют это «социализмом», но на самом деле это государственный капитализм. При таком порядке бюрократия очень быстро станет новым капиталистическим классом и неизбежно введет жесткий тоталитаризм…


В настоящее время марксизм-ленинизм дискредитирован как никогда ранее, а социал-демократия мертва как идея, хотя и продолжают существовать европейские партии, называющие себя «социал-демократами», поэтому многие анархисты считают: почему мы должны идентифицировать анархизм с прогнившим на корню левым движением? Зачем держаться за этот скомпрометированный и пользующийся дурной славой ярлык?


ЛЕВЫЕ - ЭТО ОППОЗИЦИЯ


 В этих аргументах много верного. Мы согласны с основной позицией, что необходимо провести четкую границу между анархизмом и либерализмом (или государственным социализмом). И в то же время я считаю, что успех анархического движения будет основываться на нашем умении быть самыми левыми из левых.


Левые – это прежде всего оппозиция. Если рассматривать левое движение в более общем смысле, не придавая значения партиям и программам, то можно сказать, что левые – это прежде всего объединение людей, которые выступают против эксплуатации трудящихся, угнетения женщин, негров, «голубых» и других групп населения, против империалистических войн, против разрушения окружающей среды – одним словом, против всех зол, за которые ответственно нынешнее общество.


Профсоюзные активисты, феминистки, борцы с расизмом и дискриминацией гомосексуалистов, экологисты и т. д., и т. п. – все это «левые» в широком смысле слова. В некоторых странах они предпочитают называть себя «либералами» или «прогрессивистами». В других же …

author: Fozzie
title: Chapter 1: The Commodity
content:
Harry Cleaver's study guide to chapter 1 of Marx's Capital volume 1.

Section 1: The Two Factors of the Commodity: Use-value and Exchange-value

Marx’s presentation begins with the analysis of commodities— of useful products of human labor that are bought and sold—because:

His “wealth of societies” echoes the title of Adam Smith’s The Wealth of Nations (1776), the foundational text of classical political economy. But when he goes on to specify “in which the capitalist mode of production prevails”, we know that he will be analyzing wealth in capitalism, not in any random “nation”.

Part VIII on Primitive Accumulation explains why wealth appears as commodities in capitalism—because capitalists have imposed the commodity-form on both workers and production. They have stripped people of their land and tools (Chapter 27) and have forced them to sell their willingness and ability to work as a commodity for wages (Chapter 28). These processes created a “home market” (Chapter 30) in which most consumer goods take the form of commodities. In Volume II, Marx restates this point explicitly. “The wage-laborers, the mass of direct producers, . . . must constantly be faced with the necessary means of subsistence in purchasable form, i.e., in the form of commodities . . . When production by means of wage-labour becomes universal, commodity production is bound to be the general form of production”. (2) With raw materials, machinery, factories and office buildings being produced by capitalist-controlled wage (or slave) labor, this has also been true for producer goods. Finally, the same is true for everything produced for sale to the state or for export abroad.

Beyond a new organization of production—in which wealth takes the form of commodities—Part VIII also explains how work imposed in this manner results in a class society, made up of capitalists who impose work and workers upon whom work is imposed. Workers, unable to escape the factory or office, continue to resist and sometimes create alternatives. To provide an analysis that can help workers overthrow this system, Chapter 1 explains how commodities are not simply “things produced and sold” but embody characteristics of the antagonistic class relationships of capitalism. The real “wealth” of capitalists is their control over people via imposed work. This fundamental bond must be broken to liberate society from the exploitation characteristic of capitalism and the cruel alienation that results.

Figure 1 portrays the overall structure of his analysis. Section 1 analyzes the commodity into use-value and exchange-value, beneath which lurks “value” whose substance is abstract labor. Section 2 examines the measure of value— socially necessary labor time. Section 3 explores the complexities of the form of value. Section 4 calls our attention to the fetishism of the presentation up to this point and prepares us for Chapter 2 that begins de-fetishizing the analysis by situating commodities in the hands of their owners.

Marx analyzes the commodity into its two modes of existence. In the first part of Figure 1, we have:

A commodity is a use-value because it has a value in use; that is, it “satisfies human wants of some sort or another.” It also is an exchange-value because it has a value in exchange; that is, it can be exchanged for something else. However, these two different determinations are contradictory. A commodity only becomes a use-value if it used. It only becomes an exchange-value if it is not used but exchanged. Yet, the commodity—sold, bought and consumed—is the unity of these opposites. The strange combination of unity and opposition, in which the opposites only have their meaning vis-à-vis each other and are thus inextricably joined, constitute what Marx means by a contradiction or contradictory relation. Just such a contradiction obtains in the antagonistic class relationships of capitalism. Each class stands opposed to the other, but at the same time each exists, as such, only within the relationship. A capitalist class can only exist when those with money can hire people and put them to work; people constitute a working class only in their subordination to capital.(3)

This contradiction, which Marx analyzed in A Contribution to the Critique of Political Economy, can only find its solution in the actual exchange process which: “must comprise both the evolution and the solution of these contradictions.” (4) He analyzes this solution more fully in Chapter 3, where …

title: Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya'nın istifasının ardından AKP'den ilk açıklama
content:
AKP Sözcüsü Ömer Çelik, AKP Genel Başkan Yardımcısı Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya'nın "partideki görevinden affını istemesinin" ardından sosyal medya hesabından fon krizine ilişkin bir açıklama yayımladı.


Ahmet Şık: Sayan ailesi 163 milyon TL’yi nereden buldu, hacca Yağız’ın jetiyle mi gitti?


Bugün  13:29


Kaya'nın adını anmayan ve istifasına değinmeyen Çelik, süreçle ilgili "Her türlü yanlış, yolsuzluk, istismar ve usulsüzlükle mücadele tavizsiz verilecektir" dedi.


Çelik'in açıklaması şöyle:


"AK Parti’miz her zaman 'doğru'ların yanında 'yanlış'ların karşısındadır. AK Parti’mizin 'kuruluş felsefesi' ve 'varlık sebebi' budur.


Fon krizi olarak adlandırılan gündemin her bir maddesi ve detayı, Genel Başkanımız ve Cumhurbaşkanımızın talimatıyla ilk andan itibaren partideki yetkili kurumlarımız tarafından titizlikle takip edilmekte ve değerlendirilmektedir. Bu değerlendirmeleri yaparken temel ilkemiz, Cumhurbaşkanımız ve Genel Başkanımızın 'Sorumluluğu olan kim varsa hesap sorulacaktır' ifadesidir. Bu ilke çerçevesinde, her türlü yanlış, yolsuzluk, istismar ve usulsüzlükle mücadele 'tavizsiz' verilecektir.


Fon krizi olarak adlandırılan bu süreçten olumsuz etkilenen vatandaşlarımızın hak ve hukuku titizlikle ele alınacaktır. Cumhurbaşkanımızın talimatlarıyla, Adalet Bakanlığımız ile Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığımız başta olmak üzere tüm kurumlarımızın tam bir koordinasyon içinde kapsamlı çalışmaları, olayların tüm boyutlarını açığa çıkaracak, karanlıkta hiçbir şey kalmayacak ve gereği yapılacaktır. Ortada bir iddia varsa araştırılacaktır. Tüm usulsüzlükler ortaya çıkarılacaktır. Yanlış yapanlar, hukuk önünde hesabını verecektir. Finansal sistemimize ve Türkiye ekonomisine yönelik sistemik bir risk yoktur. Temellerimiz sağlamdır.


Sermaye piyasalarının sınırlı bir bölümünde, belli sayıda fonda ortaya çıkan bir sorundur. Bu sorunun üzerine gidilirken, Cumhurbaşkanımızın ifade ettiği gibi, “benzer bir problemin yaşanmaması için hukuki ve idari düzenlemeler dahil hangi tedbirlere ihtiyaç duyuluyorsa bunların da hayata geçirilmesini sağlayacak” çalışmaları kapsamlı bir şekilde yapıyoruz. Tüm denetim kurumları görevinin başındadır. Şeffaflık, denetim ve hesap verilebilirlik ilkelerini koruyacak ve güçlendireceğiz. Milletimizin her alandaki emanetine sahip çıkma irademiz tamdır. Milletimizin emanetine sahip çıkarken hiçbir taviz, istisna ve kararsızlık söz konusu olamaz. AK Parti’mizde 'siyasetimizin alfabesi' her türlü yanlışla sonuna kadar mücadele etmektir.”


AK Parti’miz her zaman “doğru”ların yanında “yanlış”ların karşısındadır.

İddialar Yeni Parti Sözcüsü Zeynel Emre tarafından da gündeme getirilmiş, Emre söz konusu işlemlerin kamuoyuna açıklanması çağrısında bulunmuştu.


Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya ise iddiaların ardından sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamayla AKP'deki görevlerinden ayrılma talebini duyurmuştu.

author: Unknown
title: Créer la brèche : weekend pour construire et penser des perspectives révolutionnaires et antifascistes
content:
À la suite de la mort du néo-nazi Deranque, nous nous sommes retrouvé·es à quelques-un·es pour tenter de dépasser collectivement l'état de sidération face à la répression et la réaction de la classe politique et médiatique.


Nous constatons la place importante qu'occupe le milieu autonome à Lyon mais il nous semble nécessaire de le structurer afin de développer sa pleine puissance. De ce fait, nous pensons qu'il faut s'organiser de manière collective et dans une perspective révolutionnaire.


Notre volonté est de dépasser l'agenda politique institutionnel, de proposer des espaces d'organisation laissant place à nos désaccords et à nos ambitions révolutionnaires tout en étant capables d'être à la hauteur des coups portés contre notre camp.


Pour cela, nous proposons un moment de discussion le weekend du 23-24-25 octobre afin d'échanger ensemble pour penser les années à venir.


Ces discussions suivront trois axes après un premier temps consacré au bilan de nos luttes et expériences révolutionnaires de ces dernières années :


 Attaque : les formes d'organisation possible, leurs limites et leurs réussites

 Défense : les possibilités de résistance et de solidarité concrètes

 Propagande : forces et limites de nos outils de diffusion des idées


Programme à venir

author: Joe Sandler Clarke
title: Outsourcing Giants Made £6bn in Profit From UK’s Public Services Last Year
content:
Outsourcing companies made an estimated £6bn in profit from public services last year, with close to 11% of all public expenditure going to these private firms.


A new report

 by the think tank Common Wealth found that the public sector spent £129bn on services provided by outsourcing firms, despite the Labour government pledging to bring more public services in-house.


Since the 1980s, private companies have increasingly been brought in to run services once offered by the state. It was hoped that these supposedly efficient firms could break up cumbersome state-owned monopolies. 


But the influx of private companies has just created new monopolies. Serco – which has a £2bn contract with the Royal Navy and also manages

public bicycle hire schemes

 – gets 90% of its global revenue from public sector contracts, according to Common Wealth’s research. 


Meanwhile, outsourcing giants have faced numerous scandals over the years. Back in 2020

G4S was fined £44m

 by the Serious Fraud Office after overcharging the Ministry of Justice for tagging offenders, some of whom had died. 


Common Wealth found that around 1.3 million people are employed by these firms in the UK, which is over

seven times

 the number of police officers in the country. Many of these workers are in low-paid jobs, as the pressure to win public contracts forces wages down, even as their bosses get huge salaries. Former Serco CEO Mark Irwin, for example,

reportedly earned £845,000 a year

. 


Report author Sophie Flinders said: “For too long the government has allowed outsourcing giants Mitie, Serco and Sodexo to grow rich from worsening living standards. Public sector-wide insourcing would restore decent work for over a million people across the country. The government should work with the unions to make insourcing a reality.”

title: Nermin Suna son yolculuğuna uğurlandı
content:
Ankara — KESK’e bağlı Büro Emekçileri Sendikası (BES) Genel Sekreteri Sedat Suna’nın eşi Nermin Suna son yolculuğuna uğurlandı. Pir Sultan Abdal Cemevi’nden deyişlerle, türkülerle, gözyaşları içinde uğurlanan Nermin Suna’nın cenaze töreni adeta miting gibi bir katılımla gerçekleşti.

Sokullu Çetin Emeç Bulvarı’nda 25 Eylül’de hızla gelen bir aracın çarpması sonucu ağır yaralanan Nermin Suna, kaldırıldığı Memorial Hastanesi’nde iki günlük yaşam mücadelesini dün akşam saatlerinde kaybetti.

İki gün hastanede Nermin Suna’nın hayata dönmesini bekleyen eşi Sedat Suna, oğulları, ailesi ve yakınları, acı haberin ardından gece geç saatlere kadar Kızılırmak Federasyonu’na bağlı Kıvşak Köy Derneği’nde acılarını paylaşan dostlarıyla buluştu.

Nermin Suna için bugün de Oran Pir Sultan Abdal Cemevi’nde cenaze töreni düzenlendi. Eşi Sedat Suna’nın gözyaşları içinde duygularını paylaşmasının ardından, Dede Hakan Erol’un gülbengleri ve ozanlar Hüseyin Beydilli ve Mert Kılıç’la birlikte söyledikleri deyişler ve türkülerin ardından Nermin Suna Gölbaşı Mezarlığı’nda son yolculuğuna uğurlandı.

Cemevi ve Gölbaşı Mezarlığı’ndaki törene BES ve KESK’e bağlı sendikaların başkan ve yöneticileri, Emek Partisi Ankara İl örgütü, Emek Hareketi’nden dostları ile Nermin Suna’nın köyü olan Kıvşak Derneği, Kızılırmak Federasyonu ve bağlı derneklerin başkan ve yöneticilerinden, dostlarından oldukça yoğun bir katılım oldu.

Gölbaşı Mezarlığı’ndaki törenin ardından Nermin Suna için Birlik Mahallesi’nde bulunan Mardin Kültür Evi’nde (MAREV) lokma verildi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Viking mezarları ezberi bozdu: Aynı mezardakiler akraba çıkmadı
content:
İsveç’teki Viking Çağı sonları ve Orta Çağ dönemlerine ait toplu mezarlar üzerinde yürütülen kapsamlı bir araştırma, arkeoloji dünyasındaki yerleşik kabulü altüst etti. Arkeologlar, aynı mezara yan yana gömülmüş yetişkin ve çocukların genelde aynı aileye mensup olduğunu varsayarken, genetik analizler durumun çok daha farklı olduğunu ortaya çıkardı.

Stockholm Üniversitesi tarafından yürütülen ve Science Advances dergisinde yayımlanan çalışmada, İsveç'in Sigtuna, Vasterhus ve Fjälkinge bölgelerindeki mezarlıklardan çıkarılan 60'ı çocuk ve ergen olmak üzere toplam 142 kişinin antik DNA'sı (aDNA) incelendi.

Elde edilen genetik veriler, aynı mezarı paylaşan bireyler arasında yakın biyolojik akrabalığın son derece nadir olduğunu gösterdi.

Çalışmanın başyazarı Dr. Maja Krzewinska, "Aynı mezarı paylaşan yetişkin ve çocukların ebeveyn-evlat ya da yakın akraba olduğunu varsayardık. Vakaların çoğunda durumun böyle olmadığını gördük" ifadelerini kullandı.

Bu bulgu, Orta Çağ İskandinavya'sında kimin kiminle gömüleceğine dair kararların yalnızca kan bağıyla değil, sosyal statü, dini inançlar ve toplumsal dayanışma gibi farklı etkenlerle şekillendiğini kanıtladı.

Antik DNA analizi, kemik yapısından cinsiyeti anlaşılamayacak kadar küçük yaşta hayatını kaybeden çocukların biyolojik cinsiyetlerini de netleştirdi.

İncelemeler, İskandinavya’nın erken Hristiyanlık döneminde çocukluk kavramına ilişkin önemli detaylar sundu. Örneğin Vasterhus’taki katedral mezarlığında kadınlar ve erkekler kilisenin farklı taraflarına gömülüyordu. DNA analizleri, kız ve erkek çocuklarının da yetişkinlerle aynı cinsiyet ayrımına tabi tutularak gömüldüğünü gösterdi. Prof. Anders Götherström, çocukların ayrı bir kategori olarak görülmediğini, ölümde de yetişkinlerin dini ve sosyal ilkelerine göre muamele gördüklerini belirtti.

Araştırma, Vasterhus'taki mezarlıkta yatan ve "Lady 56" (56 numaralı kadın) olarak adlandırılan dikkate değer bir aile hikayesini de gün yüzüne çıkardı.

DNA verileri, anne, baba, erkek kardeş ve iki kızıyla aynı mezarlıkta yatan bu kadının biyolojik bağlarını doğruladı. Ancak "Lady 56"nın mezarında, Orta Çağ İskandinavya’sında son derece nadir görülen bir deniz kabuğu bulundu. Bu kabuk, Orta Çağ Avrupa’sının en ünlü hac rotalarından biri olan İspanya’daki Santiago de Compostela hacılığının sembolü olarak biliniyor.

Henüz 30 yaşına basmadan hayatını kaybeden bu genç kadının, Jamtland’daki köyünden çıkıp binlerce kilometre yol katederek Hristiyan Avrupa’sının en batı ucuna hac yolculuğu yaptığı ve ardından memleketine dönerek hayatını kaybettiği değerlendiriliyor.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Jorge Macri disputa el voto a la LLA actuando contra los sectores populares
content:
Jorge Macri disputa el voto a la LLA en la interna de la derecha porteña actuando contra los sectores populares


Mario Hernandez


El Gobierno de la Ciudad envió un protocolo que obliga a las directoras a denunciar a estudiantes que “podrían estar cometiendo un delito”. Mientras presiona a juezas por televisión y militariza los barrios, ahora Macri quiere que las escuelas sean prisiones.


En una clara persecución a los jóvenes y una medida casi fascista, el gobierno de la Ciudad envió un protocolo a las escuelas que obliga a las conducciones de las escuelas a denunciar a estudiantes que “podrían estar cometiendo un delito”.


La circular llegó a las escuelas de parte de la Ministra de Educación porteña, Mercedes Miguel para informar sobre cómo aplicar el nuevo Régimen Penal Juvenil en las escuelas de la Ciudad. Régimen por el cual se aprobó la imputabilidad a los 14 años.


En el comienzo del mensaje que llegó por correo electrónico, Miguel informa cómo va a actuar desde el Ministerio para “resguardar la vida escolar y el bienestar de nuestras escuelas”. En lugar de fortalecer los equipos de orientación escolar para contener los graves problemas sociales de los jóvenes Jorge Macri a través de su ministra en Educación les declara la guerra a las principales víctimas de sus políticas que nada tienen que envidiarle a las de Milei.


Desde la agrupación 9 de abril advierten que es “un paso más en la confirmación de un estado policíaco que Macri está imponiendo a la Ciudad”. Además, militarizando los barrios y reprimiendo como se vio en el operativo Tormenta Negra.


Operativo “Tormenta Negra II”


 


Vecinos y vecinas de los barrios denunciaron el secuestro de mercaderías y pertenencias como materiales de construcción, colchones y carros por parte de Espacio Público, también la detención ilegal y al boleo de vecinos y trabajadores. Desde las villas 1.11.14, 21-24 y la 31 (entre otras) llegaron las primeras denuncias y videos.


Alejandrina Barry, legisladora porteña con mandato cumplido por el PTS en el FITU y con una trayectoria de casi 20 años como operadora social en la 21-24, respondió duramente al cinismo de Jorge Macri y su “ley y orden”.


Desde la Coordinadora contra los Desalojos y por la Vivienda Digna que vienen enfrentando los desalojos ilegales de Jorge Macri y su ladero “el desalojador” Walter Gómez Diz tambien criticaron fuertemente el operativo. “Repudiamos enérgicamente a estos gobiernos hambreadores y enemigos de los laburantes y la gente humilde. El mismo gobierno que en las calles de la Ciudad arremete contra vendedores ambulantes, jubilados, docentes y toda aquella organización de los de abajo. Ya les demostramos con una enorme Marcha de la Bronca que fuimos miles los que salimos a la calle. Repudiamos y nos solidarizamos con lxs vecinos del @movdevillasybarriospopulares”, replicaron en su comunicado.


Docentes, trabajadores de la salud y vecinos cortaron la calle en repudio al operativo en la 21-24


Después de ver cómo sus alumnos llegaban al colegio espantados por el operativo policial de la noche anterior, organizaron junto a trabajadores del Cesac y vecinos cortar la calle Iriarte en las inmediaciones del barrio para repudiar la escalada represiva de Jorge Macri contra los sectores más abandonados por el Estado.


En la tarde noche del jueves, de forma intempestiva se dieron operativos en 15 barrios y villas porteñas, entre ellas la 21-24. Con un despliegue de saturación policial, Jorge Macri reeditó el operativo Tormenta Negra del pasado 15 de mayo. Con policías de la Ciudad, Infantería, helicópteros, motos, cuatriciclos y camiones jaula durante horas montaron su show represivo el mismo día en que el Indec publicaba que 1 de cada 3 habitantes es pobre en la Argentina de Milei. Esa fue la respuesta del Macri para los vecinos y vecinas de los barrios populares al hambre, endeudamiento, precariedad laboral y estructural que sufren.


Federico Puy, docente de una de las escuelas del barrio, integrante del Consejo Directivo de Ademys, estuvo a la cabeza de organizar esta acción de repudio que debe multiplicarse. Junto a otros docentes, trabajadores de la salud y vecinos del barrio realizaron un semaforazo sobre el cruce de la avenida General Iriarte e Iguazú en el barrio de Barracas, a metros del acceso a la 21-24.

title: Tülay Hatimoğulları: As Kurds, as Alevis, and as women, we demand democratic governance
content:
DEM Party Co-Chair Tülay Hatimoğulları attended the 2nd Ordinary Provincial Congress of the party’s Erzurum Provincial Organization.


‘Every congress is a political breakthrough’


Speaking at the congress, Tülay Hatimoğulları said that the gathering also represented a political breakthrough: “At a time when politics in Turkey is being restructured, and at a time when we are building the Peace and Democratic Society Process, every congress we hold is also a political breakthrough.”


Drawing attention to the ongoing economic crisis and growing impoverishment, Hatimoğulları said that the country was facing extreme poverty as a result of the government’s policies.


‘Turkey has become a hub for major fraud’


“The corruption spree enabled by the government is responsible for the swindle of the century,” Hatimoğulları said. Recalling major fraud scandals of the 1980s and 1990s, she also drew attention to the latest alleged schemes involving Tera and Pusula Holding.


Hatimoğulları said: “Unfortunately, they have turned the country into a hub for major fraud. The stock market scandal was obvious to everyone. The Capital Markets Board knew about it. The state knew, the government knew. Everyone knew, but they turned a blind eye to it.”


Stating that Turkey is now among the countries experiencing the most severe levels of poverty, Hatimoğulları said: “This cannot go on. This system will change. This system is taking our lives, our property, our bread, and our food away from us. In its place, we will build a fair and democratic system in these lands, where no one goes hungry and where everyone can return home with food and fresh bread for their spouse and children. We will build this on the foundations of rights, the rule of law, and justice.”


‘Framework law has provided a very important opportunity’


Responding to questions about the framework law and the peace process, Tülay Hatimoğulları said: “This framework law has provided a very important opportunity for all of Turkey. But it is an opportunity only if it is properly implemented. If concrete steps are not taken in the practical processes set out by this framework law, we will all lose this process together. Therefore, those responsible and the parties involved, particularly the state and the government, must act with an awareness of their duties and responsibilities.”


“The peoples of Turkey have been waiting for more than a century for the vision set out at the Erzurum Congress to be put into practice,” Hatimoğulları said, adding: “The Peace and Democratic Society Process is not, and cannot be, an approach in which one nation, one perspective, or one people is pushed aside. Nor can it be pursued with a ‘one step forward, five steps back’ mentality. In this process, we must never look backward. Everyone must always look forward.”


‘The law must be put into practice in October’


Tülay Hatimoğulları said: “With the verification and determination process being completed swiftly, the framework law being formally linked to a National Security Council decision, and its implementation through publication in the Official Gazette, the necessary step will be taken. It must be taken; there should be no waiting on this matter.”


“Turkey must be able to resolve the Kurdish question through peaceful and democratic means and take concrete steps in this regard,” Hatimoğulları said, adding: “These concrete conditions require us to do so.”


‘We will win through struggle’


Hatimoğulları said: “The success of this process will not come by simply watching and waiting, saying, ‘Let’s see what happens.’ Our valued comrades and friends who are carrying out the struggle within the DEM Party have no reason to wait. The peace process will not be handed to us on a silver platter. We will win through struggle. Believe me, however great the struggle we waged in the past and however heavy the price that was paid, we must now work even harder and organize ourselves even more strongly.”


‘We must now turn political and legal gains into concrete achievements’


Tülay Hatimoğulları continued: “Mr. Abdullah Öcalan’s Call for Peace and a Democratic Society has opened the door to an entirely new process. Until now, the Kurdish people have been forced to wage a struggle for their very existence, but the whole world has now seen their dignified existence. author: Xandan Gulley
title: “Restrictive Housing” Is Wielded as Punishment Against Trans People in Prison
content:
I am being locked up 23 hours a day with no human interaction. I believe I am being punished for being transgender.

I am being locked up 23 hours a day with no human interaction. I believe I am being punished for being transgender.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

Ever since Donald Trump returned to office, the LGBTQIA community’s human rights have been disregarded and we’ve had little protection against incursions from the government. As Trump incessantly tests the boundaries of power, the few rights trans people once had while incarcerated are now obsolete.

Deep-red Texas, meanwhile, has dehumanized incarcerated trans people by depriving us of both liberty and gender expression. Being incarcerated in Texas puts targets on the backs of trans people and a bullseye on our heads.

For starters, violations of any kind against incarcerated trans people are generally ignored, uninvestigated, and treated as insignificant. Freedom of speech, expression, and religion is nonexistent. Solidarity and protection for trans people has become extinct behind bars. Not only do prison staff not protect trans people, but prison culture actually promotes violence against trans people. Within the Texas prison system, trans people have to fend for themselves in an unprotected and unsafe environment. I know from experience.

As a F2M transgender person (trans man) diagnosed with gender dysphoria in a Texas women’s prison in 2017 by University of Texas Medical Branch, I’ve been subjected to forced isolation and marginalization. Policies and practices are implemented with hostility toward trans people. For instance, I was a victim of prolonged solitary confinement from 2012 to 2021. I fought for my release from solitary confinement for years only to be placed in “restrictive housing” once Trump’s administration took over in 2025. Restrictive housing is the same as solitary confinement: I am locked up 23 hours a day with no human interaction. Prison administrators say they placed me here for my own safety. But I believe I am being punished for being transgender.

The hatred of, fear of, or discrimination against trans people based on their gender identity or expression has taken a turn for the worse in Texas prisons. Discrimination, harassment, and violence against trans people in Texas prisons has heightened since the Trump administration has been in power. I suffer disproportionate harm, from the risk of retaliatory assaults to predatorial sexual violence, poor health care, and inadequate mental health attention. Since complaints to the prison ombudsman are downplayed and grievances are uninvestigated, trans people’s welfare and safety is a daily gamble. I have filed ombudsman complaints with no response, and I have a pending civil case in the Southern District of Texas.

Although I am one of the rare fortunate few trans people who has access to gender-affirming care, attaining my access is a weekly struggle. I have hormonal therapy from the University of Texas Medical Branch, and I’m prescribed weekly doses of testosterone injections. Since I’m in restrictive housing, I have to be escorted everywhere in handcuffs by an officer. But the prisons are understaffed, so officers are often unavailable. This leaves me on numerous occasions without an escort, so I’m unable to obtain my medical treatment. Many times, I go weeks without my injections. There have been times when officers are available but they refuse to escort me.

And then, unfortunately, there have been multiple times officers escort me to medical only to then viciously assault me as I’m being led back to my cell. I’m punched, kicked, and spit on while invectives and transphobic slurs are yelled at me. The oppression that consists of not only verbal abuse but also of mental injury, emotional turmoil, and physical assault is the norm for trans people in restrictive housing.

Harmful is its own right, restrictive housing allows officers and staff to get away unscathed with their abusive actions toward trans people. Prison staff engage in retaliatory and discriminatory behavior, initiate violence, make threats, and indulge in other misconduct toward those held captive in solitary confinement. author: Brian Dolinar
title: Incarcerated Women Are Pushing for Decarceration, Not “Trauma-Informed” Prisons
content:
Organizers discuss how they are fighting new women’s prisons in Vermont, Massachusetts, and Illinois.

Organizers discuss how they are fighting new women’s prisons in Vermont, Massachusetts, and Illinois.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

As abolitionists across the United States push for decarceration, a backlash has emerged in the form of new prison construction, demonstrating the resiliency of mass incarceration. Several new women’s prisons are being built despite a growing chorus of voices arguing that prisons only inflict more harm on women who have already endured abuse and trauma.

Last year, a new prison to hold nearly 1,000 women was opened in Louisiana to replace the prison that flooded almost a decade earlier. What the news media described as a “campus” (a word used to conflate imprisonment with voluntary settings like colleges and corporate parks) includes a rehabilitation center, classrooms, and a delivery room for women forced to have their babies in prison. In Maine, a new “reentry center” for women was completed in 2017. “Ideally we’d like to say that we don’t need prisons,” then-Gov. Paul LePage said at the grand opening. “But if we’re going to have prisons, this is the type of prison that we need…”

Truthout spoke with activists fighting the construction of new women’s prisons in Vermont, Massachusetts, and Illinois, who said they recognized similar trends. In Vermont, a proposal by the legislature for a new prison for women in Essex was halted last year when activists convinced the local planning commission to rule against a zoning request. In Massachusetts, after calls for a prison moratorium failed, Gov. Maura Healey announced in 2025 a plan to “re-imagine” the women’s prison there. In Illinois, Gov. JB Pritzker and the Illinois Department of Corrections launched in 2024 what is dubbed “RISE IDOC” to build two new prisons, including a new women’s prison with a “gender-responsive” design.

Supporters of prison construction are billing these new facilities for women as “trauma-informed,” “gender-responsive,” and “rehabilitative.” They illustrate attempts to repackage mass incarceration as what author and activist James Kilgore coined “carceral humanism,” or what Angela Davis has described as “carceral feminism.”

“All of this stuff about trauma-informed prisons is a lie,” said Monica Cosby, who spent 20 years incarcerated in Illinois and is now working with the group No New Prisons Illinois to stop the building of a new women’s prison in her state. “It’s both absurd and obscene.”

In Vermont, the political momentum for reform at the Chittenden Regional Correctional Facility for women in South Burlington was redirected to a plan for new prison construction. A white paper released in 2012 detailed the “disturbing conditions” there that prompted the state legislature to intervene. Instead of sentencing reform or much-needed mental and medical services, legislators chose to build a new prison.

“Our knee-jerk reaction is still prison construction,” said Jayna Ahsaf, founder of Project Abolition and former campaign director of FreeHer Vermont.

The plan for a new prison to hold about 100 women initially costing between $50 and $60 million was eventually approved by the legislature in 2021. In response, a small group of abolitionists launched the campaign FreeHer Vermont, backed by the National Council for Incarcerated and Formerly Incarcerated Women and Girls, in October 2022.

In 2024, the city of Essex was picked as the site for the new prison. Before long, the price tag for the prison, which would be located about 20 miles from the Chittenden prison, had risen to $97 million. FreeHer waged what Ahsaf called a “hyper-local” campaign to convince the planning commission in Essex that the chosen site was not zoned for a prison. Organizers canvassed in the downtown area, handed out zines, held phone banks, and spoke before the planning commission. Every step of the way, she said, they involved incarcerated and formerly incarcerated women.

On March 20, 2025, FreeHer held a press conference at the state capitol building in Montpelier where organizers and service providers spoke along with formerly incarcerated women, including Tiffany Harrington, who gave firsthand testimony.

“The excuse that it’s a trauma-informed prison or a compassionate facility [is] a pile of crap,” said Harrington …

author: David Swanson
title: Cyclist Mumbere Masaisai Dies While Cycling for Peace in Congo
content:
Credit:

Medi1news


By Guy Feugap, World BEYOND War’s Africa Organizer, September 27, 2026


Miguel Mumbere Masaisai, 23, died on September 18, 2026, in a traffic accident in the northern part of the Republic of the Congo while cycling from Goma in the DRC to Rabat in Morocco. The Congolese cyclist from the Democratic Republic of the Congo was known for his cross-Africa bike rides as part of the “Pedals for Peace” initiative, dedicated to promoting peace and unity. His sudden death sent shockwaves across Africa; we consider him yet another victim of the war that has been ravaging his country for years. World BEYOND War salutes this young man committed to peace in Africa.


As a reminder, the Democratic Republic of Congo is caught up in a violent conflict fueled over the past three decades by political instability, resource exploitation and foreign interference. On January 27, 2025,

 the provincial capital of North Kivu, Goma, was seized by the M23 rebels

 alongside which the

Rwandan army

 has been intervening since the beginning of 2024. The World BEYOND War chapter in South Kivu (DRC), the Peace Organization for Development Opportunities (OPOD/asbl) and all of the World BEYOND War chapters in Africa have condemned the atrocities in DRC and called on the United Nations to urgently take action to address this critical situation.


On June 27, 2025, a

 peace agreement

 was signed between the DRC and Rwanda under the aegis of the United States. Although it marks a step forward in the peace process, it raises doubts about the real intention to break with the logic of exploitation and interference that has fueled these conflicts. Regarding the agreement, we keep calling for:


Total transparency of the clauses of the agreement;


Meaningful participation of Congolese and Rwandan civil society in the implementation process;


A moratorium on mining in conflict areas until a local citizen control mechanism is put in place;


The cessation of hostilities and the immediate withdrawal of Rwandan troops from Congolese territory;


The full restoration of State authority in occupied areas, the respect of the DRC’s territorial integrity and border inviolability, and genuine bilateral cooperation based on mutual respect;


The guarantee of national security and public peace, as well as the unhindered movement of people and goods across the country;


A military disengagement with support focused on social reconstruction and restorative justice.


Mumbere Masaisai’s death should draw even more attention to the situation in the DRC. Join us in maintaining active vigilance on the DRC peace process.


Send a letter to the Office of the UN Secretary General!

title: Excavation work at mass grave in Shengal Cemetery completed
content:
The Martyrs Institution announced that excavation work at the mass grave in Şerfedîn Cemetery, located in the Sinûnê subdistrict of Shengal, which began six days ago, has been completed.


On the final day of the excavation, specialist technical and forensic teams affiliated with the Directorate for the Excavation and Preservation of Monuments and Mass Graves carefully carried out the recovery of the remains. The work was conducted in accordance with international technical and forensic standards, rules and protocols, with due regard for the dignity of those who lost their lives.


Following their recovery, the remains were handed over to the Forensic Medicine Department of the Iraqi Ministry of Health after the completion of the official and legal documentation process. The final stage of the examination of the remains will be completed at the Ministry of Health’s Forensic Medicine Department.


DNA samples collected from families who lost loved ones will be compared and matched with biological data obtained from the remains. Once their identities have been established, the remains will be handed over to their families so that they can hold farewell ceremonies in accordance with their traditions and beliefs.


On the final day of the excavation, the relevant institutions provided families who had lost loved ones and civil society organizations with information about the technical procedures followed during the work, as well as the social and humanitarian values underpinning it. The work, led by the Martyrs Institution, was reportedly carried out in accordance with a policy of direct transparency.


The mass grave at Şerfedîn Cemetery contained the remains of people who had been buried there after being recovered from mass graves in Xanesor, Berdiyê and other areas of the subdistrict.

author: Unknown
title: Evin Women’s Cooperative: A space for solidarity and production in Van
content:
Women in cities across Kurdistan are participating in social and economic life through cooperatives in response to policies rooted in a male-dominated mentality that seek to exclude women from public life.


NûJINHA published a feature about women taking part in production through cooperatives in many cities. Among the cooperatives are the Ortak Yaşam Women’s Cooperative in Mazıdağ (Şemrex), Mardin (Mêrdîn), and the Varto Hafızası Women’s Initiative Production and Business Cooperative in Varto (Gimgim), Muş (Mûş). In Van (Wan), women at the Evin Women’s Cooperative, established in 2015, aim to make women’s labour visible and develop collective production.


Şehriban Adsaz, a fashion design graduate who has worked at the cooperative as an instructor and producer for the past three years, spoke to NûJINHA about the work they carried out.


From seven women to 20


Şehriban Adsaz said the cooperative began its work with seven women and that the number later grew to 20. Adsaz said it was very important to her to bring out the potential women already possess and continued: “Our cooperative is not merely a business model; it is a platform for solidarity where women support one another, produce together and make decisions together. We carry out our work on the basis of collective working methods and the spirit of cooperation. We aim to expand women’s social spaces so that they can create a freer, more equal, democratic and principled environment within society. We do not simply produce goods here. With every stitch and at every stage of production, we make women’s historical and social labour visible again. We are trying to show, both locally and at the broader social level, what women can build and what they can change when they come together. This is where cooperativization and communal organization begin.”


There is nothing we cannot achieve


Şehriban Adsaz said they had received positive feedback from the women involved in the cooperative’s work: “Because this is a space where women can be free, the women we work with say they feel free here and are able to express themselves more comfortably. I believe there is nothing that women anywhere in the world cannot achieve if they set their minds to it. We want to bring more women together through our cooperative and are continuing our work towards that goal.”

author: Unknown
title: Kurdish entrepreneurs discuss economy and political process in Switzerland
content:
Kurdish entrepreneurs from Switzerland, Germany, and France gathered in Egerkingen, Switzerland, for a meeting on economic prospects, new technologies, and the role of the diaspora. The conference, organized by the Swiss Democratic Employers’ Association (SDAV), focused primarily on artificial intelligence and its economic applications. However, the discussion also expanded to include the economic development of Kurdistan and the peace and democratic society process.


Participants in the event in the canton of Solothurn included DEM Party parliamentary group deputy chair Sezai Temelli; economist and former HDP MP Erol Katırcıoğlu; Hasan Siral, chair of the Association of Kurdish Entrepreneurs in Germany (AKEE); and AKEE board member Leylan Uca. Abdullah Ülmez, deputy chair of the Association of Kurdish Businesspeople in France (UEFK), and other board members also traveled from France to attend the meeting.


Artificial intelligence and the economy of tomorrow


Opening the event, SDAV board member Eyyüp Kavak said the association was closely following developments in Kurdistan and supported the ongoing political process. At the same time, he said they wanted to explore how Kurdish entrepreneurs could make use of artificial intelligence and technological developments.


SDAV chair Jordi Alvarez then outlined the economic conditions in Switzerland. He identified the country’s democratic structures and political stability as among its key strengths.


Two speakers, Joshua Bonacorsi and Cem Haligür, addressed the opportunities and risks associated with artificial intelligence. They warned entrepreneurs not to overlook technological developments when planning for the future. What mattered, they said, was not only the technology itself but how it was used. As an analogy, they pointed to a knife, which is designed to cut food but can also be used to kill a person. Similarly, with artificial intelligence, the crucial question is the purpose for which it is used, they noted.


Katırcıoğlu: Democratization and economic development go hand in hand


Erol Katırcıoğlu then focused on regional income disparities in Turkey and the economic situation in Kurdish regions. He said inequality was evident both between different social groups and between regions. Kurdish regions, he noted, continued to rank among the most economically disadvantaged areas. Referring to studies on income distribution, Katırcıoğlu drew a connection between democratic development and economic justice.


“When we look at the 24 years of AKP rule, the injustice in income distribution becomes very clear. There is both vertical and horizontal inequality. Our research clearly demonstrates this picture. The regions where Kurds live are the least developed.”


Katırcıoğlu said that regional disparities in income distribution had been at their lowest during the years when Turkey adopted reform legislation as part of its EU accession process. From this, he drew a broader conclusion: “Income distribution and democratic development are two factors that reinforce each other.”


Kurdish question also has an economic dimension


The economist also views the current peace and democratic society process from this perspective. He said the Kurdish question was not solely an issue of identity and political recognition, but also had an economic dimension.


“There are problems in this process. In my view, the necessary steps have not yet been taken by the state and the government. But despite everything, this problem must be resolved. The Kurdish question is the question of the identity of a people whose existence was denied. Alongside this question of identity, however, it is also to a considerable extent an economic question.”


For this reason in particular, Katırcıoğlu attaches special importance to meetings of Kurdish entrepreneurs. He said such gatherings should take place more frequently. As the political process develops further, Kurdish capital from the diaspora could also return and be invested in economically disadvantaged regions, he added.


Temelli: Political and economic struggle go hand in hand


Sezai Temelli placed the historical dimension of the Kurdish question at the center of his speech. He said the past century had been marked by policies of denial, destruction, and assimilation. Among the historical milestones he cited were the Şark Islahat Planı (Reform Plan for the East), adopted in 1925 following the suppression of the Şêx Seîd uprising, which, under …

author: Unknown
title: Heyva Sor a Kurdistanê-Italia celebrates 11th anniversary in Livorno
content:
Kurdish Red Crescent Heyva Sor a Kurdistanê-Italia celebrated its 11th anniversary on Saturday evening with a well-attended event at the historic Fortezza Vecchia in Livorno. Representatives of Kurdish and Italian organizations reflected on the solidarity work carried out over the past years. The event continued with Kurdish cuisine, music, and Kurdish traditional dance Govend.


Following an opening by moderator Melenia Carnavale, speakers included Ali Can Yıldız, chair of the Italian section of the Kurdish Red Crescent, and its secretary, Barbara Mancini. The event was also attended by Abdulkarim Omar, who is responsible for Rojava’s foreign relations; representatives of Heyva Sor a Kurdistanê in Germany and the Kurdistan Information Office; as well as representatives of Un Ponte Per and the Waldensian Church.


Other participants included Dr. Sherwan Bery of Heyva Sor a Kurd in Rojava, Giulia Torrini of the Italian Health Committee for Rojava, and Comas Nebot of the Barcelona city administration.


Eleven years of cross-border solidarity


The speeches reflected on the work of Heyva Sor a Kurdistanê-Italia since its establishment. Particular emphasis was placed on the ties that have developed between Kurdish and Italian society, as well as the various aid and solidarity projects carried out over the years.


Special attention was given to the solidarity shown during the attacks on Kobanê and to the support provided for reconstruction efforts and for addressing the social consequences of the war in Rojava.


Abdulkarim Omar addressed the current situation in Rojava. He said that the threats facing the region had not ended ,noting that efforts to protect the achievements made so far and to build a democratic Syria would continue. Representatives of solidarity organizations emphasized the importance of international networks in preserving Rojava’s social and political achievements.


Narinxan and Serhado take the stage


Following the political part of the event, the focus shifted to culture and collective celebration. Kurdish families had prepared food for the guests. Kurdish musician Narinxan and rapper Serhado then took the stage. Participants danced Govend together to their music within the historic fortress complex.


The anniversary celebration at the Fortezza Vecchia continued until late in the evening.

title: Mardin’de çıkan kavgada 6 kişi yaralandı
content:
Mardin’in Kızıltepe ilçesi kırsal Yalınkılıç Mahallesi’nde, akraba oldukları tespit edilen 2 aile arasında öğle saatlerinde henüz bilinmeyen bir nedenle tartışma çıktı. Tartışma bir süre sonra taşların ve sopaların da kullanıldığı kavgaya dönüştü.

Olayda K.G. (50), M.G. (47), C.G. (40), Ö.G. (36), E.G. (27) ve M.G. (25) yaralandı. İhbar üzerine bölgeye çok sayıda sağlık ve jandarma ekibi sevk edildi. Jandarma ekipleri tarafları ayırıp güvenlik önlemi aldı.

Yaralılar, sağlık görevlilerinin ilk müdahalesinin ardından ambulanslarla kaldırıldıkları Kızıltepe Devlet Hastanesi’nde tedaviye alındı. Yaralıların sağlık durumlarının iyi olduğu belilrtildi. Olayla ilgili inceleme başlatıldı.

author: Unknown
title: Aziz Yıldırım’dan Saran yönetimine eleştiri: Fenerbahçe'nin malına çökme var
content:
Fenerbahçe Spor Kulübü Olağan Mali Genel Kurul Toplantısı, Ülker Spor ve Etkinlik Salonu’nda düzenlendi. Raporların, okunup görüşülmesinin ardından Fenerbahçe Başkanı Aziz Yıldırım kürsüde konuştu.

Futbol takımını şampiyon yaparak görevini bırakacağını söyleyen Yıldırım, “Fenerbahçe tarihinin en önemli mali kongresinin başlangıcını yapacağız. Herkes her şeyi bilecek. Medyadan değil, burada öğreneceğiz. Ne dedim, ‘1 sene sonra bırakacağım.’ Bunlarla uğraşmak istemiyorum. Ben doğru yaptığıma inandığım için ibra, mahkeme hiçbirinden korkmam. Benim tereddüdüm yok, 1 sene sonra şampiyon yaparak bırakacağım. Avrupa’ya katılacağız dedik. 18 sene sonra arkadaşlarım, futbol takımı, teknik direktörü, Oğuz Çetin’le birlikte bunu başardılar” ifadelerini kullandı.

Önceki yönetime transfer ödemeleri üzerinden eleştirilerde bulunan Aziz Yıldırım, “Gelelim Sadettin Bey ve yönetimine; paraları yemişsiniz. En-Nesyri’yi Ali Koç 19 milyon euroya satın almış. Bunun da 6 milyon daha bonservisi ödenmemiş. Nisan ayında taksiti geliyor, siz de ödememişsiniz. UEFA’dan yazı geliyor haziran ayının 15’inde. Arkadaşlar getirdi, bunu ödememiz lazım, ödüyoruz. Kulübe ne kadar para girdi, neler oldu hepsini anlatacağım. Ödemiyorsunuz, ceza geliyor. Birinciyi ödedim, ikinciyi de imzaladık gönderdik. 6 milyon euro biz ödüyoruz bu yönetim olarak. Nereye harcadınız bu parayı onu da siz anlatın” diye konuştu.

Sidiki Cherif’in transfer süreçlerine değinen Yıldırım, “Sidiki Cherif’i sattık. Hasan Çetinkaya’ya, Cihan Kamer’e, Oğuz Çetin’e teşekkür ediyorum. Oyuncuyu, bu futbolcu diye gelip almadılar. Hasan’ın tanıdığı vasıtasıyla 25 milyon euroya sattık. Gitti, gittiği takımda oynayamıyor” dedi.

Fenerbahçe Üniversitesi hakkında da açıklamalarda bulunan Aziz Yıldırım, sözlerini şöyle sürdürdü: “Üniversite Fenerbahçe’nin değil artık Medicana’nın. Sustunuz. Suç işlediniz, 10 sene daha sözleşmeyi uzattınız? Fenerbahçe’nin malına çökme var. Bizim olduğumuz yerde kimse çökemez. Fenerbahçe’de iyilik yapana saygı duyarız. Ama siz yönetim olarak suçlusunuz. Bundan dolayı sizi ibra etmeyeceğim. Anonim şirkette de yapmayacağım. Siz Fenerbahçe’nin haklarını savunun. Gelin buraya bu yanlıştır deyin hep beraber düzeltelim. Fenerbahçe’nin malı elden gitmiş, Fenerbahçe malın sahibi değil. 400 bin euro almak için 10 sene niye uzattınız?" ifadelerini kullandı.

Aziz Yıldırım sözlerini; “Fenerbahçe’nin parası çok, şu anda 77 milyon Avro kasada para var haberiniz olsun” diyerek noktaladı.

Aziz Yıldırım, konuşmasının sonunda eski Başkan Saadettin Saran dönemi yönetim kurulu üyelerinden İlker Aksun’u kürsüye davet ederek belirttiği konulara ilişkin bilgi vermesini istedi. Aksun, Yıldırım’ın konuşmasının son bölümünde davet üzerine kürsüye geldi. Aksun, Yıldırım'ın konuşmasının ardından salona hitap etmek üzere kürsüde kaldı.

author: CNT Valladolid
title: Contra el negocio de la vivienda, las trabajadoras tomamos las calles
content:
Convocadas por el Sindicato de Vivienda de Valladolid, miles de trabajadoras ocupamos el viernes 25 de septiembre las calles de Valladolid. El motivo inmediato fue el escándalo del desalojo de una vecina de Madrid de más de ochenta años, denunciado con gran repercusión por el Sindicato de Inquilinas gracias a una cuidada campaña. Era inevitable concentrarse en Valladolid por tener en la ciudad sede la empresa beneficiaria del desahucio, Urbagesa (c / Santiago, 9), pero necesariamente evolucionó a algo más amplio contra la política de vivienda que nos exprime para aumentar los beneficios capitalistas.


La movilización pronto empezó a cobrar una repercusión a la que la policía, como pilar del Estado, respondió según su vocación, con violencia contra las trabajadoras. Pero si el gobierno suelta a la policía para intentar intimidar a las trabajadoras solidarias, y si quienes se lucran con los alquileres y las compraventas financian a los matones «desokupa» para intimidar a nuestras vecinas… pueden todos esperar sentados.


Dejando aparte la exigencia de responsabilidades por las agresiones policiales, que pronto va a a llegar, está claro que la solidaridad de la clase trabajadora cada vez cobra más fuerza y que retroceder no es una opción. No podemos sino avanzar.


Como ha expresado el colectivo Marabunta:


Ayer Valladolid volvió a demostrar que, con una clase obrera organizada, el miedo cambia de bando.


Nos quieren inculcar que la vivienda es un bien con el que mercadear, pero ni nuestros hogares ni nuestras vidas son un bien especulativo con el que hacer negocio.


Frente a su mercantilización de los bienes básicos, cuya punta son los desahucios, los alquileres impagables y una vida cada vez más precaria y tóxica, solo tenemos una salida: organización obrera y lucha colectiva.


Ningún derecho nos llegó regalado. Cada conquista de la clase trabajadora nace de la unión de las gentes y de la organización de la rabia para tomar las calles y recuperar el control de nuestras vidas.


Ayer no hubo miedo suficiente para hacernos retroceder ni un solo paso.


Ayer la dignidad obrera estuvo en las calles poniendo el cuerpo y a pesar de la violencia de los matones con placa, nadie consiguió que dejásemos de luchar por la solidaridad y el apoyo mutuo.


Porque cuando la rabia deja de ser individual y se convierte en fuerza colectiva, se vuelve peligrosa para quienes viven de nuestro miedo y nuestra precariedad.


Ayer fueron las calles, pero ha de arder en rabia cada barrio, cada fondo buitre, cada centro de trabajo….


Organízate – Con tus vecinas. – Con tu sindicato. – Con tu colectivo. – Con tu coordinadora. – Con tus amigas.


Organízate para defender tu casa, tus derechos y frente a aquellos que quieren especular y hacer negocio de nuestras propias vidas.


Porque los derechos no se legislan en ningún despacho, se conquistan en las calles.


Que lo ocurrido ayer se haga costumbre: que sea costumbre la lucha, la conciencia de clase y la organización obrera.


La organización convocante, Sindicato de Vivienda de Valladolid, ha valorado así la manifestación:


Valoramos muy positivamente la respuesta de hoy ante nuestra convocatoria urgente de concentración para señalar a los culpables de la situación en la que se encuentra la vivienda para la clase trabajadora.


El desahucio de Mari Carmen ha sido una gota que ha desbordado un vaso que ya estaba desde hace tiempo al límite. Nuestra organización lleva años librando pequeñas batallas en cientos de casos de atropellos de rentistas y propietarios.


Por ello no podíamos dejar pasar la oportunidad de solidarizarnos con este escandaloso caso de las compañeras del sindicato de inquilinas de Madrid y de señalar a los culpables de este caso: Urbagestion

.


La concentración se ha desbordado dando lugar a una manifestación espontánea, movida por el descontento generalizado por la situación de la vivienda y el enfado ante la represión de la policia.


La respuesta de las fuerzas de seguridad del Estado ha sido desproporcionadamente violenta. Las imágenes hablan por sí solas: las unidades de intervención policial han atacado la cabecera de la manifestación en la plaza Zorrilla, sin que hubiera habido incidente alguno.


Tal y como pasó el miércoles en el desahucio de Mari Carmen, vemos cómo la policía bajo las órdenes del Ministerio de Interior actúan de una manera absolutamente desproporcionada ante el movimiento de vivienda.


Los responsables políticos de estas actuaciones …

author: Operation Münsterland
title: Wandern im "Lille Norge" bei Saltum – Dänemarks kleines Norwegen!
content:
Willkommen zu einem neuen Wanderabenteuer! Heute wandern wir in dem idyllischen Naturschutzgebiet Lille Norge („Klein-Norwegen“) bei Saltum an der nordjütländischen Jammerbucht in Dänemark.


Warum heißt diese Gegend eigentlich Lille Norge? Der Überlieferung nach verdankt das Gebiet seinen Namen einem einst hier lebenden Schifffahrtskapitän, der extremes Heimweh nach seiner norwegischen Heimat hatte. Als er die steilen Dünen- und Hügelketten sah, fühlte er sich sofort an das norwegische Fjell erinnert!


Auf unserem Rundweg geht es durch:


🌲 Mystische Naturwälder – urige Nadelwälder, verwunschenes Totholz und knarrende Bäume.


🟣 Weite Heideflächen – blühende Landschaften und typisch nordisches Panorama.


🌊 Dünentäler & Küstennähe – hügelige Pfade direkt im Hinterland der Jammerbucht.


Viel Spaß beim Zuschauen und Mitwandern! Hinterlasse gerne einen Daumen nach oben, wenn dir das Video gefallen hat, und aboniere den Kanal, um keine Abenteuer an der Nordsee zu verpassen! 🔔


ℹ️ Hintergrund-Infos zur Region:


Lage: Bei Saltum/Ejersted an der Jammerbucht (Nordjütland).


Entstehung: Die Landschaft wurde maßgeblich durch die Eiszeit und stetige Flugsandbewegungen geprägt.


Besonderheit: Hügeliges, leicht bergiges Terrain, das sich deutlich vom flachen dänischen Umland abhebt.

author: Unknown
title: Great turned out on first day of Amed’s 10th Book Fair
content:
The 10th Amed Book Fair, organized by TÜYAP Fair Organization Group in cooperation with the Publishers Association of Turkey and with the support of the Amed Chamber of Commerce and Industry (DTSO), opened on Saturday at the Mesopotamia International Fair and Congress Center. The fair will run until 4 October, and its opening day attracted considerable interest. Hundreds of people attended the opening, alongside representatives of political parties and civil society organizations.


125 publishers and civil society organizations present at the fair


The opening speech was delivered by Ilhan Ersözlü, General Manager of TÜYAP Fairs Organization Inc. and President of the Turkish Fair Organizers Association. Ersözlü said that the previous nine book fairs had attracted more than 1.5 million visitors in total, with approximately 1,300 exhibitors participating. He noted that 125 publishing houses and civil society organizations are taking part in this year’s 10th fair.


The presence of the publishers participating here is extremely valuable to us all


Nazlı Berivan Ak, Secretary General of the Publishers Association of Turkey, addressed the audience. “We are representatives of a tradition that stretches from dengbêjs [Kurdish traditional singers and storytellers], folk poets and writers to the present day. The greatest significance of this fair today lies in the fact that young people and children will be here. That is very important. The presence of the publishers participating here is extremely valuable to us all,” she said.


Jehat Rojhilat, a member of the board of the Kurdish Publishers Association, provided information about the organization. “If there are 30–40 million Kurds in Turkey and Kurdish is still not a language of education, if we are still learning Kurdish in language courses, then just look at the state of Turkish-language publishing around the world and imagine what the situation of Kurdish must be like. That is why we want people to embrace the language; we want a conscience. There is a people of 30–40 million. If they speak a language, they should no longer have to learn that language in courses. Turkish publishers and other publishing houses should offer this support wholeheartedly,” Rojhilat said.


Mehmet Kaya, President of the Amed Chamber of Commerce and Industry (DTSO), said: “As the DTSO, we provide every kind of support to our publishing houses. But, of course, there is no chance of sustaining this fair through the DTSO’s support alone. The Ministry of Culture, the governor’s office and local administrations must take ownership of this fair. This fair needs to continue in Mesopotamia in a participatory way, because it is not just books that are being exhibited here. There are more than 93 events planned. This is a cultural festival, an event in its own right. It is impossible for it to survive with the support of publishers and the DTSO alone."


The publishers deserve the greatest congratulations for making this fair happen


Serra Bucak, Co-Mayor of Amed Metropolitan Municipality, then addressed the audience. “As a municipality, we are, of course, making efforts to support events of this kind in our city, to contribute to them and to become involved in their content in a meaningful way. We will continue these efforts.


Writers establish connections with a city. They develop many connections that we ourselves may not see, and they open up new windows. The publishers deserve the greatest congratulations for making this fair happen. Persisting here despite all the impossibilities and economic difficulties means recognizing the value of this place. I hope that, in the period ahead, we too will continue to do justice to this special value, together with all the different forces and communities that make up our city,” she said.


I hope this fair will contribute to the freedom of mother tongues


Halide Türkoğlu, spokesperson for the Women’s Assembly of the Peoples’ Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party), said: “I hope this fair will contribute to democracy, the future of young people, women’s freedom and the freedom of mother tongues.”

title: Ill prisoners Mehmet Elçe and Abdülhalik Oral must be released, says the IHD
content:
The Prison Commission of the Istanbul branch of the Human Rights Association (IHD) held its 757th “F Sitting” protest outside the association’s building in Beyoğlu, Istanbul, to draw attention to the health conditions of sick prisoners. The protest highlighted the situation of Mehmet Elçe (62), a sick prisoner with a 93% disability who is being held at Elazığ R-Type Closed Prison.


Numerous relatives of sick prisoners and human rights defenders attended the protest. A banner reading “Release Sick Prisoner Mehmet Elçe” was displayed, and participants chanted slogans including “Release sick prisoners” and “Treatment is a right; it cannot be denied.”


The Initiative for the Freedom of Sick Prisoners gathered on Sakarya Street in Ankara for its 629th weekly protest. This week’s action drew attention to the situation of sick prisoner Abdülhalik Oral, who is being held at Kırıkkale Hacılar F-Type Closed Prison.

title: Nos corps - Nos choix !
content:
Dans le cadre de la journée international du droit à l'avortement le 28 septembre, et contre toutes les attaques contre nos droits et contre nos corps, nous vous proposons de regarder ensemble le film « Regarde, elle a les yeux grand ouverts » à la Dar le 27/09


À travers l'histoire d'un groupe de jeunes femmes d'Aix en Provence découvrant le

MLAC

 et ces pratiques, nous pourrons discuter de l'autonomie de nos corps, des violentes attaques de l'état français et des extrêmes droites sur les droits reproductifs.


Les camarades du planning seront présentes et pour tenir une table !


Rendez-vous à la Dar le dimanche 27 à 18h pour la projection et le lundi 28 à 18h au Vieux-Port pour un rassemblement pour le droit à l'avortement !


Regarde, elle a les yeux grand ouvert


C'est l'histoire de 1975 à 1980, d'un groupe de femmes d'Aix en Provence et de leurs proches maris, compagnons, enfants. Ces femmes découvrent au

MLAC

 (

Mouvement pour la liberté de l'avortement et de la contraception)

 qu'elles peuvent ensemble transformer et vivre autrement des moments aussi importants pour elles que : avorter, accoucher, choisir de faire ou non un enfant. Elles apprennent à le faire elle-mêmes et se heurtent à la répression : en mars 1977, six d'entre elles sont jugées pour exercice illégal de la médecine et pratique illégale de l'avortement.


*attention le film comporte quelques scènes explicites d'accouchement et d'avortement.

title: I think it’s really going to help to actually stop and think about:
content:
gatheringbones

gatheringbones

gatheringbones

gatheringbones

:

I think it’s really going to help to actually stop and think about:

what is the point of acquiring social skills?

like. is there a point beyond base level survival

do people have useful and interesting qualities apart from what they make possible for you

could acquiring social skills have a purpose beyond getting what you need from them to live

can different sets of social skills work against each other?

like say you were conditioned to prioritize certain social groups over others and make the environment inhospitable for the least valued and wanted, so you have a lot of skills for pressuring and triangulating and devaluing and dogpiling and are really good at identifying the weakest link and making them leave.

would that work against other social skills that prioritize access and dignity and quality for stigmatized groups?

wouldn’t you have to actively dismantle certain sets of skills to strengthen others?

okay great you’ve acquired enough social skills to fit in with white cis straight abled neurotypical people of a certain socioeconomic bracket and you’ve successfully separated yourself from anyone that might taint your status and make you vulnerable to outside devaluation—

how long can you keep that up?

how long will it feel like it’s worth it?

title: Adana'da yolcu otobüsü tabela direğine çarptı, 11 kişi yaralandı
content:
Adana'da Ali Osman Ulusoy şirketine ait yolcu otobüsünün, alt geçidin duvarına ve yön tabelasının direğine çarpması sonucu 11 kişi yaralandı.

Kaza, saat 03.30 sıralarında Seyhan ilçesinde otogar alt geçidinin girişinde meydana geldi. Şoförünün direksiyon hakimiyetini kaybettiği Hatay-Giresun seferini yapan 38 YILTUR 005 plakalı yolcu otobüsü, alt geçidin duvarına ve yön tabelasının direğine çarptı. Çevredekilerin ihbarı üzerine kaza yerine polis, sağlık ve itfaiye ekipleri sevk edildi. 35 yolcu ve 3 görevlinin bulunduğu otobüste 11 kişi yaralandı.

10 yaralı ambulanslarla kentteki çeşitli hastanelere kaldırılırken, otobüste sıkışan şoförün kurtarılması için çalışma başlatıldı. İtfaiye erlerinin 2 saat süren çalışmasıyla bulunduğu yerden çıkarılan şoför, ambulans ile Adana Şehir Hastanesine götürüldü.

Kaza sebebiyle otobüslerin otogara geçiş yaptığı yan yol bir süre kapatıldı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Ephéméride des luttes : 27 septembre
content:
La main de l'éphéméride des luttes du 27 septembre se fait sentir dans les oppositions aux fascistes, à leur justice et à la gauche nucléaire. Aujourd'hui, on fait boum et on fait frrrrrrrrrfrfr.


1907 :

 A Cadiz, mort de Fermín Salvochea y Álvarez, figure importante de l'anarchisme et du fédéralisme en Espagne. Il fut considéré comme l'une des têtes de la 'Mano Negra', une organisation anarchiste fictive au centre d'immenses montages judiciaires. Plus de 50.000 personnes assistent à ses funérailles.


1932 :

 Aux États-Unis, la maison du juge Thayer explose en réponse à sa condamnation à mort cinq ans plus tôt des anarchistes italiens Sacco et Vanzetti.


1937 :

 Le tigre de Bali est officiellement reconnu comme espèce éteinte.


1943 :

 A Naples, c'est le début des célèbres quatre journées de Naples : une insurrection populaire chasse les nazis de la ville au bout de quatre jours d'insurrection. Naples (et surtout sa population) est la première ville à se libérer de l'emprise des nazis/fascistes, avant même l'arrivée des troupes américaines.


1975 :

 En Espagne, ce sont les dernières exécutions judiciaires de condamnation à la peine capitale réalisées dans le pays : deux militants d'ETA et trois du FRAP (Front Révolutionnaire Antifasciste Patriote) sont fusillés par les franquistes.


1979 :

 A Paris, attentat revendiqué par Action Directe contre les locaux du patronat chargé de la gestion de l'emploi pour la région.


1982 :

 A Colomiers, près de Toulouse, le domicile du président du Conseil Régional PS Alex Raymond est touché par une explosion le jour de la visite de François Mitterrand à Toulouse. Revendiqué par le GIGN (Groupe d'Intervention contre la Gauche Nucléaire).


1993 :

 A Belfast, l'IRA fait sauter deux bombes de fortes puissance dans les quartiers du centre et du sud, faisant de gros dégâts.


1998 :

 Naissance du moteur de recherche Google.


2006 :

 Dans la ville principale du Koweit, une station de police est totalement incendiée juste avant son inauguration.


2018 :

 Dans la nuit vers le 28, "

Lune blanche, meute noire

" incendient un abattoir à Hotonnes dans l'Ain. Communiqué de revendication à lire sur

Attaque

.


Voir également

l'éphéméride anarchiste

 du 27 septembre.

title: Meteoroloji’den 63 il için sağanak ve fırtına uyarısı
content:
Fotoğraf: Misael Silvera/Unsplash

Meteoroloji Genel Müdürlüğü (MGM), 27 Eylül 2026 Pazar gününe ilişkin hava durumu raporunu yayımladı. Son değerlendirmelere göre Türkiye geneli parçalı ve çok bulutlu bir havanın etkisine girerken, Edirne hariç Marmara, Ege, Akdeniz, İç Anadolu, Karadeniz ile Doğu Anadolu'nun kuzey ve batı kesimlerini kapsayan 63 ilde yerel sağanak ve gök gürültülü sağanak yağış bekleniyor.

Hava sıcaklıklarının Marmara, Ege ve Akdeniz bölgesinde 3 ila 5 derece düşeceği, diğer bölgelerde ise önemli bir değişiklik olmayacağı tahmin ediliyor.

MGM, olumsuz hava şartları nedeniyle Afyonkarahisar, Antalya, Aydın, Balıkesir, Burdur, Çanakkale, Denizli, Isparta, İstanbul, İzmir, Kocaeli, Manisa, Muğla ve Uşak olmak üzere toplam 14 il için 'sarı kod'lu meteorolojik uyarı yayımladı.

Güney Ege, Batı Akdeniz, İç Anadolu'nun batısı ile Kırşehir, Yozgat, Kırıkkale, Çorum ve Bolu çevrelerinde yağışların yer yer şiddetini artırarak kuvvetli olması bekleniyor.

Rüzgarın genellikle kuzey, güney ve doğu kesimlerde güneyli yönlerden hafif ve orta kuvvette esmesi beklenirken, Marmara ile Kuzey Ege kıyılarında kuzey ve kuzeydoğu yönlerden kuvvetli (40-60 km/saat) eseceği bildirildi.

Yetkililer kuvvetli yağış ve fırtına nedeniyle oluşabilecek ani sel, su baskını, yıldırım, ulaşımda aksamalar ve çatı uçması gibi olumsuzluklara karşı yurttaşların dikkatli ve tedbirli olmalarını hatırlattı.

Bölgelere göre hava durumu şöyle…

author: Unknown
title: Burcu Kapu ile futbol, aidiyet ve kimlik üzerine: ‘Futbol bizi bir araya getirirken karşı karşıya da getirebiliyor’
content:
Futbol, yalnızca 90 dakikalık bir oyun değil; aidiyet, rekabet, çocukluk, arkadaşlık, sınıf, kimlik ve güç ilişkilerinin de kesiştiği bir alan. Tribünde yaşanan sevinçten yenilginin yarattığı öfkeye kadar futbol, gündelik hayatta çoğu zaman bastırılan duyguların ortaya çıktığı bir zemine dönüşüyor.

Ayrıntı Yayınlarından çıkan “Futbol İnsanın Kendiyle Maçı” kitabında bu ilişkilerin izini süren Burcu Kapu, “İnsan neden futbolu sever?” sorusundan yola çıkıyor. Kitapta taraftarlık ve aidiyet duygusunun yanı sıra “biz” ve “onlar” ayrımı, futbolun sınıfsal yapısı, bahis ve şike ilişkileri, liderlik arayışı ve futbol endüstrisinin taraftarla kurduğu ilişki ele alınıyor. Kapu ile futbolun insanın kendisine dair neler anlattığını konuştuk.

“İnsan neden futbolu sever?” sorusuna tek bir biyolojik, sosyolojik ya da ekonomik açıklamanın yetmeyeceğini söylüyorsunuz. Kitabı bitirdiğinizde bu soruya kendi cevabınızı verebildiniz mi?

Sanırım kitabı yazarken cevabı bulmaktan çok, sorunun kendisini değiştirdim. Çünkü futbolu neden sevdiğimizi düşündüğümüzde karşımıza tek bir sebep çıkmıyor. Çocukluk, aile, mahalle, arkadaşlık, rekabet ve heyecan çıkıyor. Bazen de hayatımızda eksik olan bir şeyi futbolun içinde buluyoruz: Bir yere ait olma duygusu, birlikte sevinmek, birlikte üzülmek, kendimizi kalabalığın içinde hissetmek...

Benim vardığım yer şu: İnsan futbolu biraz da hayatı daha yoğun yaşayabildiği için seviyor. Normalde söyleyemediğimiz duyguları tribünde söylüyoruz, tanımadığımız insanlarla sarılıyoruz, kaybettiğimizde gerçekten yas tutuyoruz. Futbolun büyüsü belki de hayatın içinde dağınık duran duyguları bir araya getirmesinde. Bir maçın içinde umutlanıyor, öfkeleniyor, kıskanıyor, seviniyor, hayal kırıklığı yaşıyoruz. Hepsi 90 dakikanın içine sığıyor. Futbola bakarken aslında biraz da kendimize bakıyoruz.

Taraftarlığı bir aidiyet biçimi olarak ele alırken “biz” ve “onlar” ayrımının ötekileştirmeye dönüşebileceğini söylüyorsunuz. Sizce taraftarlık, ötekini yaratmadan mümkün mü?

Mümkün ama kolay değil. Çünkü aidiyetin içinde doğal olarak bir “biz” duygusu var. Bir takımı tuttuğunuz anda ortak bir hikâyenin parçası oluyorsunuz. Tezahüratları biliyorsunuz, kimliğini tanıyorsunuz, geçmişte yaşananları hatırlıyorsunuz. Bu çok güçlü bir duygu.

Ama burada önemli bir ayrım var: Rakibinizin olması başka, bir düşman yaratmak başka. Futbol rakipsiz düşünülemez. Hatta rakibiniz ne kadar güçlüyse kazandığınız galibiyetin anlamı da o kadar büyüyor. Sorun, karşı tarafı yenmekten çıkıp onu değersizleştirmeye başladığınız yerde başlıyor.

Rakibin formasını giyen kişinin de sizin kadar sevindiğini, üzüldüğünü, çocuğuyla maça geldiğini hatırladığınız sürece rekabet sağlıklı kalıyor. Kendi takımını tutkuyla severken karşı tarafın da aynı tutkuyu yaşadığını kabul edebilmek, bence taraftarlığın en güzel hali.

“Sevdiğin şey, seni neye dönüştürüyor?” sorusunu futboldan siyasete ve toplumsal kimliklere taşırsak nasıl bir sonuç çıkar?

Kitabın en temel meselelerinden biri bu. Sevdiğimiz şeylerle kurduğumuz ilişki bizi de değiştiriyor. Bir takımı severken nasıl davranıyorsak, bir sevgiliye, siyasi görüşe, toplumsal kimliğe ya da bir gruba bağlanırken de benzer şeyler yaşayabiliyoruz.

Sevdiğimiz şey bize güç verebilir, bizi cesaretlendirebilir, yalnız olmadığımızı hissettirebilir. Ama bir noktadan sonra sevdiğimiz şeyi eleştiremez hale geliyorsak orada durup düşünmek gerekiyor. Sevdiğimiz insanın, takımın ya da grubun yaptığı her şeyi savunmaya başladığımızda kendi aklımızı da ona bırakmış oluyoruz.

O yüzden benim için asıl soru sadece “Neyi seviyorsun?” değil. “Sevdiğin şey seni nasıl birine dönüştürüyor?” Daha cesur, daha dayanışmacı, daha tahammüllü biri mi yapıyor? Yoksa seni daha öfkeli, daha kapalı, başkasının varlığına tahammül edemeyen biri haline mi getiriyor? Sevdiğimiz şeylerle ilişkimizi biraz da buradan sorgulamak gerekiyor.

Futbolun insanları bir araya getiren tarafıyla insanları birbirine düşmanlaştıran tarafı arasında nasıl bir eşik var?

Bir adımlık incecik bir eşik var. Aynı tribünde binlerce insanı hiç tanımadıkları halde birbirine sarılabilir hale getiren duygu ile rakibin hayatını değersiz gören duygu bazen aynı yerden çıkıyor: Güçlü bir aidiyet ihtiyacından.

Kritik nokta, rekabetin ne zaman düşmanlığa dönüştüğü. Rakibi yenmek istemek oyunun doğasında var. Rakibin kaybetmesinden keyif almak da futbolun bir parçası olabilir. Ama rakibin acısından beslenmeye başladığınızda başka bir yere geçiyorsunuz.

Futbolun kalabalık bir …
